Project Manager

Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for end-to-end delivery of projects in line with GP Studio PMO lifecycle standards. The role ensures projects are delivered to scope, timeline, budget, and quality expectations while serving as the client’s primary day-to-day liaison, maintaining strong stakeholder communication, and ensuring client satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle. The role also requires strong operational discipline and effective use of approved AI tools to enhance delivery effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver projects end-to-end aligned to PMO lifecycle standards (kick-off, planning, execution, reporting, retrospectives, and closure)

  • Apply GP Strategies approved AI tools, prompts, and agents to enhance planning, reporting, and delivery efficiency

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project artefacts within approved systems (including SharePoint as the single source of truth)

  • Manage project financials including weekly budget tracking, monthly forecasting, baselining, and invoicing schedule execution

  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans aligned to approved scope, budget, and resource availability

  • Operate effectively in fast-paced and ambiguous environments, translating evolving client needs into structured delivery plans

  • Manage risks and changes proactively, ensuring appropriate mitigation, escalation, and formal change control

  • Produce high-quality reporting and documentation for stakeholders and senior management

  • Ensure quality standards are met, including required delivery artefacts (e.g. test plans, technical specifications where applicable)

  • Lead structured project retrospectives and ensure lessons learned are documented

  • Build strong client and stakeholder relationships to support satisfaction and repeat business

Skills and Capabilities

  • Strong project planning and organisational skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management

  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability

  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and digital/AI-enabled productivity tools

raw.description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

The Director of Sales Operations is a hands-on functional leader and people manager who will build and lead the commercial operating foundation for USGBC/GBCI and provide global oversight of sales operations, commercial processes, systems, analytics, and sales enablement.

The Director will establish effective processes, usable commercial data, forecasting discipline, Salesforce business requirements, and enablement.

They will lead the Sales Operations function, including the Sales Operations Analyst and Sales Enablement Lead, and support consistent commercial execution across all global regions.

The role is responsible for establishing and maintaining scalable sales processes, data governance, forecasting frameworks, performance reporting, and enablement resources that support market development and account management teams worldwide.

The Director of Sales Operations reports to the Global Head of Market Development and works in close partnership with the Regional Directors and Market Leads, the director of account management, customer account management and channel partner account management teams, the Client Solutions team, and the Product, Marketing, Finance, and Technology teams to support sales success across regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build the sales operations function and lead people:Establish charters, role expectations, operating priorities, methods, and service commitments. Recruit or develop approved capacity, coach and assess staff, manage workload, and prioritize resources and operational initiatives to support the development and effectiveness of the global sales operations function. Provide direct leadership, coaching, performance management, and professional development for the sales operations analyst and sales enablement leads.
  • Global commercial operations support:partner with the director of account management, regional directors, and market leads to establish consistent commercial processes, reporting frameworks, and operational standards that support customer acquisition, account management, and channel partner activities across all regions. Provide operational guidance and systems support without assuming direct responsibility for account management strategy, customer retention, revenue expansion, partner development, or account management team performance. Collaborate with the director of account management to ensure account management teams have the systems, reporting, process guidance, and enablement resources necessary to support their commercial responsibilities.
  • Establish coverage and engagement rules:Design sales territories, account hierarchies, segmentation, assignment frameworks, lead routing, regional handoffs, partner attribution, and joint-pursuit rules. Recommend equitable quota and KPI distribution across Market Leads for approval by the Regional Directors and the Global Head of Market Development. Administer approved allocations and resolve routine issues within delegated authority; and escalate strategic coverage decisions. Partner with the director of account management on account and partner coverage frameworks, handoff processes, and attribution standards.
  • Sales processes, pipeline management, and forecasting:establish and maintain opportunity stages, required evidence, pipeline reviews, commercial handoffs, and forecasting procedures to improve sales efficiency and effectiveness. Challenge unsupported assumptions, consolidate forecasts, and coordinate commercial plans with market development leadership and finance. Maintain visibility into commercial risks, resource capacity, and performance trends. Standardize forecasting methodologies, reporting expectations, and pipeline governance across global regions to improve data consistency and decision-making. Collaborate with the Director of Account Management to incorporate account retention, renewal, expansion, and partner revenue forecasts into consolidated commercial reporting, while account management leadership retains accountability for the underlying revenue results.
  • Salesforce governance, data quality, and business systems:own commercial data definitions, data quality standards, reporting priorities, and the salesforce business-improvement backlog. Oversee the sales operations analyst's business requirements, testing, and adoption activities while coordinating technical delivery and system controls with technology. Support Market Leads and Account Managers in maintaining accurate pipeline and forecasting data. Establish global CRM governance standards, data integrity practices, and user adoption expectations while ensuring system improvements support regional commercial requirements.
  • Sales enablement and commercial readiness:lead sales enablement priorities, including onboarding, playbooks, learning resources, tools, and process adoption for market leads, account teams, and relevant partners. Partner with product, marketing, client solutions, and service teams to ensure approved content, product-launch readiness, defined handoffs, and consistent working standards. Oversee the development and implementation of scalable global sales enablement programs that support consistent commercial capabilities across regions. Collaborate with regional directors and the director of account management to identify sales enablement needs, prioritize training and development resources, and support consistent commercial readiness across global teams.
  • Cross-functional commercial execution:serve as a liaison between market development teams and marketing and communications on campaign setup, audience segmentation, lead routing, and return-on-investment reporting. Collaborate with product, client solutions, finance, legal, hr, and technology to align commercial processes, customer handoffs, approval requirements, and operational priorities. Facilitate cross-regional collaboration and ensure global commercial processes are coordinated with organizational strategies and local market needs.
  • Commercial performance, reporting, and analytics:Monitor process adoption, customer and partner performance data, commercial performance, and cost and capacity considerations. Reconcile reporting with Finance, maintain auditable attribution, and prevent double counting or unauthorized commitments. Recommend resource and organizational adjustments based on performance evidence. Establish consistent global sales operations reporting and performance indicators to support leadership visibility into pipeline health, forecast accuracy, customer retention, expansion, and partner performance. Provide accurate and timely reporting to the director of account management and other commercial leaders, who retain accountability for customer retention, renewals, account expansion, and channel partner performance.
  • Operational improvement and change management:identify opportunities to improve commercial processes, system adoption, reporting accuracy, and team effectiveness. Lead operational improvements in collaboration with sales operations, technology, and regional leadership. Develop and implement scalable process improvements, documented standard operating procedures, and change-management practices that support consistent execution across global teams.
  • Operational governance, decision-making, and risk management:Manage sales operations team performance, operational priorities, review cadence, data standards, and enablement requirements within approved authority. Allocate work and administer approved commercial coverage frameworks and operational processes. Recommend territory planning frameworks, quota and KPI allocation methodologies, sales operations staffing, system investments, incentive reporting processes, and operational improvements. Escalate unresolved commercial process issues, sales operations capacity conflicts, disputed attribution, systems risks, and proposed operational changes to the appropriate functional leaders. Maintain clear decision-making authority, approval processes, and escalation procedures across global commercial operations, in alignment with the Global Head of Market Development.

Assessment Notice

Candidates who advance in the interview process will be required to complete an assessment, more details will be provided as the time approaches.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Experience

  • A minimum of ten years of progressively responsible experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial operations, or related business-to-business commercial functions, including at least five years with substantive responsibility for sales processes, forecasting, commercial analytics, or business systems, and at least three years of direct people-management experience.
  • Demonstrated success building, scaling, or materially transforming a sales operations or revenue operations function, including leading operational teams and implementing improvements in commercial processes, forecasting, systems, and performance reporting.
  • Practical expertise in pipeline governance, forecasting processes, account coverage, partner attribution, and commercial performance analysis in a complex business-to-business environment.
  • Experience translating commercial needs into Salesforce business requirements and governing improvements with technical teams without assuming technical control responsibilities.
  • Experience developing employees, managing approved resources, resolving commercial conflicts, and maintaining clear decision rights and auditable reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or supporting sales operations across multiple geographic regions or international markets.
  • Experience establishing standardized commercial processes, forecasting practices, and performance reporting for geographically distributed teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and managing operational change in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience leading global sales operations or revenue operations functions that support multiple business units, regions, or commercial models.
  • Experience developing sales operations frameworks, reporting dashboards, or CRM governance practices from the ground up.
  • Experience supporting commercial operations within a nonprofit, membership-based, certification, or professional services organization (preferred).

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, marketing, business analytics, operations management, or a related field required.
  • Master's degree in business administration (MBA), finance, business analytics, or a related discipline preferred.

Technology/System(s)

  • Advanced proficiency with salesforce or a comparable customer relationship management (CRM) platform, including pipeline management, forecasting, account hierarchies, reporting, and data governance.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, pivot tables, forecasting models, and performance reporting.
  • Experience with business intelligence and data visualization tools, such as Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or comparable analytics platforms.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, or comparable business productivity and collaboration tools.
  • Experience using sales reporting, forecasting, and performance management systems to support commercial decision-making.
  • Ability to define business system requirements, support user acceptance testing, and partner with technology teams on CRM enhancements, system integrations, and process automation.

Skills

  • Strong change leadership, cross-functional influence, prioritization, analytical judgment, and executive communication, with the ability to build standards while maintaining business operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead, develop, and coach employees while managing performance and competing organizational priorities.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to evaluate commercial performance, identify operational risks, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, geographic regions, and organizational levels.
  • Strong strategic planning, project management, and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple initiatives and lead teams across global time zones.
  • Ability to balance standardized global commercial processes with regional business needs, customer requirements, and market conditions.
  • High level of business acumen, financial literacy, and attention to detail, with a commitment to data accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Commitment to the missions of USGBC and GBCI and an interest in advancing sustainability in the built environment.

Credentials/ Certifications

  • Professional certifications in salesforce, revenue operations, business analytics, project management, or change management are preferred.
  • LEED Green Associate or LEED AP credential is preferred.

ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS PACKAGE

Salary

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.

Benefits

We offer you:

  • Competitive compensation
  • 401(k) with employer matching
  • Professional development reimbursement
  • We offer a healthcare plan through Cigna that includes medical, dental, vision, and prescription drugs. USGBC covers 100% of the premiums and an HRA that will assist you and your dependents in reaching the in-network medical deductible. You will only be responsible for the $300 individual / $600 family up front deductible for medical services before the employer funded HRA will process payments for your in-network claims
  • Generous paid time off (12 paid holidays, 9 paid personal sick days and based on career level either 2 to 3 weeks PTO), including operations closed for a full week between Christmas and New Year’s
  • 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service

LOGISTICS

Location:This position is remote in the U.S.

Work Schedule:Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM in candidate’s time zone. Flexibility to coordinate meetings and collaborate with teams across international time zones may be required.

Travel:May include domestic or international team meetings, strategic customer and partner engagements, and other organizational events as business needs require.

EEO STATEMENT

The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

ABOUT US

U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC)is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. Through LEED—the world’s most widely used green building rating system— and initiatives likes Greenbuild, the Center for Green Schools and advocacy, USGBC empowers professionals to drive market transformation that advances human and environmental health, climate resilience, and equity.

Green Business Certification Inc. (GBCI)is the world’s leading sustainability and health certification and credentialing body, independently recognizing excellence in performance. GBCI administers project certifications and professional credentials and certificates includingLEED,PERFORM,SITES, andTRUE Zero Waste.

We are proud to be globally recognized for our leadership in green building, environmental performance, and sustainable development.

Our Global Impact

  • Over 120,000 LEED-certified commercial projects worldwide
  • Millions of square feetof certified healthy, efficient, low-carbon space
  • Recognition in 180+ countries for innovation in green building and business practices

Why Join Us?

At USGBC and GBCI, you’ll work alongside passionate, mission-aligned professionals who care deeply about people, the planet, and progress. We offer:

  • A purpose-driven, inclusive culture
  • Opportunities to grow your career and take ownership of meaningful work
  • A chance to make a measurable impact on global sustainability efforts
  • We’re seeking team members who thrive in collaborative environments, are committed to excellence, and want to build lasting partnerships that drive change in the built environment.

Meet Our Leaders and Learn More about our Mission:

  • U.S. Green Building Council Leaders
  • Green Business Certification Inc Leaders

Culture and Values Statement

Working together, each of us advances our mission by respecting all voices, trusting and supporting one another, excelling through collaboration and accountability, and continuously improving ourselves and our organization.

Position Title: Subject Matter Expert - Navy Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Contracting Environment

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly experienced Subject Matter Expert (SME) with a background in the Navy's Procure-to-Pay (P2P) contracting environment. The ideal candidate will have over 10 years of hands-on experience in navigating the intricacies of Navy procurement processes and possess in-depth knowledge of the Department of the Navy's (DON) business processes, solutions, and systems landscape, including familiarity with the Integrated Awards Environment (IAE) systems and the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all matters related to Navy procurement processes, procedures, and systems.
  • Provide guidance and expertise on best practices within the Navy's P2P contracting environment.
  • Work closely with the Electronic Procurement System (ePS) program team to help develop the DON’s enterprise contracting capability.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to analyze, evaluate, and improve existing procurement processes and systems.
  • Stay abreast of developments and changes within the DON's procurement landscape, including updates to IAE systems and PIEE environments.
  • Act as a liaison between our organization and relevant Navy stakeholders, fostering positive relationships and facilitating effective communication.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
  • 10+ years of direct experience working within the Navy's Procure-to-Pay (P2P) contracting environment.
  • Deep understanding of DON's business processes, solutions, and systems.
  • Familiarity with Integrated Awards Environment (IAE) systems and Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE) environments.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify and solve complex problems.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven track record of delivering results in a remote work environment.

  • Experience with Functional User Support.

If you are a seasoned professional with extensive experience in Navy procurement processes and systems, and you thrive in a remote work setting, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join our team and play a key role in driving efficiency and innovation within Navy contracting operations.

To apply, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and qualifications.

Job Title: Systems Analyst

Role Summary

The Systems Analyst provides expertise regarding systems development implementation, maintenance and support activities to a wide range of business and technical situations throughout the SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst is responsible for leading, planning, and analyzing complex business requirements and implementing technology enabled solutions to address multi-facetted business opportunities and challenges.

The incumbent is Accountable for executing conceptual frameworks, implementation strategies and plans for recommended changes within SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst proactively contributes toward the development of the Technology team's tactical plans in support of business initiatives and occasionally offers directional guidance to clients and other applicable audiences.

Key Accountabilities

1.Provides technical expertise and consulting services in the development and implementation of new bank delivery systems, in order to achieve and maintain a competitive edge. Mentors system developers. Conducts and delivers analysis that presents comprehensive views on business challenges. Recommends and develops application architecture for assigned business application.

2.Completes complex systems development assignments, with minimal supervision, within budget and to client expectations, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oCodes or makes modifications to programmes according to detailed business requirements and specifications, including the execution of team and operability testing.

oProvides the required documentation including software unit test strategy, plan, matrix, scripts, execution completion report, software impact analysis, back-out and recovery procedures, technical implementation procedures, computer run sheet updates, system documentation, data dictionary updates and system user guide.

oConducts feasibility studies of multi-discipline business opportunities and challenges, assuming the responsibility for the development of business proposals.

3.Delivers products and functionality that fully meets business requirements, that may include but is not limited to the following:

oEnsures compliance with established policies, standards and methodologies, e.g., project planning, security etc.

oEnsures that no outages / problems are identified during user acceptance, operability and / or stress and performance testing or product implementation.

oParticipates in post-implementation reviews as required.

4.Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of current and the future direction of financial and computer industries, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oProvides expertise in areas of speciality, e.g., become the specialist in one or more information technology disciplines, commensurate with the current state of technologies.

oForecasts future trends, anticipates problems and conditions (e.g., volumes, new developments, turnover, etc.).

oConducts highly complex evaluations for product releases, standalone products, etc.

5.Partners and collaborates with Solution Architects, Solution Designers and Application Developers as required, striving towards high success levels in implementation of solutions and ongoing support.

6.Contributes to the realization of complex solutions that capitalize on business and technology developments by monitoring industry-wide standards and the development of new vendor products for applicability to the organisation.

7.Participates in the development, maintenance and implementation of policies, standards and guidelines on all aspects of technology architecture within the Technology team.

Role Specifics – Cyber Risk

Responsible for the technical analysis, maintenance, optimization, and support of key cybersecurity and data protection platforms across the Cyber Risk Programs. The role includes:

Maintaining, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting EOS ITPM, Rubrik M365 Backup, and Digital Crown Jewel protection.

Implementing system upgrades, resolving technical and connectivity issues, analyzing logs, and optimizing platform performance and security controls.

Supporting business analysts and project teams with technical expertise and operational troubleshooting.

Analyzing system requirements, technical capabilities, integration points, and design specifications for M365 Backup/Rubrik, Project OHM, SharePoint Data Governance scanning, and Advanced Server Protection.

Supporting requirements and design deliverables, documenting technical decisions, reporting on system health and security posture, and recommending improvements to strengthen security, segmentation, backup, and data protection capabilities.

raw.description:
Wholesale Sales & Account Manager

Location: Woodstock, GA (Primarily Remote)
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

A growing consumer products company is seeking an experienced Wholesale Sales & Account Manager to drive sales, develop new retail partnerships, and grow its wholesale business across two unique brands.

This is an opportunity for a relationship-driven sales professional who understands the boutique and specialty retail market and knows how to turn product interest into orders, build lasting retailer relationships, and generate repeat business.

The role supports two brands: an established luxury accessories brand specializing in authenticated vintage handbags and accessories, sold through boutiques, gift shops, resorts, and specialty retailers; and an emerging faith-forward wellness brand preparing to expand into the wholesale market.

The ideal candidate has experience representing consumer products to retailers, presenting collections, developing new accounts, and managing the full wholesale sales cycle. You'll have the opportunity to leverage existing relationships while identifying new markets, opening doors with prospective retailers, and helping grow both brands.

Key Responsibilities

Wholesale Sales & New Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and develop new wholesale accounts with boutiques, gift shops, specialty retailers, resorts, and other relevant retail partners.
  • Build relationships with boutique owners, retail buyers, and purchasing decision-makers.
  • Proactively reach out to prospective accounts through phone, email, social media, industry connections, and wholesale platforms.
  • Present products, collections, and brand offerings to prospective retailers and secure new orders.
  • Follow up on sales opportunities, maintain an active pipeline, and move prospects through the buying process.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce existing retail partners to additional products and complementary brands.

Wholesale Account Management & Growth

  • Manage and grow an assigned portfolio of wholesale accounts, taking ownership of ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Develop strategies to increase order frequency, average order size, and overall account revenue.
  • Build repeat business by consistently following up with customers, identifying reorder opportunities, and introducing new products and collections.
  • Re-engage inactive accounts and turn first-time buyers into long-term wholesale partners.
  • Understand individual retailer needs, buying cycles, product preferences, and customer demographics to recommend relevant products.
  • Maintain regular communication with accounts before and after orders to strengthen relationships and encourage continued business.

Trade Shows, Markets & Product Representation

  • Represent the brands at major wholesale markets, trade shows, and industry events.
  • Schedule and conduct appointments with current and prospective retail buyers.
  • Present product collections, communicate brand value, and develop new sales opportunities.
  • Follow up with leads and buyers after events to convert interest into wholesale orders.
  • Help prepare for markets and coordinate outreach to existing and prospective accounts.

Sales Operations & Account Coordination

  • Maintain organized records of customer interactions, sales opportunities, orders, and follow-up activities.
  • Track account performance, outreach, new business development, and reorder activity.
  • Utilize Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and other wholesale platforms to manage customer relationships and sales activity.
  • Coordinate with internal operations and fulfillment teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.
  • Assist wholesale customers with order questions, shipping updates, and product information as needed.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a proactive, commercially minded wholesale sales professional who enjoys building relationships, developing business, and taking ownership of sales results.

Required Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of direct wholesale sales, B2B sales, or wholesale account management experience.
  • Experience selling consumer products to boutiques, independent retailers, gift shops, apparel stores, or specialty retailers.
  • Demonstrated success developing new business, securing orders, and growing existing customer accounts.
  • Experience working directly with retail buyers, boutique owners, or purchasing decision-makers.
  • Comfortable with outbound prospecting, product presentations, sales conversations, and consistent follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of repeat business, account development, and the wholesale buying cycle.
  • Self-motivated and able to independently manage a sales pipeline and portfolio of accounts.
  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and organizational skills.

Preferred Experience:

  • Background in women's apparel, accessories, handbags, jewelry, beauty, gifts, or lifestyle products.
  • Experience representing multiple brands or product collections.
  • Previous showroom sales, territory sales, or national wholesale sales experience.
  • Experience attending wholesale markets, trade shows, or buyer appointments.
  • Familiarity with Faire, Shopify, CRM systems, and online wholesale platforms.
  • Remote Work Experience: Previous experience working remotely and the ability to work independently, stay organized, and manage daily responsibilities with minimal supervision.
  • Technology Requirements: Must have a reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, and a professional workspace suitable for virtual meetings, customer communication, and daily sales activities.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position open to qualified candidates nationwide. The ideal candidate will have prior remote work experience and be comfortable working independently, managing their schedule, and maintaining consistent communication with the team.

Sales and account management activities will be conducted remotely through phone, email, virtual presentations, wholesale platforms, and other sales tools. Occasional in-person meetings and trade show participation may be required.

This is not a daily road-sales position, but it does require proactive outreach, new business development, and the ability to confidently sell products, manage wholesale relationships, and grow accounts.

Why This Role Matters

The company has an established wholesale customer base and significant opportunity to expand its retail presence. There is an opportunity to develop new wholesale partnerships, reactivate existing accounts, increase repeat purchasing, and introduce an emerging brand to an established network of retailers.

The person in this role will have a direct impact on wholesale revenue and brand growth. Success will be measured by the ability to:

  • Develop and secure new wholesale accounts.
  • Grow revenue across existing customer relationships.
  • Increase reorder frequency and average order size.
  • Reactivate inactive accounts and generate repeat business.
  • Build a strong network of retail partners.
  • Support the wholesale expansion of an emerging consumer brand.

Target Start Date: December 2026, with the goal of being fully prepared for the January wholesale market.

Salary: $50,000 – $60,000 / year

Overview

The Accounts Receivables Insurance Specialist 1 manages the accounts receivable in accordance with compliance, regulatory and billing guidelines and specific payer rules. Responsible for collection of outstanding receivables through payer portals and/or phone lines. Responsible for the accurate billing of insurance claims by validating coverage, resolving charge review edits, claim edits and front-end clearinghouse and payer rejections. In addition, follows up on outstanding receivables; completes basic appeals; answers, documents and completes inquiries from, insurance companies, internal departments, and 3rd party payers. Works collaboratively with other departments such as Billing, Coding, Cash Posting, etc. to ensure claims are processed/paid correctly.

Responsibilities

Ability to take initiative but also accept direction and seek guidance appropriately. Ability to manage confidential information with sensitivity and discretion (in a HIPAA-compliant way). Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Timely and accurate claims submissions to health insurance carriers for community, government and commercial health plans as assigned, in the form of electronic and paper billing. Timely and accurate submissions of non-complex reconsiderations and/or appeals to health insurance carriers for community, government and commercial health plans as assigned, via paper, fax or web portal. Monitoring, researching, and resolving unpaid, rejected, denied and/or allowance discrepancy claims. Responsible for all aspects of account follow up and collections, as assigned. Ability to analyze accounts and determine the next appropriate action for account resolution. Accurately and thoroughly document the pertinent collection activities in the billing system. Determines and initiates appropriate action to resolve denied and/or rejected invoices, or invoices in allowance discrepancy and prepares payer corrections and/or appeals in accordance with payer plan requirements using electronic and paper processes. Utilizes clinical applications, payer websites and other systems as a research tool to retrieve medical documentation, patient eligibility information, billing guidelines, patient referrals, and hospital or procedure code authorizations to substantiate corrected claims submissions, through written appeals, and coding reviews, etc. Review account level undistributed payments for application to open balances as it applies to assigned payer(s). Reviews and resolves incoming correspondence. Identifies, prepares and appropriately requests adjustments. Responds to inquiries from patients, insurance companies, public agencies, internal departments and 3rd party payers. Identifies and resolves insurance set up errors to facilitate timely billing. Resolves charge review edits, claim edits and clearinghouse and payer rejections to facilitate accurate billing, as assigned. Evaluates Credit/Balance accounts and performs appropriate action to resolve, including but not limited to sending refunds and/or initiating payer recoupments via web portal. Evaluates accounts in an allowance discrepancy status against system loaded contract. Meticulously prepares appeals for appropriate reimbursement from payers. May prepare adjusted and corrected bills, adjust accounts receivable entries, or prepare refunds in accordance with existing operating procedures. May be required to answer calls coming into the department through a rotation line. Will assist or direct callers to the appropriate representative to resolve issues. Performs other duties as assigned.

Um dos principais desafios desta vaga é modernizar sistemas legados: evoluir aplicações em VB6 para C# e .NET Core. Você vai participar de todas as etapas, desde entender o código existente até desenhar, implementar e colocar os novos serviços em produção.

This role is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. Employees based in Utah are expected to work on-site Monday-Friday. Remote work may be available for candidates located outside of Utah.

Department: Healthcare Advisory Services - 955

Primary Purpose:

Supports Healthcare Advisory Services consulting engagements and internal initiatives through data preparation and analysis, research and benchmarking, preparation and production of deliverables, and defined project support activities. Works under the direction of Consultants, Senior Consultants, and department leadership to produce accurate, timely, and consistent work that supports healthcare organizations in improving laboratory operations, stewardship, outreach performance, staffing, operational efficiency, and financial performance.

Builds foundational consulting, analytical, and laboratory industry expertise through participation in client engagements, internal initiatives, and product development efforts. Contributes findings and draft insights while developing the judgement, communication skills, and technical knowledge needed for increasing responsibility within Healthcare Advisory Services.

About ARUP:

ARUP Laboratories is a national clinical and anatomic pathology reference laboratory and an enterprise of the University of Utah and its Department of Pathology. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

ARUP proudly hires top talent to create a work environment of diversity, professional growth and continuous development. Our workforce is committed to the important service we provide to over one million patients each month. We always strive for excellence and have a strong desire to have involvement with the advances in medicine and the role laboratory services plays within each patient’s life. We never forget that there is a patient behind every specimen we receive.

We are looking for individuals who want to contribute to ARUP's culture of accountability, integrity, service, and excellence. Consider joining our dynamic team.

Essential Functions:

Data, Analytics, and Reporting

Collects, cleans, organizes, validates, and transforms healthcare, operational, financial, and laboratory data from multiple sources.

Performs quantitative and qualitative analyses using established methodologies and quality standards.

Develops and maintains dashboards, reports, benchmarking resources, and other analytical tools.

Summarizes analytical findings and prepares draft insights and supporting materials for consultant review.

Identifies data quality concerns, risks, inconsistencies, and analytical limitations and escalates issues appropriately.

Research, Benchmarking, and Knowledge Resources

Conducts healthcare, laboratory, market, operational, and benchmarking research in support of client engagements, internal initiatives, and service offerings.

Compiles, evaluates, and organizes research findings and source materials for use by consulting team members.

Supports development and maintenance of benchmarking resources, knowledge repositories, methodologies, and reusable content libraries.

Monitors healthcare and laboratory industry developments and shares relevant findings with the consulting team.

Deliverable and Resource Development

Supports preparation and production of presentations, reports, proposals, dashboards, and other consulting deliverables.

Develops tables, charts, summaries, and draft presentation content derived from analyses and research activities and reviews work for accuracy, consistency, and completeness.

Supports development, standardization, and maintenance of consulting tools, templates, methodologies, and recurring deliverables.

Engagement and Project Support

Participates in client meetings, interviews, conference calls, and project working sessions as assigned.

Documents meeting discussions, decisions, action items, and follow-up requirements.

Collaborates with consultants and cross-functional ARUP teams to support project execution, deliverable development, and client engagement activities.

Practice Development and Professional Growth

Contributes to continuous improvement, standardization, and service development initiatives within Healthcare Advisory Services.

Develops knowledge of laboratory operations, utilization management, laboratory outreach, healthcare finance, staffing analytics, and operational improvement methodologies

Other Duties as assigned

Physical and Other Requirements:

Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist.

Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

Mobility: The person in this position needs to occasionally move between work sites and inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

Communicate: Frequently communicate with others.

PPE: Biohazard laboratory environment that requires use of personal protective equipment in accordance with CDC and OSHA regulations and company policies.

ARUP Policies and Procedures: To conduct self in compliance with all ARUP Policies and Procedures.

Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects.

Travel: Ability to travel off-site 20% of time

Title: Associate Director, Treasury

Department: Treasury

Reporting to: Chief Financial Officer

Compensation: $107K - $140K USD

Employment: Full Time

Location: USA - Remote

Who we are:
World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.
About the Opportunity:
The Associate Director, Treasury is responsible for leading the organization’s global treasury function, including cash management, banking operations, liquidity planning, working capital oversight, and treasury controls across all entities. Reporting to the Chief Financial Officer, this role owns cash visibility and forecasting, oversees banking relationships and access governance, and ensures effective management of cash movement, payment governance, and financial risk. The role partners closely with FP&A, Controllership and Investments, and external financial institutions to support short- and long-term cash planning, investment liquidity needs, payroll funding, and cross-entity cash operations. This role also drives treasury process standardization, policy development, ERP and banking-system automation, and scalable controls to support WES’s global growth.
  • Lead global treasury operations across all entities, including daily cash positioning, liquidity management, cash transfers, pooling structures, and capital optimization.
  • Develop and maintain the global working capital model, including cash balance reporting, weekly working capital analysis, cash flow visibility, and cash optimization across operating entities.
  • Own short-term and long-term cash forecasting in partnership with FP&A, Controllership, Investments, and Finance leadership to support operating decisions, investment planning, funding needs, and liquidity strategy.
  • Oversee global banking operations, including bank relationships, account setup and maintenance, banking documentation, authorized signers, user access, bank portal administration, and global account structures.
  • Lead, mentor, develop a high-performing treasury function, establishing clear roles and responsibilities and best practices, strengthening team capabilities, supporting professional development, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Govern treasury controls, including segregation of duties, payment approvals, dual controls, fraud prevention, bank access governance, signatory management, recurring access reviews, risk assessments, issue tracking, and remediation of control gaps.
  • Oversee cash disbursement governance, including ACH, wire, international payments, internal transfers, payment approvals, banking controls, and alignment with AP, Payroll, Controllership, and Investment activities.
  • Monitor and optimize cash inflows and outflows, including AP disbursements and payroll cash requirements.
  • Drive automation and integration of banking and treasury systems with the ERP, including bank feeds, host-to-host connections, bank-to-bank integrations, automated reporting, and process improvements that increase efficiency, accuracy, and cash visibility.
Your Experience:
Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field or equivalent work experience.
  • 5-8 years of experience in treasury, cash management, or corporate finance
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional business partners.
  • Experience managing global treasury operations across multiple entities or geographies.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading or managing a team,
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and dynamic team environment.
  • Ability to operate autonomously while being a team player who brings a positive attitude.
  • Act as a culture champion, modeling the organization’s values and ways of working.
  • Sage Intacct and/or other cloud-based ERP systems and Vena budgeting software experience preferred.
  • Systems integration and transformation experience desired.
  • Strong alignment with WES mission and values and demonstrates a growth mindset
Desired
  • Certified Treasury Professional (CTP) preferred
  • Experience in a nonprofit, social enterprise, or mission-driven organization.
  • This role is a remote first role with possible requirements to travel to the New York or Toronto office, potentially 2-3 times per year.
What We Offer:
Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options.
  • Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions.
  • Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career.
  • Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change.
  • Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.
Values:
  • Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures.
  • Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity.
  • Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions.
  • Enterprising - We are resourceful, inventive, and driven.
  • Expertise - We challenge ourselves to be the best at what we do.
Inclusive Recruitment Process:
We welcome all applicants, irrespective of their experience perfectly fitting the job description, as we value diverse and innovative viewpoints. At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. raw.description:
Sprague is passionate about delivering diverse products and programs that warm, power and move the world. We keep homes warm through Northeastern winters and hospitals cool through summer. We help small businesses focus on serving their communities, and our renewable fuels keep our country’s infrastructure running. From importing wind energy components to deploying leading-edge solar technology to help power terminal facilities, we are committed to continually evolving to meet our customers’ changing energy needs.

Our Culture

We recently surveyed our employees to ask them their favorite part of the job. They answered, "The people I work with."

In addition to great coworkers, you’ll enjoy perks like medical benefits and retirement contributions that start on your first day. Employees start with three weeks (15 days) of paid vacation time per year! Sprague also provides tuition reimbursement for any employee that would like to further their education. Do you like to get involved where you work? Is giving back important to you? It’s important to us, too! Sprague donates back to the communities in which we live and work every year and provides opportunities for employees to support various charities throughout the year. In addition, Sprague offers paid volunteer time to allow employees to support charities which are meaningful to them in the communities in which they live. Sprague has a range of committees to support varying initiatives (Sustainability, Charitable, Scholarship, Innovation, FunForce, etc.). Sprague is a place that cares about its employees, its community, and about creating a place where people want to come to work every day.

Plus, we have some great benefits!

  • 401(k) Traditional and Roth plans with employer match of 100% of the first 6% of the employee’s contribution
  • Defined Contribution Plan with an automatic contribution from Sprague
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • Flexible Working Policy
  • Choice of high deductible and PPO Health Plans to fit your individual needs
  • Wellness Program

We want to hear from you!

We are seeking an experienced Industrial Automation Application Developer to support our terminal automation systems and industrial automation solutions, including the back-office database systems that support these applications. This role encompasses software development, engineering, system integration, and vendor management responsibilities.

The position is responsible for ensuring the reliability, security, performance, and continuous improvement of Terminal Automation Systems (TAS), including loading rack controls, programmable logic controllers (PLCs), tank gauging systems, SCADA integrations, and interfaces with enterprise systems. Our ideal candidate will be able to perform duties in high pressure, time sensitive situations.

This opportunity will be remote and requires you to live within a 1 to 2-hour commute of Portsmouth, NH.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Knowledge and familiarity with load rack operations
  • Installation, upgrades, maintenance, and support of multiple terminal automation systems, including DTN Guardian G3 and TopTech TMS6/7, and support systems
  • Ensure continuous availability of critical systems including terminal automation, tank gauging, PLC, and HMI systems
  • Effectively communicate and manage issues with product vendors
  • Understanding of general operation, programming, wiring, and communication functions of AccuLoads and Multiloads, Weigh scales, PLC’s, and instrumentation
  • Ensure accurate data flow from terminal systems to corporate reporting platforms for inventory, throughput, and compliance metrics
  • Develop and maintain documentation and procedures
  • Develop and set up distribution of data reports
  • Provide 1st and 2nd level 24/7 on-call production support for systems as part of rotation with other team members
  • Work as a member of a team to design cost effective technology solutions in support of functional business requirements
  • Develop and maintain HMI screens for terminal automation, loading rack control, and industrial weighing systems with a focus on clarity, operator efficiency, and safety.
  • Design, configure, and troubleshoot PLC logic for loading racks, safety interlocks, permissive, and industrial weighing processes.
  • Integrate PLCs with terminal automation platforms, and field instrumentation using Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP, and serial protocols.
  • Diagnose PLC communication issues, I/O faults, and network disruptions to restore operational continuity.
  • Design and maintain industrial control system architectures, including Studio 5000 environments, FactoryTalk, Modbus TCP networks, and Ethernet based instrumentation.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Modbus TCP communication between PLCs, HMIs, and automation controllers.
  • Ability to perform duties in high pressure, time sensitive situations
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to apply technical knowledge
  • Occasional, but periodically frequent, travel as needed, when needed
  • Other projects as assigned

Do you like to solve problems and consider yourself forward thinking? If you are looking for a place to challenge yourself, then Sprague is your place. Sprague employees are dedicated and driven. We work best as a team, knowing that collaboration leads to innovation and the best customer experience. We are looking for hardworking colleagues to join us and help us stay at the forefront of the energy industry, which is where we’ve been for over 150 years.

Qualified candidates for this role will have the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline and a minimum of seven years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to successfully perform the job.
  • Knowledge of liquid and weigh scale terminal loading operations
  • Knowledge and experience with load rack metering devices (AccuLoad, MultiLoad)
  • Experience with management of terminal automation system applications including DTN G3 and Toptech TMS6/7
  • Experience with PLC/HMI programming, including Allen Bradley
  • Extensive database experience (Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL)
  • Research and resolve issues independently / strong problem solving skills
  • Ability to multi-task while maintaining attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team
  • Ability to prioritize workload, perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment and relate to customers/outside contacts and fellow employees

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting and/or standing at a desk.
  • Frequent use of computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Occasional reaching and stretching.
  • Occasional lifting and carrying light objects (usually up to 10 pounds).
  • Moving within the office environment, including visits to different departments or meeting rooms.
  • Prolonged periods of computer monitor work, reading documents, and detailed work.
  • Frequent typing and use of office equipment.
  • Ability to communicate clearly over the phone, video conferencing and in person.

Who we are:

Sprague takes a collaborative, customer-centric approach to providing best-in-class energy products and related services throughout the Northeast. Founded in 1870, we pride ourselves on offering customers the expert solutions and high-quality service that help their businesses thrive in any market landscape. Sprague values innovation, safety, integrity and people. We know that our people are what set us apart from our competition, and we work hard to make sure each employee across our 20+ locations knows how important they are to our community.

Come join us to learn why we are consistently celebrating 20-, 30-, and even 40-year anniversaries here at Sprague!

Sprague is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We strive to create a respectful and inclusive environment which welcomes people from all backgrounds and experiences.

raw.description:
Responsável por garantir a sustentação, disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança dos ambientes tecnológicos, por meio da administração e monitoramento da infraestrutura de TI, análise e resolução de incidentes, automação de processos e suporte operacional especializado, em conformidade com os padrões, processos e níveis de serviço estabelecidos pelo cliente. Atua na gestão de ambientes Linux corporativos, contribuindo para a estabilidade e evolução da infraestrutura, bem como para a continuidade dos serviços de negócio.

Principais atividades e responsabilidades:

  • Administrar e gerenciar ambientes Linux corporativos, garantindo disponibilidade, desempenho, segurança e continuidade dos serviços;
  • Gerenciar recursos computacionais dos servidores de forma integrada às plataformas de monitoramento e gerenciamento de infraestrutura;
  • Instalar, configurar, atualizar e manter sistemas operacionais Linux, seus componentes e serviços, incluindo ambientes de alta disponibilidade;
  • Diagnosticar, analisar e solucionar incidentes e problemas complexos relacionados à plataforma Linux e seus serviços;
  • Aplicar correções, atualizações de segurança e patches liberados pelos fabricantes, avaliando impactos e riscos no ambiente;
  • Definir e administrar padrões de nomenclatura para usuários, grupos e estruturas de segurança;
  • Configurar e prestar suporte às soluções de proxy e filtro de conteúdo utilizadas no ambiente corporativo;
  • Configurar, monitorar e solucionar problemas em ferramentas de monitoramento de infraestrutura e serviços;
  • Configurar e apoiar a administração de soluções de firewall, IPS e demais controles de segurança da infraestrutura;
  • Definir, estruturar e administrar recursos compartilhados em servidores, incluindo diretórios, permissões e compartilhamentos;
  • Prover suporte técnico a problemas relacionados a hardware, sistema operacional e serviços executados nos servidores Linux;
  • Participar de projetos de infraestrutura, fornecendo informações técnicas sobre arquitetura, características e dimensionamento de servidores e seus componentes;
  • Elaborar documentação técnica, procedimentos operacionais e guias de melhores práticas para utilização da plataforma Linux em ambientes de produção e alta disponibilidade;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar a tratativa de chamados junto a fornecedores e fabricantes para resolução de problemas de alta complexidade;
  • Realizar prospecção, avaliação e especificação técnica de soluções de infraestrutura baseadas em Linux;
  • Atuar na manutenção, evolução e melhoria contínua de soluções DevOps utilizadas pela organização;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de desenvolvimento para implementação de melhorias de desempenho, segurança e automação da infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e administrar ferramentas que contribuam para a modernização, automação e eficiência operacional do ambiente tecnológico;
  • Apoiar iniciativas de transformação tecnológica, propondo soluções aderentes às necessidades de infraestrutura e às melhores práticas de mercado;
  • Contribuir para a definição de padrões, processos e arquiteturas voltados à sustentação e evolução da plataforma Linux.

Formação:

Superior Completo na área de Tecnologia da Informação.

Experiencia profissional:

Possuir experiência comprovada em administração e sustentação de ambientes Linux corporativos, preferencialmente em ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade, mediante registros profissionais ou declaração de experiência emitida por instituições públicas ou privadas.

Cerificações/Cursos:

  • Treinamento ITIL 4, com carga horária de no mínimo de 12 (doze) horas.
  • Certificação oficial ITIL 4 Foundation ou superior.
  • Certificação LPIC-3 ouRed Hat Certified System Engineer (RHCSE)

raw.description:
A Atlas é uma empresa de tecnologia dinâmica e em forte crescimento,presente em cerca de 14 países, que usa tecnologia e inteligência artificial para trazersegurança, eficiência e inovação a todos os processos de governança e deconselhos de administração.

Todas nossas açõessão tomadas baseadas em quatro valores: Capital Humano, Clientecentrismo,Qualidade e Segurança. Onde o nosso principal valor é o Capital Humano. Somosfeitos de pessoas apaixonadas, inquietas, questionadoras e ousadas que nosajudam a buscar soluções de impacto que aceleram o nosso crescimento. Unindotecnologia, infraestrutura, desenvolvimento, respeito, diversidade econstruindo relações significativas.

Estamos buscando porpessoas que tenham brilho nos olhos por esses desafios e que queiram fazerparte da construção de um mundo melhor.

Reforçamos que nossas vagas são especialmente destinadas apessoas negras, indígenas, mulheres, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência (PCD) etodas as demais representações da diversidade. Junte-se a nós e seja partedessa transformação!

Descriçãoda vaga:

O(a) Digital Customer Success Manager é dono(a) do segmento digital da Atlas Governance: uma pessoa operando uma jornada escalável e orientada por dados, no lugar do modelo 1:1 de CSM.A posição fica na área de CSCX e reporta ao(à) Head of Customer Success. O perfil combina Customer Success (adoção, retenção, expansão) e Operações (monitoramento do Health Score, eventos de uso, automação e orquestração da jornada).

A missão é manter cada cliente do segmento digital saudável, engajado e renovando, por meio de gatilhos, plays automatizados e toques humanos pontuais, com um custo de atendimento bem menor que o do modelo high touch.

O que você vai fazerno seu dia a dia:

Monitoramento (Ops)

  • Monitorar diariamente o Health Score da carteira digital e agir sobre quedas, alertas de risco e inatividade.
  • Acompanhar eventos de uso do produto no Mixpanel (logins, adoção de funcionalidades, uso de IA, fluxos-chave) e transformá-los em gatilhos.
  • Manter dashboards e alertas do segmento: distribuição de saúde, adoção, risco e pipeline de renovações.
  • Manter os dados de CRM e da carteira limpos e atualizados, garantindo automações e relatórios confiáveis.

Jornada Digital (Ops + CS)

  • Operar a Jornada Digital: e-mails automatizados, mensagens in-app, webinars, office hours e conteúdos da central de ajuda.
  • Executar plays baseados em eventos (ex.: baixa adoção, sponsor inativo, renovação em 90 dias) e ser responsável pela execução.
  • Gerenciar os CTAs do segmento híbrido, direcionando cada acionamento para a pessoa certa.
  • Trabalhar com os agentes de IA de CS: supervisionar entregas, escalar exceções e propor melhorias.
  • Testar, medir e iterar: testes A/B de mensagens e cadências, reportando o que move as métricas.

Customer Success (CS)

  • Ser o ponto de contato humano do segmento quando os gatilhos exigirem: calls de risco, sessões de adoção, conversas de renovação.
  • Identificar sinais de expansão e repassar oportunidades qualificadas ao time de Renovações.
  • Escalar para Suporte, Produto ou CSMs Enterprise quando necessário.
  • Levar feedback dos clientes e insights de uso para Produto e para a liderança de CS.

O que estamos procurando na pessoa que vai fazer parte do time:

  • Experiência em Customer Success em SaaS B2B, sendo 1+ ano em Digital CS, Scaled CS, CS Ops ou modelo pooled/long tail.
  • Experiência prática monitorando Health Score e agindo a partir de dados de uso.
  • Conhecimento de analytics de produto (Mixpanel, Amplitude ou similar) e de CRM/plataforma de CS (HubSpot, Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero ou similar).
  • Experiência criando ou operando jornadas automatizadas: sequências de e-mail, mensagens in-app, gatilhos e workflows.
  • Forte habilidade com dados: planilhas em nível avançado, construção de dashboards, leitura de tendências e tradução em ação.
  • Experiência gerenciando carteiras grandes (100+ contas) com priorização e automação.
  • Espanhol e inglês avançados.
  • Comunicação escrita clara: a maior parte do trabalho é um-para-muitos.

Informações adicionais

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição (no cartão Swile);
  • Auxílio home office (no cartão Swile);
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Aulas de Espanhol;
  • Parceria com a EnglishPass;
  • Folga no aniversário e no aniversário dos seus filhos.

raw.excerpt: Description et livrables de la prestationContexte :Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
raw.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Dans le cadre d’un projet de décommissionnement de SAP BW, une organisation renforce son équipe Data Platform pour concevoir, industrialiser et optimiser ses pipelines de données sur Google Cloud.
Les données sources sont déposées sous forme brute dans BigQuery via SAP Datasphere. La mission porte principalement sur leur transformation en modèles analytiques fiables, performants et exploitables pour les usages décisionnels.

Livrables attendus :

  • Pipelines de transformation développés avec dbt dans BigQuery.
  • Modèles analytiques structurés et documentés.
  • Tests de qualité intégrés aux traitements.
  • Développements versionnés et intégrés au processus CI/CD.
  • Documentation technique et d’exploitation.

Missions principales :

  • Concevoir et développer les transformations de données sous BigQuery à l’aide de dbt.
  • Structurer les modèles selon une architecture en couches de type médaillon : données brutes, données nettoyées et harmonisées, puis modèles analytiques.
  • Traduire les règles de gestion définies avec les interlocuteurs métier et techniques en transformations SQL.
  • Optimiser les performances et les coûts des traitements BigQuery, notamment par le partitionnement, le clustering et les stratégies de chargement adaptées.
  • Mettre en place des tests et des contrôles de qualité des données.
  • Industrialiser les développements en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de versionnement, de revue de code et d’intégration et de déploiement continus.
  • Contribuer à la fiabilité des pipelines et à l’analyse des anomalies.
  • Documenter les modèles de données, les transformations et les procédures d’exploitation.
  • Selon les besoins, contribuer à l’exposition des données dans Looker à l’aide de LookML.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience significative en Data Engineering ou Analytics Engineering et savez intervenir de manière autonome au sein d’une équipe Data Platform.
Vous faites preuve de rigueur dans la conception, les tests et la documentation. Vous êtes capable de comprendre les besoins métier, de clarifier les règles de transformation et de collaborer avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles.

Compétences requises :

  • Maîtrise du SQL avancé et de la modélisation analytique.
  • Expérience confirmée de BigQuery : développement, optimisation des requêtes, partitionnement et clustering.
  • Expérience confirmée de dbt : modèles, dépendances, tests et documentation.
  • Maîtrise de Git et des pratiques CI/CD appliquées à la data.
  • Capacité à concevoir des traitements maintenables et fiables en production.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Premières connaissances de Looker / LookML.
  • Expérience de projets de migration d’entrepôts de données ou de refonte décisionnelle.
  • Familiarité avec les environnements SAP BW ou SAP Datasphere.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

raw.description:
Patient Scheduler II – Be the Go-To Support for Patient Care!

Are you passionate about helping patients and thrive in a fast-paced healthcare environment? Do you love staying organized, solving problems, and making a real impact on the patient experience? Join GetixHealth as a Patient Scheduler and become a key part of our Patient Support Center team!

This is your opportunity to make a difference every day by helping patients get scheduled, verified, and prepared for care. From appointment coordination to insurance verification, your work helps ensure patients receive timely, accurate, and compassionate service.

If you have strong customer service skills, healthcare scheduling experience, and enjoy helping patients navigate the healthcare process, we’d love to hear from you.

Position: Full- Time

Potential Start Date: 11/30/2026

Location: Remote (Must pass an internet speed test/ we provide the equipment)

Reports to: Patient Support Center Supervisor

Compensation: $18- $20 per hour

Operational Hours: The operating hours for this position are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM CST. Employees will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week within these hours, including rotating weekends. (Schedules are subject to change and based on the business need)

POSITION SUMMARY:

Provide day-to-day support for patient scheduling operations, ensuring timely appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and excellent communication between patients, providers, and medical staff.

You’ll serve as the first point of contact for patients by scheduling appointments, confirming visits, collecting insurance details, and helping patients understand their financial responsibility prior to care. Strong communication skills, multitasking ability, and attention to detail are essential.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and external facilities to schedule appointments by phone and electronic correspondence
  • Collect, verify, and communicate benefit details of patient insurance policies during scheduling
  • Educate patients on the insurance verification process and estimated patient responsibility prior to their visit
  • Confirm patient appointments and provide appointment details, location information, and special instructions
  • Create and maintain patient records including demographic information and required paperwork
  • Contact referring provider offices to obtain necessary records and visit preparation details
  • Coordinate with healthcare providers and medical staff to ensure appointments are scheduled efficiently and effectively
  • Respond to patient inquiries professionally and in a timely manner via phone and written communication
  • Collaborate with internal teams and third-party systems to support coordinated patient care
  • Assist insurance verification associates when needed
  • Maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality at all times
  • Other duties as assigned

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred
  • 2+ years of customer service, appointment scheduling, or healthcare experience required
  • 1+ years of EHR system experience (Epic preferred)
  • 1+ years of remote work experience preferred, especially in high-volume inbound and outbound call environments
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution skills
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and other computer systems
  • Strong customer service mindset with compassion and professionalism
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records
  • Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Dependable, punctual, and able to manage time effectively
  • Adaptable and open to change in a dynamic healthcare environment
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think critically
  • Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills
  • Empathetic and patient-focused approach to service
  • Professional communication and customer service skills

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote position requiring high-speed internet and a secure HIPAA-compliant workspace
  • Prolonged sitting and regular computer use required
  • Exposure to sensitive and confidential patient information
  • Occasional overtime may be required based on workload and business demands

WHY JOIN GETIXHEALTH?:

Founded in 1992, GetixHealth is a trusted leader in healthcare revenue cycle management, with offices across the U.S. and India. We’re more than revenue cycle experts—we’re a mission-driven team dedicated to helping healthcare organizations improve financial outcomes while delivering compassionate care. With over 1,800 employees, we foster a culture that values professionalism, innovation, and—above all—people.

BENEFITS & INCENTIVES:

  • Comprehensive Health Benefits: Choose from a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans designed to support your overall well-being.
  • Life & Disability Coverage: Receive company-paid Basic Life and AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, with the option to purchase additional voluntary Life and AD&D benefits.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Become eligible to participate in the company's 401(k) plan on the first day of the quarter following three months of continuous employment, with a company match to help you invest in your future.
  • Paid Time Off: Begin accruing PTO on your first day of employment, promoting a healthy work-life balance from the start.
  • Flexible Benefit Options: Tailor your benefits package with a variety of options to meet your individual and family needs.

GetixHealth is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.

Note:This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities or qualifications and may be subject to change based on business needs.
