raw.excerpt: Department OverviewThis position is responsible for the direct supervision of the centralized managed care activities within the Centralized Managed Care (CMC) Department.
raw.description:
Department Overview

This position is responsible for the direct supervision of the centralized managed care activities within the Centralized Managed Care (CMC) Department. Managed care activities include eligibility and benefit verification, preauthorization and patient estimates for all departments that are supported by the central team. This position directly supervises 18-23 staff and has the responsibility for the following:

  • Eligibility verification
  • Preauthorization (for all services including office visits, infusion services, inpatient admissions, chemotherapy, pharmacy medications)
  • Benefit level exceptions as applicable
  • Patient liability estimates
  • Retroactive authorizations and appeals for denied services

The Supervisor leads their team by recruiting, training, mentoring, and managing the work queues and performance of their direct reports, to ensure the department's key performance indicators are met. The supervisor will also perform the duties of their staff as needed. In addition, they will serve as the first line of communication with the practices/departments to answer questions, trouble shoot issues and improve processes/workflows. This position reports to the Centralized Managed Care and Price Estimates Manager.

Function/Duties of Position

Eligibility Verification, Pre-Authorization

  • Ensures that each high liability patient contact has a valid Epic referral attached to the appointment.
  • Ensures any services requiring pre-authorization are requested within established timeframes. Re-prioritizes resources when necessary to ensure metrics are met.
  • Ensures all eligibility verification and pre-authorization information is documented accurately in the Epic referral.
  • Reviews denials for lack of pre-authorization to attempt to resolve the issue. Recommends changes to processes to improve denial rates.

Staff Development

  • Ensures that each employee demonstrates competencies in the workflows they are responsible for.
  • Provides cross training opportunities to promote growth and team flexibility.
  • Manages lead workers and ensures they receive training and development opportunities to manage their workloads more effectively.

Department / Practice Communication and Management

  • Serves as the first line of communication with the practices/departments to answer questions and trouble shoot issues.

Quality Improvement

  • Performs quality assurance audits for employees.
  • Establishes goals for employees with the help of the manager.
  • Uses audits to improve staff education.
  • Conducts regular “in-service” trainings for staff based on audits.
  • Works with other Supervisors to ensure staff are held to the same standards.
  • Utilizes feedback from audits, practices/departments, and staff to design, create, and revise workflows to gain efficiencies and minimize financial risk with the support of the manager.

Daily Huddles / Visual Boards

  • Performs daily huddles with staff to ensure they have what they need for the day, are aware of priorities and allows staff to surface issues.
  • Creates and maintains visual boards that demonstrate the performance of the team.
  • Rewards staff for meeting performance standards and uses boards to assist in process improvement.
  • Participates in Ambulatory OPEx initiatives as necessary. Uses lean tools to continuously improve.

Patient Liability Estimation

  • Works with staff to provide patients with estimates of their potential cost of care using the Epic estimate tool.

Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Associates degree in related field or combination of education and equivalent experience.
  • Three years of prior experience in a clinical setting working with patient scheduling, benefit verification, pre-authorization, and a high level of patient interaction.
    • Experience should demonstrate progressive additions to responsibility and time spent serving as a lead worker.
  • Healthcare revenue cycle experience.
  • Must be familiar with Microsoft Office products.
  • Must have superb organizational skills and strong customer service orientation and experience.
  • Must have ability to work autonomously, be flexible and able to shift priorities on short notice.
  • The ideal candidate is driven by achieving outcomes in a timely manner.
  • A working knowledge of OHSU system, policies, procedures and the OHSUMG practices is a must.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Coursework in Healthcare and/or Education.
  • Specific experience with an integrated health record, Epic preferred.
  • Experience with determining acuity of patient for managed care purposes.
  • A working knowledge of OHSU systems, policies, procedures and the OHSUMG practices.
  • Experience with supervising staff who perform managed care, scheduling, and patient estimation.

Additional Details

Although the position is expected to work standard Monday – Friday business hours, there will be times when availability is necessary on weekends and during the evening.

Work Location: Remote and Downtown Portland (Fifth Avenue Building). Occasionally will include travel to off-site locations for meetings.

Benefits

  • Healthcare for full-time employees covered 100% and 88% for dependents.

  • $50K of term life insurance provided at no cost to the employee.

  • Two separate above market pension plans to choose from.

  • Paid time off - 208 hours per year, prorated for part-time.

  • Extended illness bank - 64 hours per year, prorated for part-time.

  • 9 paid holidays per year.

  • Substantial Tri-Met and C-Tran discounts.

  • Employee Assistance Program.

  • Childcare service discounts.

  • Tuition reimbursement.

  • Employee discounts to local and major businesses.

Why apply to OHSU?

We are Oregon's only public academic health center. In addition to caring for patients, we lead groundbreaking research. We also train the next generation of health care professionals. As Portland's largest employer, we give you opportunities to learn and advance in a system of hospitals and clinics across Oregon and Southwest Washington. All are welcome. OHSU welcomes people of all ages, ethnicities, genders, national origins, religions and sexual orientations. We are striving to build an anti-racist, multicultural institution and encourage people with diverse backgrounds to apply. To request reasonable accommodation, contact

raw.description:
About Slang AI

Slang AI is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences.

At Slang AI, we believe how we build matters just as much as what we build. We foster a culture rooted in hospitality, ownership, and clarity, where every “Slangsta” feels valued, supported, and connected to the broader impact of our work in the AI-powered future of restaurants.

What your experience will be

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for net-new business within our Enterprise segment. You’ll lead consultative sales motions with high-volume restaurant groups, hospitality brands, and enterprise foodservice organizations, helping them reimagine guest interactions through voice AI.

You’ll prospect strategically, run discovery, deliver compelling demos, and partner cross-functionally with Sales, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to create winning proposals and bring major brands into the Slang ecosystem.

Your success will come from combining thoughtful preparation, commercial acumen, and genuine curiosity, identifying how Slang’s platform can elevate guest satisfaction, improve staff efficiency, and drive measurable ROI for every client. This role requires both independence and collaboration, balancing strategic hunting with methodical execution, travel and representation at industry events.

Why You Belong Here and How You Will Grow

At Slang AI, you thrive in an environment built on trust, accountability, and craftsmanship. You believe that excellence is a team sport, celebrating wins collectively while taking personal responsibility for results. You view feedback as fuel, and you approach each deal as both a challenge and a craft to master.

We invest deeply in the growth of our people. You’ll have access to executive mentorship, advanced enterprise sales training, and opportunities to co-create the future of our go-to-market motion. Here, we measure growth not just by deals closed, but by the depth of learning, adaptability, and impact you drive across the business.

What Success Looks Like

  • Pipeline Generation:
    Develop and manage a robust pipeline of qualified enterprise accounts by targeting decision-makers across multi-unit hospitality brands (Director+ level). Deliver a minimum of $4M in influenced pipeline annually.
  • Full-Cycle Ownership:
    Run a disciplined sales process from prospecting through close—including tailored discovery, business-case building, procurement navigation, and contract execution. Average deal size $100K–$250K ARR.
  • Strategic Insight & Storytelling:
    Translate operational pain points into business value by quantifying ROI and telling compelling stories that align to executive priorities. Build trust and credibility across C-suite and IT stakeholders.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership:
    Partner closely with Product, Implementation, and Marketing to align messaging, streamline onboarding, and ensure every new logo transitions seamlessly post-sale.
  • Performance & Forecasting:
    Meet or exceed quarterly revenue targets with precision forecasting accuracy of >90%, maintaining CRM hygiene and deal inspection discipline.

What You Will Bring

  • 5–8 years of full-cycle SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years in Enterprise or Strategic new-logo acquisition, ideally in hospitality tech, automation, or CX solutions.
  • A consistent track record of exceeding $1M+ ARR annual quota with multi-stakeholder deal cycles and contract values of $100K+.
  • Strong command of MEDDIC or Challenger-style frameworks; able to articulate business pain and ROI fluently.
  • Experience selling into VP/COO/CTO-level personas within complex organizations.
  • Disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and process consistency.
  • A growth mindset—coachability, curiosity, and accountability at your core.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with executive presence and emotional intelligence.

How Work Affects my Life

Your success at Slang.ai directly impacts the hospitality world—freeing restaurant teams to focus on creating meaningful moments with guests. You’ll see your work translate into real-world outcomes: less friction, happier staff, and smoother service experiences. We offer competitive compensation, equity participation, and benefits that prioritize your well-being, ensuring your work enriches—not consumes—your life.

Compensation & Location

Compensation for this role is location-based and benchmarked against local market data aligned to the employee’s primary work location. Total compensation includes a mix of cash and equity and may vary by location, role level, and experience. Our range is therefore wide and not meant as a negotiation range.

Location: Remote

Travel: 50%

Base Compensation: $135,000 – $150,000

Variable Compensation: 50/50 split ($135,000-$150,000)

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $270,000 – $300,000

Equity: Included in offer package

Our Vision

Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang AI We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).

We have backgrounds building product at companies like Spotify, Buzzfeed, the New York Times, and OpenTable —shipping experiences that have reached hundreds of millions of users. Now, we’re using our backgrounds to start a new culture, one that puts product and human-centered design above all else while fostering constant learning and growth. Sound like something you’d like to be part of? Get on board.

Our Values

Overachiever Fever. We’re overachievers (we don’t know any other way)

AI Native. We don't just sell AI. We are Al.

Humility Ability. We approach each other with curiosity and openness (know-it-alls not welcome!)

Be A Good Host. We build for hospitality. We should embody it.

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Leads and manages team consultant team responsible for employee leave and accommodation activities. Oversees leaves of absence and reasonable accommodation interactive processes - ensuring alignment with applicable federal/state laws and internal Molina policies and procedures. Responsible for maintaining knowledge of applicable laws and regulations related to leaves, accommodations, and worker’s compensation, and applies knowledge/best practices, and recommendations for changes in policy, practice, and/or resources to applicable stakeholders.

Essential Job Duties

  • Oversees team responsible for facilitating consultation in the areas of leaves and accommodations; ensures alignment with federal and state regulations and internal Molina policies and procedures, including Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA), statutory leaves and accommodation entitlement programs as well as military, company-offered, and other types of leaves of absence.
    • Provides high level consultation to leadership and human resources (HR) stakeholders regarding absence management strategy, business planning, required documents and processes, caseload, eligibility, determination, and/or other legal requirements.
    • Independently handles high-risk or sensitive issues and/or escalations, identify recurring or systemic issues, and analyzes data by preparing consumable reports for leadership and stakeholders.
    • Proactively works to mitigate risk and contain liability to the organization; escalates issues as appropriate for further resolution.
    • Regularly exercises discretion and independently provides counsel on state and federal laws as well as company policy/compliance strategies to meet obligation to reasonably accommodate the known disabilities of employees and ensure FMLA application is consistent and without interference risk.
    • In conjunction with the leave team, provides high level consultation through facilitating the interactive process with employees for reasonable accommodation requests in accordance with federal and state and/or local laws and regulations.
    • Collaborates with other human resource centers of excellence (COEs) and stakeholders, serving as the subject matter expert in the areas of leaves and accommodations; solicits regular feedback regarding the quality of service from team and/or individual consultant’s performance.
    • Manages the partnership with the third-party administrator (TPA) to ensure open cases for leave, disability and/or worker’s compensation are managed in accordance with federal and state or local laws and organizational policies and processes.
    • Develops and delivers leave/accommodation trainings for HR business partners (HRPBs), leaders and other stakeholders.
    • Navigates complex HR data, laws, and policies in a fast-paced environment, while effectively de-escalating high-pressure or emotionally sensitive situations.
    • Maintains the highest levels of confidentiality and discretion; work routinely involves handling confidential or sensitive information, requiring protection and disclosure on an as-needed basis.
    • Prioritizes workload to ensure legal compliance and responsive customer service while maintaining highest levels of confidentiality and discretion.
    • Provides expert guidance on leaves and accommodations to enhance knowledge and alignment on best practices.
    • Hires, trains, develops and manages team; demonstrates accountability for team performance and achievement of department-specific goals.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 7 years of experience in human resources (HR), counseling, social work, law, or a reasonably comparable field, and at least 3 years of experience supporting employee leave/accommodation entitlement programs, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • At least 1 year of management/leadership experience.
    • In-depth understanding of Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA), American's with Disabilities Act (ADA), state-specific leave laws, and reasonable accommodation requirements.
    • Experience managing, administering and/or consulting on entitlement programs (leaves of absence, reasonable accommodations).
    • Human Resource Information System (HRIS) database experience and absence management software experience.
    • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
    • Ability to communicate and provide professional service and work products across all levels of the organization.
    • Demonstrated ability to analyze, interpret, and apply rules, regulations, policies and procedures.
    • Ability to navigate, maintain, and analyze employee data to support HR operations and compliance.
    • Proven ability to work independently while prioritizing competing deadlines and projects.
    • Ability to remain calm while successfully working to de-escalate stressful, emotionally charged situations.
    • Ability to speak concisely, compassionately, and persuasively; strong listening skills, in addition to conflict resolution, negotiation and mediation skills.
    • Organizational and time-management skills; ability to manage simultaneous projects and tasks to meet internal deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
    • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience providing coaching/training.
    • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

• Health care experience.

To all current Molina employees: If you are interested in applying for this position, please apply through the Internal Job Board.

Molina Healthcare offers a competitive benefits and compensation package. Molina Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE) M/F/D/V

raw.description:
About PDQ

PDQ, founded in Salt Lake City, UT, USA, makes device management simple, secure, and Pretty Damn Quick. IT teams use our products to reduce complexity, improve efficiency, and enhance control in their unique environments. We are backed by TA Associates and Berkshire Partners, top-tier global private equity firms.

Our Core Values:

  • Honesty: You communicate transparently and build trust through your actions.
  • Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow through on commitments.
  • Collaboration: You value diverse perspectives and work effectively across teams.
  • Improvement: You actively seek opportunities to learn, grow, and innovate.

Location

  • Remote, US - This position is open to candidates residing in any of PDQ’s open states: AR, AZ, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KY, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, NH, OK, OR, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI.

PDQ is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale intelligent, autonomous systems that transform how users interact with our products. In this role, you will develop AI-powered agents and workflows that can reason, plan, execute tasks, and interact with tools and systems to solve complex problems with minimal human intervention. You will work across the full software development lifecycle, combining strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in LLMs, agentic architectures, and AI-driven application development to bring practical, production-ready AI capabilities to life.

What you'll be doing:

  • Build new features in Elixir and React with TypeScript while designing and operating agentic AI systems that perform multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool execution for our cloud-native SaaS product.
  • Work in a CI/CD environment, shipping code to production frequently following agile principles.
  • Collaborate with engineering teammates in the US and Romania on shared priorities.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues, from bugs to outages and customer support cases.
  • Research, prototype, and contribute to technical decisions.
  • Participate in constructive code reviews and continuous learning.

We're looking for people who have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related degree, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years experience developing Elixir or Erlang based applications, with much of this experience in a professional setting
  • Experience with AI fundamentals and agentic workflows, including:
    • Autonomous or semi-autonomous agents
    • Multi-step reasoning, planning, and tool use
    • Feedback loops, memory, and stateful agents
    • LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, semantic kernels, custom agent frameworks)
    • Experience integrating LLMs via APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
    • Understanding of prompt engineering vs. system design tradeoffs
    • Experience handling hallucinations, guardrails, evaluation, and observability
  • Proven experience building intuitive, scalable UI/UX for SaaS products
  • Experience with agent-based or end-point management SaaS products is a plus
  • Familiarity with agile development and CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with GraphQL for building and consuming APIs
  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and PostgreSQL
  • Exposure to observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
  • Exposure to open-source development is a plus.

Who you are:

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for projects, drive results, and deliver on commitments
  • Honesty: You demonstrate integrity, transparency, and ethical behavior in all interactions
  • Collaboration: You work effectively with cross-functional teams and foster a culture of teamwork
  • Improvement: You continuously seek opportunities for growth, innovation, and personal development
  • Passionate about delivering business value by applying your engineering skills
  • Experience building clean and simple solutions at scale
  • Possess strong analytic, technical, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively through written or verbal medium
  • Knowledge of Git version control and branching strategies
  • Defensive security strategies for both client and server-side web systems
  • Strong ability to create lightweight proposals, diagrams, specifications, and other analyses from user requirements
  • Excellent debugging skills and pragmatic design experience
  • Experience with test-driven development and automated testing frameworks
  • Ability to read code and quickly make sense of an unfamiliar codebase
  • Ability to understand a problem space and make code changes safely
  • Experience with internal quality validation marker PDQ-Elixir-SIGNAL-

PDQ Perks & Benefits:

PDQ offers all of the great perks and benefits you'd expect from working at a very cool tech company, and even some you might not expect, including:

  • 4-Day Work Week
  • Equity
  • Managers who champion professional development
  • 100% Premium Coverage for medical, dental and vision for you and your dependents
  • 100% Premium Coverage for Short Term Disability, Long Term Disability, Life, and AD&D Insurance
  • Company Match of the first 6% of your employee deferrals
  • Flexible Paid Time Off Policy that treats you like the adult that you are
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and wellness incentives
  • Quarterly Company Values Award (team member nominated)

Equal Opportunity Employer

PDQ is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, provincial, state, or local law. If you would like to request reasonable accommodation for a medical condition or disability during any part of the application process, please contact .

Work Authorization and Sponsorship

The majority of PDQ's full-time roles do not qualify for sponsorship of employment visas such as the H-1B visa. This applies to scenarios where a candidate might possess temporary work authorization during their schooling or after graduation (e.g., CPT, OPT), but would require H-1B visa sponsorship within a few years of employment to retain eligibility for employment.

Job Summary

Reporting to the VP- Client and CDL Operations, the Director of CDL Operations is responsible for ensuring thatall training locations are operating at the highest levels of safety, effectiveness, and efficiency with respectto the business plan.

This position serves as the Subject Matter Expert for CDL programs equipment and protocols. This leader has overall responsibility for Federal and State regulatory compliance,curriculum implementation, along with training of staff and their on-going development.They will effectively conduct onboarding and training at all locations to ensure training standards areconsistently upheld. They execute plans for achieving and exceeding the budgeted level of growth andprofitability, the student experience metrics, compliance, and other key success metrics for all trainingprogram locations to deliver an optimal student learning experience. This position works collaboratively withother Ancora departments to identify and drive best practices and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversees CDL Programs and supports day-to-day CDL Operations

●Trains and Retains Program Personnel

  • Executes Business Development Plans for CDL Programs
  • Provides oversight and support related to facilities and equipment
  • Represents Strategic Programs Internally and Externally
  • Maintains Compliance with Key Regulatory Rules
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines of multiple concurrent tasks
  • Ability to remain flexible and easily adapt to changes in work environment or schedule
  • Ability to communicate effectively and provide a positive, professional impression via phone, email, text and in-person to students and staff from diverse backgrounds
  • Ability to assist the Account Management department with support and training needs as applicable
  • Ability to work and succeed individually and as part of a team in a highly structured and regulated work environment.
  • Ability to work remotely in any/all states in which Ancora is licensed/approved to do business.

Education and Experience Required

  • Four-year degree from an institution accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education (or international equivalent) or 5+ years of experience in post secondary education.
  • 5 years of commercial vehicle driving/training or related experience
  • 5 years of program/team management experience

● Customer service-oriented

● Proficiency in Google Suite

  • Critical thinker with effective problem-solving skills
  • Excellent analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills, ability to work with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Superior verbal and written English language skills; ability to communicate effectively with a variety of audiences

● Attention to detail

  • Ability to process multiple types of information and make judgments about moving from one task to another based on priority/importance
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills

● Professionally polished

Physical Demands

  • Mobility & Balance: Ability to frequently climb in/out of the cab, bend, squat, kneel, twist and reach to perform pre/post-trip inspections and navigate tight spaces.
  • Strength: Ability to crank trailer landing gear (often 100+ lbs), handle training and safety equipment, and potentially assist with loading/unloading (if applicable).
  • Endurance: Ability to sustain physical activity and be alert during extending driving and instructional periods, including exposure to varying weather conditions such as heat, cold, wind, rain, ice or snow.
  • Sensory Acuity and Overall Health: Must possess and maintain a valid DOT Medical Examiner’s Certificate and meet DOT physical qualifications required to hold a CDL, with or without reasonable accommodations, as required by Federal regulations.

Work Environment

raw.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Monitor federal and state legislative, regulatory, coding, payment, and coverage developments affecting clinical laboratories, molecular diagnostics, genomics, rare disease, and precision medicine; convert changes into clear enterprise implications and action plans.
  • Represent Baylor Genetics in health policy matters with trade associations, standards-setting organizations, public agencies, coalitions, payer policy forums, and other external stakeholders.
  • Lead end-to-end coding strategy for new and existing products, including applications for new or revised CPT codes through the American Medical Association and coordination of ICD-10-CM code proposals through the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and other appropriate federal processes.
  • Develop evidence, utilization, clinical-workflow, and economic rationales required to support coding, valuation, coverage, and reimbursement submissions.
  • Lead state health policy strategies that accelerate adoption and sustainable funding of rapid WGS for critically ill infants and children, including Medicaid, appropriations, coverage mandates, pilots, and implementation pathways.
  • Partner with authorized Government Affairs resources, external coalitions, and registered lobbyists to educate and engage state legislatures and members of the U.S. Congress on Baylor Genetics priorities in accordance with Legal and Compliance requirements.
  • Lead upstream pipeline reimbursement planning for new products, platform extensions, and tuck-in acquisitions, including coding, coverage, payment, evidence, channel, operational, and commercialization-readiness assessments.
  • Integrate reimbursement and policy diligence into business-development evaluations, identifying access risks, evidence gaps, investment requirements, and post-close integration priorities.
  • Guide responses to proposed federal and state rules, payer policies, fee schedules, laboratory payment reforms, and other public-comment opportunities.
  • Build executive-ready policy briefs, scenario analyses, risk assessments, and recommendations for senior leadership and the Board, as appropriate.
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle and Finance to assess payment adequacy, coding performance, denial patterns, fee-schedule changes, and financial impact.
  • Maintain governance, documentation, and compliance controls for policy engagement, coding submissions, coalition activity, and external representation.

People Leadership Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, develop, and retain a team responsible for health policy, coding, reimbursement strategy, and government-affairs coordination.
  • Establish measurable objectives, operating rhythms, decision rights, and accountability aligned to enterprise priorities.
  • Conduct regular portfolio, policy, and pipeline reviews; remove barriers and ensure timely execution of critical submissions and advocacy initiatives.
  • Develop succession plans and expand organizational capability in laboratory policy, coding, payment, and state-government engagement.
  • Promote a culture of integrity, evidence-based advocacy, cross-functional partnership, and execution excellence.

Core Deliverables

  • Annual federal and state health policy strategy with prioritized issues, stakeholders, risks, and action plans.
  • CPT and ICD-10-CM coding roadmaps, applications, evidence packages, and milestone plans for priority products.
  • State rWGS adoption strategy, including legislative, Medicaid, appropriations, coalition, and implementation pathways.
  • Congressional and state policy engagement plans executed with authorized Government Affairs and Compliance partners.
  • Pipeline and acquisition reimbursement-readiness assessments with clear go/no-go considerations and investment requirements.
  • Executive dashboards covering policy developments, coding milestones, reimbursement risks, advocacy progress, and expected business impact.

Key Success Metrics

  • Achievement of coding milestones and favorable outcomes for priority CPT and ICD-10-CM initiatives.
  • Number and quality of state policies, Medicaid pathways, appropriations, or programs advancing rWGS adoption.
  • Progress against federal and state policy priorities, including compliant engagement with members of Congress and legislative stakeholders.
  • Pipeline products and tuck-in acquisitions entering commercialization with complete coding, coverage, payment, and evidence strategies.
  • Timely identification and mitigation of material legislative, regulatory, coding, and reimbursement risks.
  • Improvement in payment adequacy, coding clarity, reimbursement predictability, and access for Baylor Genetics products.
  • Team performance, retention, succession readiness, and achievement of annual objectives.
  • Quality, timeliness, and executive usefulness of policy intelligence, scenario planning, and recommendations.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Health Policy, Public Health, Life Sciences, Business, Healthcare Administration, Health Economics, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of leading teams in health policy and reimbursement
  • 12+ years in progressive experience, combination with the following experience;

o8+ years of progressive experience in health policy, reimbursement, coding, government affairs, market access, or related healthcare leadership roles.

o8+ years of direct laboratory health policy and reimbursement experience, preferably in molecular diagnostics, genomics, or precision medicine.

  • Demonstrated experience leading CPT coding strategy and familiarity with ICD-10-CM coordination and federal coding processes.
  • Demonstrated success influencing state or federal health policy, reimbursement, Medicaid, or legislative initiatives through compliant advocacy and coalition engagement.
  • Experience leading and developing teams responsible for policy, coding, reimbursement, or government affairs.
  • Ability to interpret legislation, regulations, coding guidance, payment policy, and payer requirements and translate them into business strategy.
  • Executive-level communication, deductive storytelling, negotiation, and cross-functional influence skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 40–50% domestically.
    •

Preferred:

  • MBA, MPH, MHA, JD, MS, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent advanced degree.
  • Experience with rWGS, WGS, WES, NGS, rare disease, oncology genomics, reproductive genetics, or pediatric critical care.
  • Experience with AMA CPT processes, CMS payment systems, state Medicaid programs, and CDC ICD-10-CM coordination processes.
  • Established relationships with laboratory trade associations, patient-advocacy organizations, state policy coalitions, federal agencies, and legislative stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting product pipeline strategy, licensing, mergers and acquisitions, or post-acquisition integration.
  • Experience developing public-comment letters, legislative language, fiscal-impact analyses, or reimbursement evidence packages.
    •

COMPETENCIES

✓ Enterprise Health Policy Leadership ✓ Laboratory Coding & Reimbursement

✓ Government Affairs & Advocacy ✓ State Policy Strategy

✓ Pipeline & Acquisition Planning ✓ Executive Presence & Influence

✓ Evidence-Based Communication ✓ Cross-Functional Collaboration

✓ People Leadership & Talent Development ✓ Compliance & Execution Excellence

ROLE IMPACT

This role shapes the policy, coding, and reimbursement environment required to accelerate rWGS adoption, support product innovation, enable strategic growth, and expand patient access to Baylor Genetics testing.

ABOUT ACCESS OFFSHORING:

We specialise in providing Australian businesses with experience and qualified professionals based in the Philippines. Not only does our team of recruiters have extensive experience in sourcing and recruiting offshore talent, we also help Australian businesses implement best practice when it comes to building an offshore team.
JOB SUMMARY
The Mechanical Engineer is a newly created position within the Commercial division, designed to strengthen the technical capability of the business and bring in-house engineering expertise to the project delivery and estimating functions. This role is responsible for preparing and reviewing mechanical system designs, driving value engineering outcomes, supporting the estimating team with technical input, and leading design and construct documentation from inception through to handover. The Mechanical Engineer will also play an active role in shaping internal processes and systems, while mentoring and guiding other team members to elevate technical standards across the division.
Key Responsibilities
  • Prepare and review mechanical system designs for HVAC and building services projects, ensuring technical accuracy, compliance, and buildability
  • Lead value engineering reviews across active tenders and projects, identifying cost-effective design alternatives that maintain or improve performance outcomes
  • Assess existing designs, specifications, and consultant documentation to identify opportunities for value engineering, rationalisation, or improvement
  • Produce and review design documentation, including schematics, equipment schedules, load calculations, and design reports to support project delivery
  • Ensure all designs comply with relevant Australian Standards, NCC requirements, and client specifications
  • Liaise with mechanical consultants, certifiers, and head contractors on technical design matters as required
  • Work closely with the Senior Estimator and Estimator to provide technical input and design guidance during the tender preparation process
  • Review tender documents, drawings, and specifications to identify technical risks, gaps, and value engineering opportunities prior to bid submission
  • Assist in the preparation of design and construct tenders by developing outline design solutions and associated cost assumptions
  • Support post-award scope reviews to ensure the estimate basis reflects the agreed design intent and project delivery model
  • Assist with variation pricing by reviewing proposed scope changes and providing technical assessments of design impact and cost
  • Lead the design management process on design and construct projects, coordinating with consultants, suppliers, and internal teams to meet programme and design milestones
  • Prepare and manage design and construct documentation, including design briefs, drawing registers, review schedules, and authority submission packages
  • Coordinate design reviews, consultant workshops, and technical RFI responses throughout the design development and construction phases
  • Ensure design intent is maintained through construction by supporting Site Supervisors and Project Managers with technical guidance on site
  • Actively participate in the development and implementation of engineering processes, documentation standards, and technical frameworks within the Commercial division
  • Contribute to the creation of standard design templates, calculation tools, and technical reference documents that improve efficiency and consistency across the team
  • Identify opportunities to improve how engineering knowledge is captured, shared, and applied across estimating, project delivery, and design functions
  • Support senior management in embedding engineering-led thinking into operational and commercial processes
  • Mentor and guide estimating and project management team members on technical and engineering matters, lifting the overall capability of the commercial team
  • Provide structured technical guidance to junior and mid-level staff, supporting their development through review, feedback, and on-the-job coaching
  • Actively share knowledge and expertise across the team to build internal engineering capability and reduce reliance on external consultants over time
  • Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, and professional development within the Commercial division.

Requirements

  • Degree qualified in Mechanical Engineering or Building Services Engineering (or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated experience in HVAC and mechanical building services design within the Australian commercial construction market
  • Strong understanding of value engineering principles and the ability to apply them practically within commercial project environment
  • Experience supporting or leading design and construct projects including design management, documentation, and authority submissions
  • Solid knowledge of relevant Australian Standards, NCC requirements, and mechanical services design codes
  • Experience working alongside estimating teams in a technical advisory or design support capacity
  • Proficiency in relevant engineering software including load calculation tools, CAD, and Revit or similar BIM platforms
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical information clearly to non-engineering stakeholders
  • Proven ability to mentor and develop team members in a professional and constructive manner

Benefits

Here at Access Offshoring, we believe in more than finding our clients the right candidate. We believe in the human perspective. We believe in our candidates and their dreams. We believe in finding the right role for you. We are committed to working for you as much as we work for our clients.
Access Offshoring is dedicated to saving business owners 2,000,000 hours by 2031 and we need your help. Transforming the way businesses operate, we connect great businesses with amazing offshore talent.
We recognise that we often get more done in our own designed workspace, so Access Offshoring offers a complete work from home model. Yep – that’s right, 100% work from home. But wait there’s more.
Here are just some of our benefits:
  • Australian clients and Australian hours (giving you great experience and an early finish!)

  • 20 Days Annual Leave and 5 Days Sick L​eave

Nous mettons à leur disposition un outil puissant mais simple dutilisation pour les aider à opérer plus efficacement et plus facilement en éliminant les silos et permettant une meilleure flexibilité.

Lensemble de nos équipes, quels soient orientés fonctionnel ou technique, travail dans la collaboration pour livrer des solutions qui répondent à des besoins métiers afin de donner toujours plus de valeur ajoutée à nos produits.

Job Title: Systems Analyst

Role Summary

The Systems Analyst provides expertise regarding systems development implementation, maintenance and support activities to a wide range of business and technical situations throughout the SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst is responsible for leading, planning, and analyzing complex business requirements and implementing technology enabled solutions to address multi-facetted business opportunities and challenges.

The incumbent is Accountable for executing conceptual frameworks, implementation strategies and plans for recommended changes within SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst proactively contributes toward the development of the Technology team's tactical plans in support of business initiatives and occasionally offers directional guidance to clients and other applicable audiences.

Key Accountabilities

1.Provides technical expertise and consulting services in the development and implementation of new bank delivery systems, in order to achieve and maintain a competitive edge. Mentors system developers. Conducts and delivers analysis that presents comprehensive views on business challenges. Recommends and develops application architecture for assigned business application.

2.Completes complex systems development assignments, with minimal supervision, within budget and to client expectations, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oCodes or makes modifications to programmes according to detailed business requirements and specifications, including the execution of team and operability testing.

oProvides the required documentation including software unit test strategy, plan, matrix, scripts, execution completion report, software impact analysis, back-out and recovery procedures, technical implementation procedures, computer run sheet updates, system documentation, data dictionary updates and system user guide.

oConducts feasibility studies of multi-discipline business opportunities and challenges, assuming the responsibility for the development of business proposals.

3.Delivers products and functionality that fully meets business requirements, that may include but is not limited to the following:

oEnsures compliance with established policies, standards and methodologies, e.g., project planning, security etc.

oEnsures that no outages / problems are identified during user acceptance, operability and / or stress and performance testing or product implementation.

oParticipates in post-implementation reviews as required.

4.Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of current and the future direction of financial and computer industries, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oProvides expertise in areas of speciality, e.g., become the specialist in one or more information technology disciplines, commensurate with the current state of technologies.

oForecasts future trends, anticipates problems and conditions (e.g., volumes, new developments, turnover, etc.).

oConducts highly complex evaluations for product releases, standalone products, etc.

5.Partners and collaborates with Solution Architects, Solution Designers and Application Developers as required, striving towards high success levels in implementation of solutions and ongoing support.

6.Contributes to the realization of complex solutions that capitalize on business and technology developments by monitoring industry-wide standards and the development of new vendor products for applicability to the organisation.

7.Participates in the development, maintenance and implementation of policies, standards and guidelines on all aspects of technology architecture within the Technology team.

Role Specifics – Cyber Risk

Responsible for the technical analysis, maintenance, optimization, and support of key cybersecurity and data protection platforms across the Cyber Risk Programs. The role includes:

Maintaining, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting EOS ITPM, Rubrik M365 Backup, and Digital Crown Jewel protection.

Implementing system upgrades, resolving technical and connectivity issues, analyzing logs, and optimizing platform performance and security controls.

Supporting business analysts and project teams with technical expertise and operational troubleshooting.

Analyzing system requirements, technical capabilities, integration points, and design specifications for M365 Backup/Rubrik, Project OHM, SharePoint Data Governance scanning, and Advanced Server Protection.

Supporting requirements and design deliverables, documenting technical decisions, reporting on system health and security posture, and recommending improvements to strengthen security, segmentation, backup, and data protection capabilities.

Integrative Acquisition Environment

DOD acquisition system

The ten (10) years of experience may be reduced to five (5) years of progressive experience if combined with an Advanced Business or Business related degree.

Knowledge of Federal and DOD acquisition procedures

Location: Sheffield, covering Sheffield or surrounding areas such as Rotherham or Chesterfield (fully field-based)

£50,000–£90,000 OTE (£30,000–£54,000 base salary + uncapped commission, based on experience) + £800 monthly car allowance and a comprehensive benefits package

Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services have made life harder for them, with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that. We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe, bringing together payments, business accounts and other business tools with simple technology and real human support. From card payments and business accounts to financing solutions, we help our Members spend less time worrying about their finances and more time doing what they love.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you’re ambitious, enjoy meeting new people and want to make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We’re looking for ambitious, driven people to join our growing Field Sales team and help bring Teya to more local businesses across the UK.

As a Field Sales Representative, you’ll take ownership of your own territory, getting out into your local community, meeting business owners face-to-face and showing them how Teya can help their businesses thrive.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being out in the field, building relationships and winning new business. You’ll have the freedom to manage your territory, the support of a team that wants you to succeed, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career in sales.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own your territory: Proactively identify and engage local businesses through face-to-face prospecting, networking, referrals and other opportunities to generate new business.

  • Build meaningful relationships: Get to know business owners, understand their challenges and identify how Teya’s products and services can make their lives easier.

  • Win new Members: Use a consultative, value-led approach to demonstrate Teya’s solutions, build trust and turn conversations into long-term customer relationships.

  • Deliver results: Take ownership of your sales performance, maintain a healthy pipeline and consistently work towards your commercial targets.

  • See things through: Take responsibility for your Members’ experience from the first conversation through to onboarding, ensuring they’re set up successfully and ready to start using Teya.

  • Keep learning: Develop strong knowledge of our products, competitors and sales methodology through structured training, coaching and feedback.

  • Represent Teya: Be a trusted face of Teya in your local community, delivering the genuine care and hospitality that we want every Member to experience.

  • Help us improve: Share insights from the field to help us continuously improve our products, sales approach and Member experience.

Your Story

We believe great salespeople come from all kinds of backgrounds.

You might already be an experienced field sales professional with a strong track record of winning new business. Or you might be earlier in your career, with the ambition, drive and potential to become an exceptional salesperson.

What matters most to us is your mindset, your ability to connect with people and your willingness to learn and improve.

We’re looking for people who bring:

  • Ambition and drive: You’re motivated to succeed, enjoy working towards challenging goals and take pride in delivering great results.

  • A competitive mindset: You enjoy winning, hold yourself to high standards and are always looking for ways to improve.

  • Resilience and determination: You’re comfortable with rejection, stay positive when things get tough and don’t give up easily.

  • Strong people skills: You enjoy meeting new people, build rapport naturally and can have meaningful conversations with business owners from all walks of life.

  • Curiosity and commercial awareness: You ask good questions, listen carefully and want to understand what makes a business successful.

  • Coachability: You’re open to feedback, willing to challenge yourself and committed to developing your skills.

  • Ownership and self-discipline: You’re organised, proactive and comfortable managing your own time and priorities in a field-based role.

  • A genuine care for others: You understand that great sales isn’t just about closing a deal. It’s about doing what’s right for the customer and building trust that lasts.

Experience in field sales, business development, payments or financial services is an advantage, but not essential for every level. We care just as much about your potential as your experience.

You’ll also need:

  • Fluency in English.

  • A full UK driving licence and access to a car.

  • The right to work in the UK.

  • Willingness to work in a fully field-based role, travelling regularly throughout your territory.

The Perks

We believe great performance should be recognised and rewarded. Alongside the opportunity to build your career in a growing European fintech, you’ll receive:

  • £30,000–£54,000 base salary, depending on your experience and demonstrated capability.

  • Uncapped commission.

  • £800 per month car allowance (£9,600 annually), on top of your salary and commission.

  • 25 days of paid annual leave, plus UK bank holidays.

  • Bupa private healthcare and life insurance.

  • Employer pension contributions through our company pension scheme.

  • Free gym membership through Wellhub, alongside one-to-one therapy sessions, meditation and digital fitness and nutrition apps.

  • Structured onboarding, practical sales training, ongoing coaching and opportunities to grow your career at Teya.

What Happens Next?

Our recruitment process is designed to help us get to know you, understand your strengths and give you a genuine opportunity to show us what you can do.

Stage 1 - Introductory conversation (30 minutes)
A conversation with our Talent team to learn more about you, your motivation and what you’re looking for in your next role.

Stage 2 - Hiring Manager Interview (60 minutes)
An opportunity to explore your experience, how you approach challenges and what makes you successful.

Corporate Travel Consultant - Marlboro Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability

  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

raw.description:
Hello, our name is Customertimes, but you can call us CT. We are a global digital engineering, product development, and technology consulting company. Headquartered in New York, we have a team of 1000+ experts working across 65+ countries.

About this job:

The Salesforce Solution Architect is responsible for end-to-end solution design and delivery across the Salesforce platform, primarily supporting Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft-driven integrations. This role leads discovery and requirements gathering with client stakeholders, produces solution documentation, supports presales solutioning and scoping, and drives implementation teams through delivery. This is a senior, client-facing individual contributor role. No travel. Fully remote.

Location: India (Remote)

How you'll make an impact:

  • Implement and govern end-to-end solution architecture aligned to approved business outcomes, platform standards, and security/compliance requirements;
  • Lead client-facing discovery, requirements workshops, and design sessions; translate requirements into clear functional and technical designs;
  • Own solution documentation including solution design documents, architecture diagrams, data flows, integration specs, and configuration/workflow decisions;
  • Define and review Salesforce data models, security model (profiles/permission sets/sharing), automation strategy (Flows), and programmatic approach (Apex/LWC);
  • Architect Service Cloud capabilities (case management, Omni-Channel routing, knowledge, entitlements, email-to-case) and Life Sciences/Health Cloud patterns as applicable;
  • Define integration architecture and patterns across Salesforce and external systems (REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven patterns such as Platform Events and Change Data Capture);
  • Partner with MuleSoft and integration teams to design API-led connectivity, error handling, retries, and monitoring; provide architectural oversight even when not building MuleSoft flows directly;
  • Support presales solutioning and scoping, including high-level estimates, delivery approach, assumptions, risks, and implementation roadmap;
  • Provide technical leadership across onshore and offshore delivery teams through design reviews, build guidance, and quality gates;
  • Support regulated life sciences delivery needs (validation readiness, auditability, change control, and release governance);
  • Drive environment strategy, CI/CD governance, and deployment readiness (Git, SFDX, Copado/Gearset/Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions or equivalent).

What makes you a great fit:

  • 8+ years of Salesforce platform experience with 3+ years in a Solution Architect, Technical Lead, or Architecture role;
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of Salesforce platform capabilities, including data modeling, security architecture, and automation (Flows);
  • Working knowledge of programmatic development on Salesforce (Apex and Lightning Web Components) sufficient to make design tradeoffs and guide developers;
  • Experience delivering solutions across multiple Salesforce clouds, including Service Cloud and at least one Life Sciences Cloud or Health Cloud;
  • Strong experience designing integrations (APIs and event-driven patterns) and coordinating with middleware teams (MuleSoft or equivalent);
  • Experience producing and maintaining solution documentation used by technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Experience supporting Agile delivery teams and driving implementation through requirements, build, test, and release;
  • Strong client-facing skills: facilitation, clear written communication, executive-ready storytelling, and the ability to manage ambiguity without formal authority.

Required Salesforce certifications:

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator (Administrator credential);
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer (Platform Developer I credential);
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II.

If you're looking to contribute to global projects, grow your skills, shape the way you work, and be part of a connected international community — Customertimes is the place to build your next career chapter. Are you ready to spark the tech with us?

  • Design, configure, and maintain the CMDB structure, including CI classes, asset attributes, software and application records, lifecycle states, ownership fields, relationship types, business service mapping, and dependency structures.
  • Define and enforce CMDB standards for naming, classification, required fields, ownership, support groups, relationship mapping, lifecycle status, environment, criticality, and authoritative data sources.
  • Establish reconciliation processes between discovery tools, endpoint management systems, software inventory sources, procurement records, identity systems, ITSM records, ITAM repositories, and SAM records.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, stale, orphaned, incorrectly classified, or conflicting asset, software, and CI records.
  • Ensure CMDB data supports incident, request, change, problem, security, audit, vulnerability, software compliance, and service management processes.
  • Maintain CMDB governance documentation, data ownership rules, exception-handling processes, and quality metrics.

3) Discovery & Application Dependency Mapping

  • Configure and maintain discovery capabilities for endpoints, servers, network devices, virtual infrastructure, cloud resources, databases, application components, and discovered software installations.
  • Set up or support ADM and service dependency mapping by enabling discovery methods, validating discovered relationships, and coordinating with application and infrastructure owners.
  • Coordinate discovery prerequisites such as service accounts, credentials, network access, firewall allowlisting, agents, probes, collectors, and access approvals with Infrastructure and Security teams.
  • Monitor discovery coverage, credential failures, scan errors, synchronization status, relationship completeness, software recognition gaps, and unmapped or unknown assets.
  • Continuously tune discovery settings, mapping rules, software normalization logic, reconciliation logic, and dependency rules to improve CMDB accuracy, ADM coverage, and SAM visibility.

4) Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Inventory Management

  • Oversee hardware and infrastructure asset lifecycle data from request, receiving, deployment, assignment, transfer, return, decommissioning, disposal, and retirement.
  • Ensure lifecycle updates are accurately reflected in ITAM, ITSM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, and reporting platforms.
  • Reconcile purchased, deployed, discovered, retired, and disposed hardware assets across procurement records, endpoint tools, discovery platforms, and ITSM/ITAM systems.
  • Maintain accurate inventory data including owner or custodian, location, serial number, model, status, environment, support group, business purpose, warranty or support status, and related CIs or services.
  • Coordinate inventory audits, physical verification, exception handling, discrepancy investigations, disposal evidence, and asset record cleanup.

5) Software Asset Management (SAM) & License Governance

  • Establish, administer, and maintain software asset records, software models, publishers, versions, editions, categories, license records, entitlement data, subscription records, renewal dates, approved software status, and software lifecycle status within ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and ITSM platforms.
  • Reconcile discovered software installations, SaaS usage, endpoint inventory, purchase records, subscriptions, entitlements, and approved software records to support license accuracy and compliance visibility.
  • Track software assignments, usage, ownership, business justification, license position, approval status, renewal risk, retirement status, and compliance status.
  • Identify unused, underused, duplicate, unauthorized, unsupported, end-of-life, or potentially non-compliant software and coordinate remediation, reclamation, renewal, or retirement actions with the appropriate owners.
  • Support software request, approval, assignment, deployment, reclamation, renewal, retirement, and decommissioning workflows in coordination with IT Support, Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Application Owners.
  • Maintain software-related CIs and relationships in the CMDB, including links between applications, software products, users, devices, servers, business services, application owners, support groups, and dependency records.
  • Prepare dashboards and reports for software compliance, license utilization, renewal risk, unauthorized software, software lifecycle status, SaaS/application inventory, reclamation opportunities, and cost optimization opportunities.
  • Support software audits, true-ups, renewals, vendor reviews, and internal compliance reviews by providing accurate asset, entitlement, deployment, and usage data. Contract negotiation and legal interpretation remain owned by Procurement, Finance, and Legal.

6) Integrations, Automation & Reporting

  • Configure and maintain integrations between ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery platforms, endpoint management tools, procurement sources, identity systems, SaaS sources, and reporting tools.
  • Build workflows, automation rules, validation rules, notifications, exception reports, and data quality controls to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  • Create and maintain dashboards and reports for inventory health, lifecycle status, CMDB completeness, discovery coverage, ADM coverage, software compliance, license utilization, renewal exposure, aging assets, reconciliation exceptions, and audit readiness.
  • Analyze data quality metrics, discovery gaps, synchronization failures, software normalization issues, license gaps, and process issues to identify corrective actions and improvement opportunities.
  • Support automation, API, import/export, bulk update, and low-code workflow activities where appropriate and approved.

7) Stakeholder Coordination, Governance & Process Ownership

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and related ITSM configurations.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Compliance, vendors, and application teams to align asset, software, license, CI, and service data with operational, audit, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Document and improve processes for asset intake, software intake, CI creation, discovery onboarding, license record maintenance, ownership validation, dependency mapping, lifecycle updates, reclamation, and decommissioning.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT teams on asset, software, license, CMDB, discovery, and platform update requirements.
  • Support audit, compliance, risk, security, and governance activities related to hardware assets, software assets, software licensing, CMDB reliability, discovery coverage, and administrative access controls.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3-5+ years of experience in ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB administration, IT operations, systems administration, infrastructure support, software asset management, or a related technical platform administration role.
  • Hands-on administration experience with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, or asset data platforms such as Freshservice, Device42, SCCM/MECM, Intune, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience configuring asset models, software models, CI data models, fields, forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, relationships, discovery settings, synchronization rules, data imports, or system integrations.
  • Practical understanding of CMDB concepts, CI relationships, lifecycle states, service mapping, configuration management governance, and ITIL-aligned service management processes.
  • Experience with Software Asset Management processes such as software inventory, license tracking, entitlement management, software normalization, license reconciliation, usage reporting, reclamation, and compliance reporting.
  • Familiarity with common software licensing concepts such as named-user, device-based, subscription, SaaS, concurrent, enterprise agreement, server, core, processor, and usage-based licensing models.
  • Hands-on experience with discovery or inventory tools, including scan configuration, credential management, discovery troubleshooting, data normalization, software recognition, reconciliation, connector setup, or integration management.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure environments such as Windows and Linux servers, endpoints, basic networking, virtualization, cloud resources, databases, application services, and endpoint management platforms.
  • Ability to analyze data quality issues, resolve discrepancies, and establish repeatable governance, reconciliation, exception-management, and audit-readiness processes.
  • Understanding of administrative access controls, change management, credential security, least-privilege access, and separation-of-duties expectations for ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and discovery platforms.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, dashboarding, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical teams, non-technical stakeholders, vendors, auditors, procurement, finance, legal, security, and compliance partners.

Preferred

  • Direct administrator experience with Freshservice and/or Device42, including ITAM, SAM or software inventory, CMDB, discovery, integrations, dashboards, or ADM/service dependency mapping.
  • Experience implementing, rebuilding, or significantly improving ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, or ITSM modules from scratch.
  • Experience with Application Dependency Mapping, service mapping, business service modeling, or infrastructure dependency validation.
  • Experience with software compliance audits, license true-ups, renewal support, vendor audit preparation, SaaS inventory, software rationalization, or cost optimization initiatives.
  • Experience with SAM or license management tools such as ServiceNow SAM, Device42 software inventory, Lansweeper, or equivalent platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise software licensing and administration data for platforms such as Microsoft 365, Adobe, Autodesk, Oracle, VMware/Broadcom, Atlassian, Salesforce, Zoom, or similar vendors.
  • Experience with API-based integrations, webhooks, data imports, automation scripts, SQL or reporting queries, PowerShell, Python, or low-code workflow automation.
  • Experience supporting IT audit, SOX or compliance requirements, ISO 27001, security operations, vulnerability management, change management, or software compliance use cases that rely on accurate asset, license, and CMDB data.
  • ITIL Foundation, ITIL 4 Specialist, Certified Hardware Asset Management Professional (CHAMP), Certified Software Asset Manager (CSAM), ServiceNow CIS, Freshservice certification, Device42 training or certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with Power BI, advanced Excel reporting, Freshservice analytics, Device42 reporting, or similar reporting and analytics tools.
