raw.description:
Overview

The Senior Fraud Strategist is responsible for developing, testing, and optimizing fraud strategies, policies, rules, thresholds, treatment paths, and decision logic within assigned onboarding and monitoring workflows in RealPage’s payments ecosystem. This role will focus on development of policies and rules across new account onboarding, tenant payments, vendor payments, owner draws, funding instrument verifications, limit management, transaction monitoring, and payer anomalies. The successful candidate will take part in building RealPage’s next generation of fraud controls. This is a hands-on strategy role for someone who can independently identify the right data, write and troubleshoot SQL, connect fraud signals across systems, and translate analysis into practical decisions. They will test hypotheses, quantify fraud exposure and customer impact, evaluate strategy performance, and recommend policies, rules, thresholds, and controls that reduce fraud while protecting the customer experience and enabling business growth.

Responsibilities

Fraud Strategy, Policy & Controls

  • Responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of fraud risk policies, strategies, rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, and control documentation across onboarding and monitoring workflows.
  • Develop data-backed recommendations for auto-approval criteria, manual-review routing, payment holds, restrictions, limit treatments, step-up verification, account monitoring, and escalation thresholds.
  • Document strategy rationale, rule logic, data sources, expected impact, monitoring plans, policy considerations, change history, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Design and optimize controls for payment fraud, onboarding risk, account takeover, business email compromise, counterparty fraud, tenant payment fraud, synthetic identity, first-party misuse, bust-out behavior, stolen payment instruments, refund or dispute abuse, and emerging typologies.
  • Monitor launched strategies and recommend tuning on an ongoing basis.

Analytics, Data Science & Rule Performance

  • Independently source, query, and analyze data using SQL to validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives and false negatives, and evaluate loss exposure, operational impact, and customer friction.
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries using multi-table joins, aggregations, date windows, common table expressions, window functions, and segmentation logic to investigate fraud patterns and measure strategy performance.
  • Apply analytical and data science methods to support feature exploration, cohort analysis, segmentation, model output evaluation, threshold setting, experimentation, champion/challenger comparisons, back-testing, and post-launch performance monitoring.
  • Partner with Risk Data Science & Analytics to translate dashboards, models, features, risk scores, and analytical insights into practical fraud decision strategies and operational controls; assess and provide feedback on whether those outputs are effective for fraud strategy use cases, with guidance on complex cases.

Operational Feedback & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with Onboarding Risk Operations and Risk Monitoring Operations to incorporate case outcomes, queue trends, investigator feedback, alert quality, and operational pain points into strategy improvements.
  • Review themes from Trust and Safety escalations to identify control gaps, recurring fraud signals, product or process vulnerabilities, or policy needs requiring durable remediation.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payment Operations, Compliance/AML, Legal, and Operational Excellence on tooling, workflow, data availability, rule implementation, and control monitoring.
  • Provide concise updates on fraud trends, strategy performance, emerging risks, rule effectiveness, false positive impact, and recommended actions to fraud leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Share fraud findings and trends with fraud operations, monitoring, and escalation teams to inform how case learnings translate into policies, rules, thresholds, or monitoring improvements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of full-time experience in fraud strategy, fraud analytics, payments risk, data science, financial crime, risk operations strategy, or a related technical risk function.
  • Advanced, hands-on SQL experience is mandatory. Candidates must be able to independently write, troubleshoot, and explain SQL queries used to source data, validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives, and evaluate rule or control performance; dashboard-only experience is not sufficient for this role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or optimizing fraud rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, controls, or monitoring strategies based on independently sourced and analyzed data.
  • Exposure to data science, statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, Python/R, feature development, segmentation, or analytical methods used in fraud or risk decisioning.
  • Experience working with fraud operations, risk analytics, data science, product, engineering, compliance, or payment operations stakeholders.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

Required:

  • Advanced analytical curiosity and ability to connect fraud signals across disconnected tools, imperfect data, evolving processes, and multiple product or payment workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate independently sourced data findings into clear fraud strategy recommendations, rule changes, threshold adjustments, control improvements, monitoring plans, and policy considerations.
  • Strong working knowledge of fraud typologies such as synthetic identity, first-party misuse, counterparty fraud, business email compromise, onboarding fraud, stolen payment instruments, tenant payment fraud, account takeover, refund or dispute abuse, or bust-out behavior.
  • Ability to evaluate fraud strategies using metrics such as loss exposure, fraud capture, precision, false positives, customer friction, queue impact, and post-launch performance trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize technical findings for fraud, product, operations, data science, and leadership audiences.
  • High ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance fraud mitigation with customer experience, operational capacity, compliance considerations, and business growth.
  • Preferred experience with property management, rent payments, real estate technology, B2B payments, vendor payments, bill pay, embedded payments, merchant acquiring, fraud platforms, payment processor portals, device/identity signals, or decisioning platforms such as Oscilar.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must have the ability to operate a personal computer and express or exchange ideas by means of the spoken word. May be required to sit and/or stand for long periods of time. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. May be required to lift or move 10+ pounds.

SALARY AND BENEFITS RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.
Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $94,700.00 - USD $161,300.00 /Yr.

Overview

The Finance Manager is the senior finance partner to CES regional and operational leadership. The role converts financial and operational data into decisions that improve revenue quality, gross margin, operating expense discipline, and EBIT. It leads the financial cadence for an assigned portfolio of clients, programs, and sites, while directing the work of Operations Analysts and coordinating with Workforce Management, Accounting, Pricing, Commercial, and other enabling teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Financial Leadership

  • Own the regional financial narrative through EBIT, including actuals, forecast, budget, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Lead financial performance reviews with regional, site, and program leaders, focusing discussion on business drivers and decisions.
  • Translate operating performance into financial outcomes across revenue, labor, delivery costs, gross margin, operating expense, and EBIT.
  • Maintain a balanced portfolio view and prioritize finance support according to revenue, complexity, margin risk, client commitments, and strategic importance

Planning, Forecasting, and Decision Support

  • Lead the regional annual plan, rolling forecast, long-range outlook, and scenario analysis in partnership with operating leaders
  • Challenge assumptions using operational drivers, historical performance, contractual economics, pipeline changes, inflation, foreign exchange, and site-level cost dynamics.
  • Ensure risks and opportunities have quantified financial impact, accountable owners, specific actions, and expected realization dates.

Client and Commercial Finance

  • Partner with Commercial, Pricing, and Operations on renewals, scope changes, minimum commitments, and margin improvement opportunities.
  • Escalate structural issues in pricing, contractual terms, billing mechanics, or delivery design that could prevent achievement of financial commitments.

Team Leadership and Governance

  • Set priorities, allocate portfolios, coach, and review the work of assigned Operations Analysts; maintain backup coverage for critical programs and billing cycles.
  • Establish consistent standards for forecasts, variance explanations, management reporting, invoicing controls, data quality, and stakeholder follow-through.
  • Coordinate with Workforce Management to ensure staffing, productivity, scheduling, and capacity inputs are timely and financially coherent.
  • Partner with Accounting on close quality, accruals, revenue recognition inputs, cost classification, reconciliations, and resolution of recurring data issues.
  • Maintain documented approvals for invoicing, journal-entry support, forecast changes, and financially significant assumptions.

AI, Automation, and Data Enablement

  • Sponsor standardized, scalable reporting and analysis across the regional portfolio; eliminate lowvalue manual work where controls can be preserved or improved.
  • Partner with the Automation Analyst to prioritize use cases, define requirements, validate outputs, and measure adoption and realized value.

  • Strong planning, forecasting, scenario modeling, business case, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Experience in BPO, contact center, outsourced services, or another labor-intensive service environment strongly preferred.

About the role...

Our Audit team are on the lookout for keen and ambitious newly qualified Auditors CA (SA) / Audit Sem-Seniors to come and join the team as we enter our next phase of growth.

There has never been a better time to join us! So, if you have a passion for what you do, keen to get stuck in the mix, keep learning and strive to be the best you, then we want to hear from you.

About the team…

Our award-winning Audit team cover various specialities:

  • Big Business - focus on larger and more complex clients. Covering a wide range from private equity backed businesses to AIM listed businesses as well as others who report under the IFRS
  • Private business - A broad, multi-industry client base; we service more privately-owned firms in the Midlands than anyone else
  • Tech & High Growth – fast scaling tech companies, these are growing companies who face many challenges and complexities

About the day to day…

You'll be working with varied clients and as a newly qualified Auditor / Audit Semi-Senior, you’ll be getting stuck into a diverse range of tasks and responsibilities, including;

  • Work as part of a team to meet deadlines and contribute to help the team as a whole to meet its objectives and ensure client demands are exceeded
  • Manage a number of priorities to deliver high quality results
  • Proactively follow up on review points raised by the manager and completing them in a timely manner
  • Plan and organise effectively to ensure all client work is carried out within the appropriate timescales set by the manager and providing regular updates to the manager without being prompted
  • Provide technical expertise to ensure audit procedures performed are conducted to correct standard and accounts preparation is accurate
  • Be confident to seek guidance and support from colleagues and managers when required
  • Have the ability to problem solve to clear audit issues and be flexible to meet manager and client expectations
  • Manage your feedback and development, seek support from your line manager, and be open and honest

The role will also be designed to help you grow and develop through your career journey. With access to a wide range of knowledge to help push yourself further - from Managers to Partners, the team are always happy to support you.

About you...

At Cooper Parry, we’re in it together. All we ask of our people is that they play all in. The Engineering Manager leads a team of software engineers building Harbor’s next-generation compliance platform. This is a player-coach role: you will ship code, build proofs of concept, and review code in the details, while owning predictable delivery, service reliability, and team growth. You will translate product priorities into executable technical plans, guide architecture and AI-assisted workflows, and develop a mature, high-ownership team. The work includes a massive agentic orchestration layer and an evergreen data problem, and it will reach tens of thousands of organizations from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Ship code. Build proofs of concept, contribute to the codebase, and review code in the details alongside your team.
  • Drive delivery of team commitments by planning, scoping, and unblocking work, giving engineers ownership and trusting them to run with it.
  • Coach, mentor, and manage engineers through regular feedback, clear expectations, and performance management, including lifting up struggling performers and managing out when needed.
  • Hire and develop high-caliber engineers, and create growth paths for internal talent.
  • Shape how the team builds with AI, including agentic coding tools and harnesses, and drive adoption across your team.
  • Own the reliability and quality of your team’s systems, including incident response and postmortems.

raw.excerpt: OverviewCPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team.
raw.description:
Overview

CPI Card Group is seeking a Cloud Engineer with a DevSecOps focus and hands-on experience in Amazon Web Services (AWS), AWS Security Services, infrastructure automation, to join the Infrastructure Cloud Engineering team. This role implements, automates, and operates secure, resilient infrastructure capabilities across a hybrid environment that includes on-premises environments, AWS Infrastructure as a Service, and relevant SaaS integrations.

The position strengthens the Cloud Engineering organization with a focus on AWS Cloud Security, and associated security services, infrastructure delivery pipelines, threat-detection integration, vulnerability and configuration remediation, data-protection controls, incident response, and compliance-control implementation. The engineer contributes to reusable infrastructure patterns, standards, guardrails, and automated controls that integrate security throughout the platform engineering and CloudOps lifecycle.

Working closely with Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, and other technology teams, this role translates security and compliance requirements into implementable infrastructure capabilities. This role is accountable for incorporating AWS Cloud Security controls within the scope of Infrastructure Cloud Engineering and associated infrastructure cloud platforms. Enterprise cybersecurity architecture, security policy, and cyber-risk governance remain with Cybersecurity.

Responsibilities

  • AWS infrastructure security: Engineer and operate security capabilities supporting multi-account AWS environments, including logging, configuration compliance, threat detection, vulnerability visibility, network protection, encryption, and data protection. This work leverages AWS-native services such as AWS CloudTrail, AWS Config, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, AWS Security Hub, AWS Shield Advanced, and AWS KMS.
  • Infrastructure as Code and automated controls: Develop and maintain Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, scripts, modules, policies, and automated workflows that provision secure infrastructures and platforms while continuously validating required security controls.
  • Secure delivery pipelines: Implement and improve infrastructure delivery pipelines, including security testing, policy checks, approval controls, separation-of-duties requirements, artifact integrity, and controlled promotion across environments.
  • Secure infrastructure patterns and standards: Implement and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure patterns across AWS and hybrid integrations using approved architectures, standards, and guardrails.
  • Threat, vulnerability, and risk reduction: Automate the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation of infrastructure vulnerabilities, insecure configurations, and control gaps. Provide technical evidence and remediation support for risk-management activities.
  • Hybrid infrastructure protection: Integrate security controls across on-premises environments, AWS infrastructure, and relevant SaaS services. Support network segmentation, security groups, firewall integration, DDoS-resilient designs, secure connectivity, and infrastructure protection patterns.
  • Security monitoring and response: Improve infrastructure telemetry, alerting, and operational response through AWS and enterprise monitoring platforms. Participate in security and infrastructure incidents, root-cause analysis, containment, recovery, and corrective-action automation.
  • Compliance implementation and evidence: Partner with Cybersecurity to translate PCI DSS and other applicable control requirements into technical controls, validation methods, documentation, and repeatable audit evidence. CloudOps and platform operations: Monitor infrastructure health, security posture, reliability, and control effectiveness. Participate in lifecycle management, change management, problem management, operational readiness, and the team's 7x24 on-call rotation.
  • Collaboration and documentation: Contribute to design reviews, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing. Communicate options, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical, non-technical, and leadership audiences.
  • Continuous improvement: Evaluate relevant AWS services and industry practices, pilot improvements within approved guardrails, and reduce manual work through safe, measurable automation.

Qualifications

  • Builds for operations: Designs infrastructure with day-two operations in mind. Monitoring, alerting, patching, backup, and recovery are part of "done," not added later.
  • Builds security in: Treats security controls as engineering requirements that are coded, tested, and validated in the pipeline, not as reviews applied after deployment.
  • Automates first: Prefers code over console changes. Spots repeated manual work and turns it into automation that is versioned, reviewed, and repeatable.
  • Troubleshoots across layers: Diagnoses issues that span AWS, networking, identity, on-premises systems, and SaaS integrations. Uses logs, metrics, and security findings to find the root cause, not just the symptom.
  • Works with operational discipline: Follows change management and approved standards. Leaves systems and runbooks in a state another engineer can support during an on-call event.
  • Respects ownership boundaries: Understands what Cloud Engineering owns and what belongs to Cybersecurity and Technology Governance, Risk and Compliance, and knows how to engage those teams effectively.
  • Exercises risk-aware judgment: Recognizes when a design, request, or shortcut creates unacceptable risk. Raises it with evidence and a recommended option, explained in plain terms for engineers, auditors, and leaders.
  • Keeps learning: Keeps AWS, security, and automation skills current and applies what they learn to improve team patterns and practices.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or comparable professional experience.
  • Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, cloud security engineering, or comparable technical roles.
  • Hands-on experience deploying, securing, and operating AWS infrastructure in production or regulated hybrid environments.
  • Experience implementing or improving security controls within production cloud or hybrid infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, with experience developing reusable modules, automated testing, policy validation, and controlled deployment practices.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms and source control, such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS-native delivery services.
  • Strong scripting or software automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or a comparable language.
  • Experience with multi-account AWS environments, identity and access controls, logging and monitoring, configuration compliance, vulnerability management, encryption, data protection, and network security.
  • Experience participating in infrastructure or security incident response, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action implementation.
  • Working knowledge of regulated-industry security and compliance practices. Experience with PCI DSS is preferred.

Preferred Certification and Qualification Paths:

Candidates may demonstrate readiness through one or more of the following paths. AWS certifications are preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered: Preferred path: An equivalent combination of AWS architecture, operations, security, automation, and production engineering experience aligned to the following certifications: AWS Certified Security – Specialty AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or AWS Certified CloudOps Engineer – Associate

Additional desired qualifications: AWS certifications or equivalent experience aligned to: AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional AWS Certified AI Practitioner

raw.description:
Information Technology Strategies, Inc. (IT-Strat) is seeking an AI/ML Application Developer to support the Defense Agencies Initiative (DAI) program This is a hands-on technical position responsible for designing, developing, and delivering artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities directly within the Oracle E-Business Suite 12.2.x financial management environment hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

Summary:

Client Agency is Defense Logistics Agency. Design and deliver the AI/ML Functional and Technical Use Cases document, covering OCI-native AI service implementation for financial reporting automation, user experience optimization, and operational efficiency gains across the DAI ERP environment. Develop the AI/ML and DevSecOps Transition Roadmap laying out the phased approach for embedding AI capabilities into the DAI program and transitioning Agile processes from contractor to government ownership. Implement production-grade AI/ML capabilities using OCI-native services including OCI Data Science, OCI Language, and OCI Vision, with consideration for AWS GovCloud AI services where applicable per government direction. Build and integrate REST API connections between AI/ML models and Oracle EBS business processes, enabling automated decision support within financial workflows without requiring manual data extraction. Apply natural language processing techniques to financial document processing, including audit report analysis, accounting narrative classification, and automated ATM documentation generation from source content. Design and apply cognitive science approaches to improve AI readiness and human decision-making support within the DAI user community, focusing on how financial professionals interact with AI-augmented ERP processes. Lead research and development efforts in training design, competency modeling, and cognitive metrics as they apply to AI adoption within a federal financial management environment. Develop cognitive performance metrics that measure how effectively DAI users adopt AI-assisted workflows, providing quantifiable evidence of AI value delivery for program reporting. Apply knowledge discovery and data mining techniques to unstructured DAI operational data, identifying patterns that inform both audit remediation strategies and future automation priorities. Participate fully in Program Increment planning, iteration planning, daily standups, and iteration reviews as an active member of the Agile Release Train. Author well-formed user stories with precise acceptance criteria for AI/ML features, working with the Product Owner to prioritize backlog items against program objectives and technical dependencies. Deliver working AI/ML capabilities within two-week iteration cycles, demonstrating functional outputs at each iteration review rather than theoretical progress. Identify and remove technical impediments to AI adoption across the program, escalating architecture or infrastructure blockers to the Software Systems Engineer Lead for resolution. Work directly with the Software Systems Engineer Lead (L1) to align AI/ML architecture decisions with the broader DAI systems architecture and OCI infrastructure design. Contribute technical content to the Final Transition Plan and Knowledge Transfer Materials, ensuring incoming personnel can sustain AI/ML capabilities after the contract period. Support the DevSecOps Engineer and DevOps Engineers in integrating AI model deployment into the CI/CD pipeline on DLA-approved DevSecOps platforms.

Requirements:

  • Eligibility to obtain a U.S. Government SECRET / TOP SECRET Clearance. (Basic Federal Clearance requirements are U.S. Citizenship, clear criminal history check, no recent or pending bankruptcies)
  • Five (5) years minimum experience in AI/ML development applied to enterprise software systems.
  • Must have experience Oracle Cloud Infrastructure AI and data science services, or equivalent major cloud provider AI platform experience with ability to transition to OCI.
  • Demonstrated experience with artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, knowledge discovery, and data mining applied to real operational datasets.
  • Proficiency in Java, C/C++, or Python with production-level code in at least one of these languages.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: natural language processing, text understanding, classification, pattern recognition, recommendation systems, targeting systems, or ranking systems.
  • REST API design and implementation for integrating ML models into enterprise application workflows.
  • End-to-end ML lifecycle experience from data preparation through model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring in a production environment.
  • Experience with unstructured data analytics and text-based information extraction from enterprise document repositories.
  • Agile or SAFe development experience with demonstrated ability to deliver working software within time-boxed iterations.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Agile OCI AI Foundations or OCI Data Science Professional certification, demonstrating platform-specific knowledge on the environment where DAI operates.
  • AWS GovCloud experience with SageMaker, Bedrock, or equivalent managed AI services, providing versatility across the cloud platforms the government has approved for this program.
  • Working knowledge of DoD AI Ethics Principles and OMB AI governance guidance, which prevents building capabilities that stall in policy review.
  • NLP experience specifically applied to financial or accounting documents, including transaction narrative classification, posting rule extraction, or audit finding analysis.
  • Prior experience on DAI, GFEBS, LMP, or another DoD ERP financial system, eliminating weeks of program context onboarding.
  • SAFe 5 or 6 certification at Practitioner level or above, reflecting formal Agile methodology training rather than claimed team exposure.
  • Experience producing federal government deliverables under a QASP performance-based contract structure.

Work With Us

IT-Strat is a technology consulting company that holds various contract vehicles including best in class vehicles. IT-Strat has supported multiple clients including the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE via both prime and meaningful subcontracts). Additionally, IT-Strat has prime contracts with Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA), Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) and many others. We maintain relationships with multiple large businesses.

IT-Strat was established in 2002. We are a certified Woman Owned Small Business. IT-Strat also successfully graduated as an SBA 8(A) company. It was an 8(a) company from 2008 through 2017 and currently still has 8(a) contract vehicles.

Benefits We Offer:

  • Four Medical/Vision options including an HSA plan
  • Dental and Orthodontia plan
  • Vision Materials plan
  • Paid Life, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability
  • 401K Retirement Program with company contribution
  • Paid Vacation, Holidays, Sick Leave, Floating Holidays, Bereavement Leave
  • Semi-monthly pay cycle

raw.description:
Why RTI

RTI International is an independent, scientific research institute dedicated to improving the human condition. Our vision is to address the world's most critical problems with technical and science-based solutions in pursuit of a better future. Clients rely on us to answer questions that demand an objective and multidisciplinary approach—one that integrates expertise across social, statistical, data, and laboratory sciences, engineering, and other technical disciplines to solve the world’s most challenging problems.

We believe in the promise of science and technical solutions, and we push ourselves every day to deliver on that promise for the good of people, communities, and businesses in the US and around the world. If you are looking for the opportunity to make a real difference, RTI is the place for you.

About the Hiring Group

RTI’s Center for Data Interoperability is seeking dynamic and detail-orientated candidates for a full-time Programmer/Analyst with Python or SQL analytic programming experience. The Programmer/Analyst will work with researcher teams to analyze and synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative administrative health data from multiple sources into meaningful results. Individuals in this role will provide analytic development and statistical programming knowledge to project teams conducting research using healthcare data, especially large and complex health insurance claims and survey data, in a fast-paced environment.

This position is based in Research Triangle Park, NC or any other U.S. location as a telecommuter.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

Approximately 85% of working time will require:

  • Developing coding expertise and best practices to query, merge, and analyze complex healthcare data from large relational databases
  • Leveraging a variety of quantitative methods to standardize, blend, and distill data from multiple disparate sources, transforming them into analytic insights for use in client reports, journal manuscripts, abstracts, or posters for professional meetings
  • Iteratively developing and maintaining Python code while adopting best practices for increasing efficiency, minimizing computational errors, implementing process improvements, and other approaches that add value to business processes and analytic results
  • Participating in thorough code review and documentation, as well as parallel coding efforts for other programmers to maintain quality standards and ensure that code may be efficiently transferred among team members as needed
  • Constructing analytic datasets and databases to support deliverables for various public health and healthcare financing engagements
  • Collaborating with project team members to review, critically evaluate, and refine business requirements, and then translate those requirements into programming logic
  • Adopting and refining technical skills on projects, including working independently, proactively resolving day-to-day issues of small complexity, and leveraging coding best practices and standards

Approximately 15% of working time will require:

  • Participating in continuing education courses on healthcare-related and/or technical coding topics (including learning new coding languages) as applicable to the role and evolving business needs
  • Sharing insights gained from the above activities with fellow programmers, leaders, and other division staff through activities such as presentations at staff meetings, contributions to collective codebase utilities, and training early career staff

What You'll Need

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS/BA or advanced degree in data science, computer science, statistics, social sciences, health policy or related field with at least 3 years of programming experience OR the equivalent combination of education and experience. An equivalent combination of education and experience is defined as a Master’s degree in the same areas mentioned above and at least 1 year of relevant experience
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience with Python or SQL analytical coding with demonstrated familiarity with the linkage of various types of data files
  • Programming experience using data stored in relational databases such as Teradata, Snowflake, DB2, Oracle, and SQL Server
  • Experience designing and implementing flexible, reusable, scalable, programming code
  • Commitment to analytic programming quality and best practices, including experience with QA/QC procedures (e.g., peer review of code, parallel programming)
  • Familiarity with all phases of the Analytic Development Life Cycle and demonstrated experience in working with at least 1 of these phases
  • Organizational and planning skills that enable independent work while contributing to a team effort
  • Analytic thinker with exceptional attention to quality and detail
  • Good interpersonal skills, including written and oral English-language skills, the ability to effectively manage competing deadlines, and the ability to work independently on a day-to-day basis while regularly collaborating with project teams
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, have lived in the United States for at least 3 of the last 5 years, and should not require now, or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status

Preferred Qualifications:

  • At least 1 year of experience using SAS for analytic programming
  • Demonstrated understanding of relational database management concepts
  • Healthcare industry experience, analytic experience in work with the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and/or knowledge of healthcare terminology and taxonomy/classification systems (e.g., ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)
  • Programming experience within CMS data systems such as the Integrated Data Repository (IDRC), Chronic Conditions Warehouse (CCW), or Centralized Data Repository (CDR)

About the role:

Responsibilities:

raw.title: Senior Product Designer, Administration
raw.excerpt: OverviewWorking at AtlassianAtlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two.
raw.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Atlassian Administration is the control centre for every organisation running on Atlassian's System of Work. Admins use it to set up their organisation, get the right people onto the right apps, keep their data secure and compliant, and grow their Atlassian investment over time.

As Atlassian becomes AI-first, Administration is changing from a place where admins dig for information into one that tells them what to act on, explains how and why, and acts on their behalf. It's built on trusted data, flexible org structures and visibility into everything connected to a customer's Atlassian portfolio, and powered by Rovo and agents. The result is enterprise-grade governance with far less effort.

Your Future Team

You'll join Admin Experience, the team behind the operating system for Atlassian admins. Admins use it to set up and manage their organisation, get people onto the right apps, and grow their Atlassian investment over time. Our vision is an Atlassian Admin that tells admins what to act on, advises them on how and why, and acts on their behalf. To get there, we're rebuilding trusted foundations: accurate license data, reliable org structure through Units, and visibility into what's connected to a customer's Atlassian portfolio. At the same time we're launching AI-powered experiences such as Rovo in Admin Hub and a reimagined Overview. You'll be part of a small, high-conviction design team working on problems at enterprise scale, for some of the world's largest and most regulated organisations.

Responsibilities

What you will do

  • Design the high-stakes foundation every Atlassian customer runs on. Every organisation depends on Administration to set up, secure and scale how it works, one decision can affect every user, app and site. Admin actions are often irreversible and hard to see, so you’ll make changes clear, safe and auditable at the scale of the world’s largest, most regulated enterprises.

  • Own whole admin journeys, not just screens. Define complete journeys end to end — setting up an organisation, structuring it with Units, managing licences, governing connected apps, including the edge cases, errors and bulk actions that only show up at scale.

  • Shape AI-powered administration. Help turn Administration from a place where admins dig for answers into one that tells them what to act on, explains how and why, and acts on their behalf through Rovo and agents, designing the transparency, controls and governance that make admins comfortable trusting AI.

  • Make Administration feel like one product. Many teams build admin experiences; you’ll create the patterns, information architecture and Admin UI Kit components that make them feel consistent and cohesive for admins.

  • Turn trust into a design outcome and champion admins. Partner with Engineering and Data so licence counts, user activity and connected-app data are accurate and easy to understand. Represent IT admins, security teams and org owners, learning from customer calls, escalations and usage data, and measuring your work against leading enterprise admin tools.

What your day to day looks like

  • Designing end-to-end admin experiences for complex, data-heavy and permission-sensitive workflows, such as licensing, org hierarchies, identity and access, and app governance.

  • Designing AI-native and agentic experiences, including recommendations, approvals, audit trails and rollback, that earn the trust enterprise admins need.

  • Building functional, AI-enabled prototypes to explore options, de-risk complex flows and test ideas with customers.

  • Contributing patterns to the Admin UI Kit and the Atlassian Design System so the admin experience stays cohesive across contributing teams.

  • Partnering with your PM and Engineering partners to define goals, reduce ambiguity and own outcomes as priorities change.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Qualifications

What You Bring

We'd love to see a portfolio that demonstrates:

  • Enterprise and admin SaaS experience. 5+ years of product design experience with complex B2B, SaaS or enterprise software, including time spent on administration, settings or other data-heavy, permission-sensitive surfaces.

  • Strong craft in visual and interaction design. A high level of craft across interaction design, information architecture and visual design, backed by strong systems thinking and experience contributing to design systems.

  • Excellent prototyping. Strong prototyping skills that show behaviour, options and trade-offs, not just screens, to de-risk complex flows and test ideas with customers.

  • End-to-end problem solver, grounded in evidence. Experience owning end-to-end UX, solving complex problems with clear, practical solutions, running generative and evaluative research, and measuring success through qualitative and quantitative methods.

  • A great team player. Clear, evidence-based communication, the ability to influence cross-functional partners and stakeholders, and sound judgement balancing customer needs with business goals and technical feasibility.

What sets you apart

  • Deep enterprise admin domain knowledge. Hands-on familiarity with concepts like SSO/SCIM, licensing, org hierarchies, and OAuth and API governance, you understand how large organisations are actually run and secured.

  • Proven AI-native and agentic design. Recent, hands-on experience designing AI-powered features, workflows or agentic tooling, including the recommendations, approvals, audit trails and rollback that earn enterprise trust.

  • Prototyping in code. Comfort building functional prototypes in code to bring behaviour and trade-offs to life for partners and customers.

  • Scale and regulation. A track record designing for some of the largest, most regulated enterprises, where edge cases, bulk actions and auditability are the norm, and comfort collaborating across time zones.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

Partner with the best

raw.title: Senior Director, Demand Generation Marketing
raw.excerpt: About Us We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact.
raw.description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is building a focused, integrated go-to-market engine to accelerate growth across our digital and performance marketing services. We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Director of Demand Generation to build and lead that effort, with a clear focus on creating qualified mid-market pipeline. You’ll partner closely with Sales, GTM Operations, Product Marketing, and our agency specialists to develop and execute integrated campaigns that reach the right buyers and turn engagement into sales opportunities.

This is a leadership role for a builder. You’ll set strategy, develop campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve results. Success requires strong and creative judgment: knowing which buyers to target, creating compelling offers, and selecting programs that convert marketing investment into qualified pipeline. You should be able to speak clearly about campaigns you personally built, why they worked, the results they generated, and how you adapted when performance fell short.

This is an opportunity to help build a new growth engine with direct exposure to senior leadership and meaningful influence over go-to-market strategy and marketing investment. You’ll have access to experienced specialists in paid media, SEO/GEO, creative, and web development, enabling you to build integrated programs that produce measurable commercial outcomes. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership, moves quickly, challenges assumptions, and knows how to turn marketing investment into qualified pipeline.

What You'll Do

Generate Qualified Mid-Market Pipeline

  • Own demand generation strategy and execution, with accountability for qualified opportunities and sales pipeline.
  • Own the demand generation program budget within agreed investment guardrails. Allocate spend across campaigns and channels, manage demand generation vendors and partners, and stop, refine, or scale programs based on qualified pipeline contribution and acquisition economics.
  • Develop campaigns targeting priority accounts, industries, and senior decision-makers.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and BDRs to coordinate marketing programs, prospecting, and follow-up.

Build a Sophisticated Email Marketing & Nurture Engine

  • Own email marketing, audience segmentation, lifecycle nurture, and marketing-led outbound campaigns.
  • Leverage HubSpot to build scalable campaigns, automated workflows, and personalized engagement.
  • Coordinate executive-branded outreach, marketing emails, and BDR/seller sequences to create a cohesive buyer experience.
  • Continuously improve email performance, deliverability, conversion, and pipeline contribution.

Orchestrate Integrated Demand Generation Campaigns

  • Translate product positioning, client stories, research, and thought leadership into integrated campaigns.
  • Coordinate across email, paid media, SEO/GEO, events, partnerships, and outbound sales activity.
  • Partner with internal specialists who execute paid media, SEO/GEO, website, and creative work.
  • Identify and test new opportunities to reach relevant buyers through targeted channels and distribution.
  • Plan and oversee execution of paid campaigns across priority channels, including LinkedIn, paid search, programmatic, and ABM tactics; use performance data to optimize targeting, creative, offers, and investment.

You do not need to be the deepest technical expert on every channel, but you must understand how they work, how to evaluate them, and how to integrate them into a cohesive growth strategy.

Drive Experimentation, Analytics & Optimization

  • Define and track KPIs focused on qualified meetings, opportunities, pipeline, and revenue contribution.
  • Analyze funnel performance, identify conversion gaps, and develop structured A/B tests.
  • Evaluate channel effectiveness and recommend changes to campaigns and investment based on results.
  • Own campaign automation, including audience segmentation, nurture workflows, email deployment, and campaign quality assurance, supported by a Demand Generation Coordinator. Partner with GTM Operations on CRM integration, lead routing, data quality, and reporting.

Strengthen Campaign Messaging & Creative Effectiveness

  • Work closely with Product Marketing and Content to translate differentiated capabilities into compelling campaigns.
  • Evaluate offers, messaging, copy, creative, and landing pages for relevance and effectiveness.
  • Provide specific feedback to improve campaign content and conversion.
  • Identify gaps in commercial content and client proof needed to support demand generation

What You Will Need

  • Proven Mid-Market + B2B pipeline generation: 8+ years of relevant demand generation experience, with demonstrated success generating qualified mid-market or enterprise pipeline for complex B2B services or solutions. Must have personally built and optimized campaigns that produced measurable sales opportunities and pipeline.
  • Industry Experience: Multiple years working at an agency or a marketing technology company
  • Deep email marketing expertise: Significant hands-on experience with email marketing, nurture, segmentation, and marketing automation. HubSpot strongly preferred.
  • Analytical discipline: Strong ability to interpret funnel data, design experiments, and optimize campaigns based on pipeline and revenue outcomes.
  • Cross-channel fluency: Hands-on experience planning, launching, and optimizing paid demand generation campaigns, including account-based marketing and channels such as paid search, LinkedIn, and programmatic. Broad understanding of how paid media integrates with SEO/GEO, content, events, and outbound sales to generate qualified pipeline.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Industry Experience: Expertise in marketing to marketers
  • Creative judgment: Ability to recognize compelling B2B messaging, challenge ineffective content, and develop campaigns that resonate with target buyers.
  • Builder mentality: Comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving environment, balancing strategic ownership with hands-on execution.

Why Join Us
You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership
  • Employee wellness programs and additional perks

Additional Information

No agencies, please.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Please note that this job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications, which may change based on business needs.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this position.

Company Overview:

Empower is a fast-growing startup that is on a mission to transform the gig economy, so that hard-working drivers can earn a sustainable living. If you want to be an integral member of a team that is disrupting Uber and cares about making a difference for gig economy workers, then we’d like to hear from you.

Role Overview:

As a Senior Customer Support Specialist (Safety), you will be responsible for supporting the customer support team, overseeing high priority escalations, and protecting our platform and customers. This role will report to the Manager of Trust and Safety, and will work closely with our customer support team.

This is a mission-critical position requiring attention to detail, fast decision-making, and empathy under pressure. You’ll be responsible for serving customers and consumers experiencing sensitive challenges.

This is a remote position from anywhere in the United States. This role requires aThursday - Monday work week and being available to timely handle issues that arise on evenings and holidays.

  • Consistently communicate with customers and consumers with empathy, clarity, and professionalism

  • Act as a resource for the broader Customer Support organization, providing guidance, coaching, and real-time support when frontline agents encounter sensitive issues

Candidate Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 5+ years of experience in customer support

  • 1+ year of experience handling safety related customer support issues

  • Familiarity with incident response, crisis management, and safety protocols

  • Detail-oriented, high-energy, driven, problem-solver with an exceptional work ethic and a desire to be part of a team disrupting the status quo

  • Polished written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience using CRM tools like Zendesk or similar platforms

What do we offer?

  • Competitive compensation: $60,000 – $80,000 base salary (based on experience) + equity + performance-based bonus + competitive benefits

  • Being part of a great team to better the lives of gig workers

POSITION SUMMARY:

Supervise a team of Finalization Specialist to achieve maximum performance and ensure compliance objectives are met in for the finalization, post-closing, and reporting processes related to Loan Modifications (“MOD”) and/or Partial Claims (“PC”). Work on various projects for the Department related to reporting, change management, compliance, quality assurance/quality control, and vendor/third party communication. Perform all duties in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable federal, state and local regulations. The target starting pay for this fully remote position is $70-$90k/yr.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Carries out Supervisor responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; monitoring performance, rewarding, and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.

• Request timeline extension variances from applicable insurer/agency as needed to ensure compliance to program requirements.

• Manage employees in such areas as workout technique, account recognition and customer service.

• Supervise the processing and completion of all MOD/PC reversal requests received.

• Troubleshoot and correct all systematic errors related to MOD/PC.

• Supervise the verification of PC amounts and posting ticket submissions to Cashiering Department

• Work with Client Relationship Managers to validate terms and secure PC Funds from prior servicers as necessary.

• Supervise and validate the closing out of terms within investor portals as necessary for FNMA and FHLMC workouts.

• Prepare reports and track results and trends within the Loss Mitigation Department.

• Oversee daily team operations; provide guidance and direction in daily workflow and volume.

• Communicates to the group the daily work goals, expectations, and any policy and/or process changes.

• Monitor employees on quality control guidelines and job performance through group training, one on one interaction and role play.

• Minimal travel supporting business operations may be required.

• Supervise the finalization of all MOD/PC workouts in LoanServ, which includes providing investor reporting summary data.

• Prepare, manage, and send Month End Reports for MOD/PC to Senior Leadership, Default and Investor Reporting Departments and Loss Mitigation Operations Management.

• Perform other projects and duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

• Knowledge of Microsoft Suite at an intermediate level preferred.

• Ability to interact with mid-level and senior management as an advisor on projects as well as be considered a business level subject matter expert (“SME”). Ability to make decisions that have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services.

• Ability to organize and prioritize work schedules of others on long-term basis.

• Ability to compute, analyze and interpret complex statistical data and/or to develop forecasts and computer models for strategic planning.

• Ability to make informal presentations, inside and/or outside the organization and speak in front of groups.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree preferred.

• Five (5) years of mortgage servicing experience.

• Four (4) plus years of loss mitigation or document recording experience required.

• Knowledge of, FHA, VA, USDA, FNMA, FHLMC and Ginnie Mae Loss Mitigation document requirements, deliverables, and timelines required.

• Two-plus years of supervisory or management experience preferred.

Our Company:

Carrington Mortgage Services is part of The Carrington Companies, which provide integrated, full-lifecycle mortgage loan servicing assistance to borrowers and investors, delivering exceptional customer care and programs that support borrowers and their homeownership experience. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: .

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
  • Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
  • Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.
  • Educational Reimbursement.
  • Carrington Charitable Foundation contributes to the community through causes that reflect the interests of Carrington Associates. For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org.

Notice to all applicants: Carrington does not do interviews or make offers via text or chat.

Job Title: Systems Analyst

Role Summary

The Systems Analyst provides expertise regarding systems development implementation, maintenance and support activities to a wide range of business and technical situations throughout the SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst is responsible for leading, planning, and analyzing complex business requirements and implementing technology enabled solutions to address multi-facetted business opportunities and challenges.

The incumbent is Accountable for executing conceptual frameworks, implementation strategies and plans for recommended changes within SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst proactively contributes toward the development of the Technology team's tactical plans in support of business initiatives and occasionally offers directional guidance to clients and other applicable audiences.

Key Accountabilities

1.Provides technical expertise and consulting services in the development and implementation of new bank delivery systems, in order to achieve and maintain a competitive edge. Mentors system developers. Conducts and delivers analysis that presents comprehensive views on business challenges. Recommends and develops application architecture for assigned business application.

2.Completes complex systems development assignments, with minimal supervision, within budget and to client expectations, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oCodes or makes modifications to programmes according to detailed business requirements and specifications, including the execution of team and operability testing.

oProvides the required documentation including software unit test strategy, plan, matrix, scripts, execution completion report, software impact analysis, back-out and recovery procedures, technical implementation procedures, computer run sheet updates, system documentation, data dictionary updates and system user guide.

oConducts feasibility studies of multi-discipline business opportunities and challenges, assuming the responsibility for the development of business proposals.

3.Delivers products and functionality that fully meets business requirements, that may include but is not limited to the following:

oEnsures compliance with established policies, standards and methodologies, e.g., project planning, security etc.

oEnsures that no outages / problems are identified during user acceptance, operability and / or stress and performance testing or product implementation.

oParticipates in post-implementation reviews as required.

4.Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of current and the future direction of financial and computer industries, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oProvides expertise in areas of speciality, e.g., become the specialist in one or more information technology disciplines, commensurate with the current state of technologies.

oForecasts future trends, anticipates problems and conditions (e.g., volumes, new developments, turnover, etc.).

oConducts highly complex evaluations for product releases, standalone products, etc.

5.Partners and collaborates with Solution Architects, Solution Designers and Application Developers as required, striving towards high success levels in implementation of solutions and ongoing support.

6.Contributes to the realization of complex solutions that capitalize on business and technology developments by monitoring industry-wide standards and the development of new vendor products for applicability to the organisation.

7.Participates in the development, maintenance and implementation of policies, standards and guidelines on all aspects of technology architecture within the Technology team.

Role Specifics – Cyber Risk

Responsible for the technical analysis, maintenance, optimization, and support of key cybersecurity and data protection platforms across the Cyber Risk Programs. The role includes:

Maintaining, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting EOS ITPM, Rubrik M365 Backup, and Digital Crown Jewel protection.

Implementing system upgrades, resolving technical and connectivity issues, analyzing logs, and optimizing platform performance and security controls.

Supporting business analysts and project teams with technical expertise and operational troubleshooting.

Analyzing system requirements, technical capabilities, integration points, and design specifications for M365 Backup/Rubrik, Project OHM, SharePoint Data Governance scanning, and Advanced Server Protection.

Supporting requirements and design deliverables, documenting technical decisions, reporting on system health and security posture, and recommending improvements to strengthen security, segmentation, backup, and data protection capabilities.

raw.description:
The role

You are the technical voice of Probabl in front of US data science teams: the person who takes a first conversation to a technical discovery, a demo on their own problem and a scoped proof of concept, alongside the sales team. Services owns technical pre-sales and delivery; you bring that field engineering expertise to the sales team on every US opportunity.

Probabl is the Tabular AI company founded by the creators of scikit-learn. Skore, our platform, builds, validates and tracks predictive models on tabular data with the methodology of the scikit-learn maintainers built in. Data science is being rewritten by agents faster than the discipline can absorb it; our job is to keep the science guarding the speed.

This is our first Solution Architect in the US. You join the Services team, Probabl's applied AI team of field engineers and solution architects, and work day to day with our US sales lead. Our pre-sales practice already runs in France, with a Solution Architect, a reference demo, a demo kit and a PoC playbook. You run it for the American market and feed back what you learn, so the whole team's practice gets better.

What you'll do

  • Run the demo.Own the reference Skore demo for the US and adapt it to a prospect's use case in days, with the demo kit, on your own.

  • Run technical discovery. With data science leads and their platform teams: current stack and tooling, how models are built and validated today, where reliability leaks, what a first project would look like.

  • Scope the PoC.Turn a qualified opportunity into one scoped question on the customer's data, with a clear go/no-go, then hand it to our field engineers to deliver.

  • Run workshops and hackathons. Hands-on sessions with a prospect's data science team on their own data, and the occasional hackathon with partners or schools: the fastest way to show what Skore does and to qualify a team.

  • Answer the hard questions. Architecture, security, deployment options (on-prem, BYOC, cloud), how Skore fits an existing stack. You bring Engineering in when needed, not by default.

  • Work the deal with Sales.Technical qualification, RFPs and evaluation workshops, alongside our US sales lead.

  • Bring the field back to Product. What US customers ask for, what blocks a deal, what wins it: written up, sized, and fed into the roadmap every week.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in data science or ML engineering, then pre-sales or solutions work for a data or AI product. You have built models in production and you have sold the idea of building them better.

  • You master tabular data work end to end, whatever the framework: scikit-learn of course, but just as much gradient boosting, PyTorch, time series and the like, with the evaluation and validation that go with them. You can read a prospect's pipeline, spot the leakage, and show them in a notebook what a sound evaluation looks like.

  • You run a room. A live demo to 20 data scientists, a whiteboard with a platform team, a discovery call with a VP: you adjust and you land the point.

  • You are comfortable with enterprise buying groups: data science, IT and security, procurement, and the economic buyer, each with their own question.

  • Based in the US, remote, with travel to customers and periodic trips to Paris.

  • Strong plus: experience with agentic or LLM-based data science tooling, and a healthy skepticism about its outputs.

  • Nice to have: Kubernetes and cloud basics, tabular and time series foundation models (TabICL and others), an open-source footprint in the Python data ecosystem.

Why Probabl

  • Credibility you don't have to build. scikit-learn is downloaded over 200 million times a month. You walk into every room with the stewards of the library behind you.

  • A category, not a feature. We are defining Tabular AI: AI on the structured business data that runs companies, with the scientific method built in. You help define what it means in the US.

  • A team that builds its playbook together.We have a first version of our demos, PoC playbook and processes, and they still have a lot of room to evolve. You use them with US customers and improve them with the rest of the team.

  • Short distance to the product. Solution Architects and field engineers sit in a weekly Product–Services sync. What you hear from customers changes the roadmap, visibly.

Practical

  • Reports to the VP Services (Paris). Day to day with our US sales lead, who is fully involved in the hiring.

  • Location: United States, remote. Preferred time zone: East Coast (to confirm). Travel to customers as needed; two to three trips a year to Paris, including onboarding.

  • Compensation:fixed + variable tied to pipeline and closed deals; band to confirm.

  • Start:as soon as possible.

  • Process, three weeks from first call to offer:

  1. 30-minute call with the VP Services.

  2. 30-minute call with our US sales lead.

  3. Practical evaluation

  4. 30-minute call with a co-founder.

  5. Offer.

About AudienceView

AudienceView is a leading event commerce platform serving over 2,100 organizations across 12 countries. The company helps live event organizations grow audiences, increase revenue, and streamline operations through an integrated ecosystem of ticketing, CRM, marketing, and commerce solutions.

With more than 20 years of industry experience, AudienceView supports performing arts organizations, sports teams, higher education institutions, festivals, and entertainment venues worldwide.

About the Role

AudienceView is expanding its engineering organization to support several strategic modernization initiatives and product refactoring projects. We are looking for experienced Quality Engineers who are passionate about automation, quality advocacy, and leveraging modern testing practices, including AI-assisted testing and development tools.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and quality of highly scalable web applications used by thousands of organizations worldwide.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks
  • Build and execute automated test suites for web applications and APIs
  • Perform manual and automation testing across functional, non-functional, exploratory, integration, and regression scenarios
  • Partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle
  • Automate API testing using tools such as Postman
  • Test mobile applications as part of the overall quality strategy
  • Support release management and quality validation activities
  • Identify defects, investigate root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues
  • Promote quality best practices across the organization
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, documentation, and quality processes

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of Quality Engineering experience, combining manual and automation testing
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver (or similar automation tools)
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and Java
  • Strong API testing experience
  • Mobile testing experience
  • SQL experience
  • Experience testing applications built with Node.js and React
  • Quality-first mindset
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

AI-Assisted Development & Testing Experience

AudienceView is actively adopting AI-powered engineering workflows. You should have practical experience using tools such as Claude Code.

We are looking for professionals who have used AI tools to support automation development, test generation, debugging, documentation, quality analysis, or engineering productivity.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Playwright or Cypress in addition to Selenium
  • Python or C# experience
  • Performance testing with JMeter
  • Cloud experience (Azure preferred)

Why Join AudienceView

AudienceView is a global leader in event commerce and ticketing technology, helping organizations create meaningful live-event experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

You'll join a team focused on innovation, modernization, AI adoption, and delivering high-quality software that powers some of the world's leading live-event organizations.
