🚀 The Vision: Building the Operating System for Product Creation

Since 2013, THE/STUDIO has been building the definitive operating system for product creation. We are combining modern SaaS technology with custom manufacturing to make producing physical goods as seamless, fast, and scalable as launching software.

We operate two core platforms: Customize Now(our best-in-class, on-demand manufacturing platform) and Source Anything (our new SaaS product that enables customers to seamlessly work with global factories beyond our own network).

We are a profitable, previously Silicon Valley-backed, fully remote company, and we are not just looking to improve manufacturing, we are looking for a visionary operator to help us truly revolutionize the global supply chain.

💻 The Role

We’re looking for a hands-on Production Team Lead to run our sourcing team day to day. You’ll own daily task management, SOP compliance and the order pipeline, so every order ships on time and the Manufacturing Manager can focus on strategy. This is a player-coach role: alongside leading the team, you’ll also handle daily sourcing rep work.

Why This Role Is Exciting:

  • Direct Access to Leadership: You will have the opportunity to work directly with our CEO and executive team, giving you high visibility, direct mentorship, and a seat at the table.

  • Product & Strategic Influence: We operate with flat hierarchies. Your daily insights from the ground level will directly shape our product roadmap, workflows, and company strategy.

  • Rapid Scale & Career Trajectory: We are growing rapidly. Joining us right now means high autonomy, minimal red tape, and massive room for personal and professional acceleration.

🎯 What You’ll Do

  • Lead and develop the team: Lead, mentor and develop a team of sourcing specialists through regular 1-on-1s, ongoing training and performance coaching.

  • Run daily operations: Make sure the team follows our SOPs for order tracking and fulfillment. Run daily audits of platform communication and flag anything that could frustrate a customer.

  • Protect on-time delivery: Monitor the global order pipeline, spot bottlenecks early and fix them right away.

  • Own escalations: Be the first point of escalation for complex order exceptions, QC failures and factory delays, and resolve them independently.

  • Manage our factory network: Evaluate our manufacturing partners and route production to reliable, high-quality suppliers.

  • Fix root causes: Analyze operational data and the root causes of delays, then design and roll out lasting process improvements.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with our global Sales, Design and Support teams to streamline communication and improve the customer experience.

💡 The Profile We’re Looking For (Our Core Pillars)

Our Founder/CEO defines our top performers by three distinct traits. If this describes how you operate, you will thrive here:

  1. Raw Intelligence & Problem-Solving: High processing power, business acumen, and logical reasoning. You can think on your feet, connect complex ideas, and break down ambiguous problems quickly.

  2. "Give a Shit" Energy (Extreme Ownership): You take 100% accountability for your domain and outcomes. You don't make excuses or blame external factors. You look inward, find solutions, and push across the finish line.

  3. Rapid Adaptation & Radical Candor: You embrace blunt, constructive feedback and pivot instantly without ego. You excel in a fast-moving environment where you need to act with urgency without waiting for hand-holding.

Requirements:

  • Experience: 3+ years of direct experience in manufacturing, supply chain management or product sourcing.

  • Leadership: Proven experience managing, training and evaluating a team, including 1-on-1s and holding people to KPIs and SOPs.

  • Problem-solving: A track record of handling order exceptions, factory delays and QC issues independently.

  • Workflows and data: Experience running operational workflows and tracking tools (order trackers, ERP systems) to deliver on time.

  • Hands-on: Comfortable being in the weeds every day: this role manages trackers and operational details, not just strategy.

  • Communication: Exceptional, professional-level English proficiency (C1/C2) with clear, concise, and articulate communication skills.

  • Independent Contractor Mindset: Highly disciplined, self-motivated, and comfortable operating as a full-time, dedicated independent contractor in a 100% remote setting.

  • Remote Infrastructure: Reliable setup including a fast computer, noise-canceling headset, and a rock-solid, stable internet connection.

Nice to Have:

  • Fluent Mandarin, to work directly with China-based sourcing staff and factory partners.

  • Hands-on process improvement experience (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma).

  • Data analysis or dashboard skills to improve visibility of metrics like on-time delivery.

💰 Compensation & Terms

  • Flexible & Competitive: We offer competitive, outcome-driven compensation packages tailored to the candidate's level of impact.

  • Engagement Type: Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

🔎 Our Hiring Process

  1. Submit Application: IMPORTANT! Please submit your resume/CV in English

  2. Initial Screening

  3. Hiring Manager Interview: Deep dive into your manufacturing experience, how you lead a team, and how you handle delays and QC issues.

  4. Assessment / Case Study: Practical demonstration of your capabilities.

  5. Final Executive Interview: Conversation with key team members. (If applicable for the role)

  6. Reference Checks: Verification of past performance with former leaders and CEOs.

Note that every role is different, so the process may vary depending on the requirements of the role. Please note that due to the volume of applications we receive, we may not be able to provide feedback to all applications.

Job Title: Medical Coder

Employment Type: Full-Time WFH
Department: Primary Care Clinic

Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Senior Medical Coder to join our primary care clinic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in coding for primary care services and a thorough understanding of medical coding guidelines and regulations. This role is pivotal in ensuring accurate and compliant coding of diagnoses, procedures, and medical services to optimize revenue and support high-quality patient care.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Medical Coding:
    Accurately code diagnoses, procedures, and services using ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS codes, ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations and guidelines.
  • Chart Review:
    Conduct thorough reviews of patient charts and medical records to verify the accuracy and completeness of coding and documentation.
  • Coding Audits:
    Perform regular coding audits to identify areas for improvement and ensure adherence to coding standards and clinic policies.
  • Documentation Support:
    Collaborate with physicians and clinical staff to clarify documentation and coding requirements. Provide guidance and training to ensure accurate and comprehensive documentation.
  • Compliance:
    Stay up-to-date with changes in coding regulations, payer requirements, and industry standards. Implement necessary adjustments to maintain compliance and optimize reimbursement.
  • Training and Mentorship:
    Mentor and train junior coders and clinical staff on coding best practices and updates. Lead internal training sessions to enhance team knowledge and skills.
  • Reporting:
    Generate and analyze coding and billing reports to monitor performance, identify trends, and support decision-making processes.

Qualifications:

  • Certification as a Certified Professional Coder (CPC), Certified Coding Specialist (CCS), or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 5 years of medical coding experience, preferably in a primary care or multi-specialty clinic setting.
  • In-depth knowledge of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding guidelines.
  • Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, and primary care procedures.
  • Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in electronic health records (EHR) systems and coding software.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

How to Apply:
Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume and cover letter to with the subject line "Senior Medical Coder Application - [Your Name]". Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

Position Summary

The Data Analyst II is a capable analytical contributor who independently designs, executes, and delivers data analysis and visualization work across RS21's client engagements. This role is designed for a practitioner who can take an analytical question from problem definition to client-ready findings without day-to-day direction, make sound methodological choices within established frameworks, and communicate results clearly to a range of audiences, technical and non-technical alike.

This person works confidently across RS21's analytical toolchain, produces high-quality reporting and dashboards, applies statistical methods appropriately, and adapts rapidly to the needs of each client context. They are able to provide constructive feedback to junior analysts, contribute to RS21's analytical documentation, and are actively deepening their expertise in the areas that will define their senior-level contribution.

This role is embedded in real client delivery and expected to take full ownership of assigned analytical workstreams. The Data Analyst II does not wait for scope to be handed down; they clarify requirements, propose analytical approaches, flag methodological risks, and keep delivery moving. They understand that the best analysis is the one that is used long after the engagement ends, and they design their work accordingly.

Critically, the Data Analyst II is developing into the kind of analyst RS21 depends on across engagements: someone who delivers accurate, timely, and persuasive analytical work, communicates with genuine client-centricity, and brings enough self-awareness to know when a question requires a methodology or domain expertise that they need to develop.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Insight Delivery

  • Independently design and execute analytical projects across multi-source datasets; manage data extraction, transformation, quality assessment, and exploratory analysis without requiring direction on approach.
  • Write clean, functional Python or R code for data analysis, automation, and reporting tasks; apply software discipline including version control, notebook documentation, and reproducibility practices.
  • Write complex SQL queries independently; optimize performance, choose appropriate query patterns by workload, and communicate query logic clearly in documentation and code review.
  • Apply statistical techniques including regression, significance testing, sampling methodology, and descriptive analysis to produce findings that are both technically sound and interpretively honest about uncertainty.
  • Independently design and publish production dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent; connect to multiple data sources, apply sound visualization and UX principles, and govern data model and access design.
  • Independently produce compelling data narratives using storytelling tools and visualization frameworks for diverse client and stakeholder audiences; adapt depth, format, and framing to the audience.

AI-Augmented Analytics

  • Use AI productivity tools independently to meaningfully accelerate research, analysis, and reporting tasks; apply sound judgment about when AI assistance improves work and when it introduces risk.
  • Apply AI-assisted data preparation and pattern detection within established analytical workflows; validate AI-generated outputs critically before incorporating them into client deliverables.
  • Stay current on emerging AI-augmented analytical tools and share relevant learnings with the analytics team; help the practice understand where these tools add genuine value.

Client and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Manage stakeholder relationships independently for assigned engagements; facilitate analytical meetings, communicate findings clearly, navigate competing interpretations, and keep stakeholders aligned on scope and timeline.
  • Produce high-quality client reports, analytical briefings, and status communications; tailor content to audience and ensure clients have the information they need to act on analytical findings.
  • Apply established data governance frameworks in client environments, including documenting ownership, lineage, and metadata, under the direction of an engagement lead.
  • Anticipate evolving client analytical needs and proactively communicate concerns about scope, data quality, or methodological limitations before they become delivery risks.

Data Quality and Documentation

  • Independently validate analytical outputs for accuracy, reproducibility, and appropriate handling of data limitations; document assumptions, caveats, and quality decisions clearly so reviewers and downstream users can trust and build on your work.
  • Maintain high-quality analytical documentation in Confluence or equivalent; structure documentation so teammates unfamiliar with an engagement can understand what was analyzed, how, and what it means.
  • Contribute to reusable analytical templates, code libraries, and accelerators that help the team move faster on common problem types.

Collaboration and Mentorship

  • Provide structured support to junior analysts through hands-on coaching, code review, documentation, and pairing; help them develop the technical and communication habits that will carry them toward independent contribution.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to ensure analytical work connects to the right data assets and model outputs; understand the full data flow well enough to design analysis around it.
  • Partner with project managers to keep analytical delivery aligned with client expectations and contractual constraints; surface scope and timeline risks early with enough context for leadership to act.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Data Science, Public Policy, or a related quantitative field.
  • 3 to 5 years of progressive experience in data analysis or business intelligence, including independent delivery of analytical projects from problem definition through client presentation.
  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one analytical language (Python or R), including libraries for data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization.
  • Advanced proficiency with Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent BI platforms; able to design, publish, and govern production dashboards independently.
  • Strong grounding in applied statistics including regression, hypothesis testing, sampling methodology, and uncertainty quantification.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders, including written reports and live presentations.
  • Experience managing stakeholder relationships and delivering analytical work independently across client engagements.

Preferred

  • Experience with geospatial analysis tools such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or Python-based spatial libraries.
  • Background in advanced analytics, program evaluation, or government data environments.
  • Familiarity with longitudinal data, panel data methods, or quasi-experimental evaluation designs.
  • Basic understanding of cloud data platforms such as AWS Redshift, Google BigQuery, or Snowflake.
  • Background in consulting or multi-client delivery environments where analytical standards and client communication expectations are high.
  • Familiarity with AI-augmented analytics tooling and responsible approaches to integrating generative AI into analytical workflows.

raw.description:
about the company

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.

A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.

At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.

Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?

Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.

Our values

  • Be a wolf, not a sheep: we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
  • Knowledge equals power: we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
  • Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy: we want work to be something you look forward to.
  • Quality results in quantity: we care about excellence and attention to detail.
  • TEAM, Together everyone achieves more: collaboration is how we get our best results.
Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

about the role

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

key responsibilities

  • Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.

  • Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.

  • Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.

  • Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.

  • Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.

  • Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

what we are looking for

Competences

  • Hosting & Security Products Knowledge: Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.

  • Supplier & Vendor Management: Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.

  • Commercial & P&L Acumen: Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.

  • Product Strategy & Roadmapping: Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.

  • Project & Programme Management: Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.

  • Data & Funnel Analytics: Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.

  • AI Proficiency: Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

How we work at Openprovider

  • Self-management: you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.

  • Learning Agility and AI Literacy: you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.

  • Adaptive Innovation Mindset: you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.

  • Quality Orientation: you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.

  • Customer Focus: you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

what we offer

  • 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);

  • Paid time off and sick leave;

  • International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;

  • Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;

  • Quarterly review and annual salary review;

  • Flexible working hours;

  • We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;

  • Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;

  • Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;

  • A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

The opportunity:

One great book can change a classroom. Your job? Make sure every educator finds it. As Marketing Manager, Corwin, you'll shape how teachers, school leaders, and districts discover Corwin's K-12 books and the professional learning services that extend their impact. You'll turn customer insight into sharp positioning and memorable campaigns across video, print, digital, and social. And you'll be Sales' go-to partner, giving sellers the tools and training to lead conversations that matter. If you're ready to see your creativity reach classrooms, we'd love to hear from you, whatever path brought you here.

What you will help achieve:

  • More educators discovering, adopting, and benefiting from Corwin books and professional learning.

  • A Corwin voice that's clear, distinctive, and built around what educators need.

  • Sellers who head into every conversation prepared and confident.

  • Smarter marketing, powered by customer insight, testing, and data.

What you will do:

  • Lead go-to-market plans for new and existing titles and priority professional learning services.

  • Sharpen positioning and messaging that set Corwin apart.

  • Create integrated campaigns across digital, print, web, email, social, and sales channels that spark interest and generate leads.

  • Design and deliver multimedia sales training that helps sellers bring Corwin to schools and districts.

  • Build sales tools and customer-facing resources that make our value easy to see.

  • Guide campaign and thought leadership content from idea to launch: accurate, on brand, on time, and on budget.

  • Use marketing automation and analytics to nurture prospects, personalize experiences, and improve results.

  • Track K-12 trends and competitors, and lead surveys, focus groups, and customer feedback programs.

  • Run regular business reviews that align Sales, Editorial, and Marketing on what's working and what's next.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years in marketing management and sales enablement, in education, publishing, or beyond.

  • Experience running integrated campaigns across email, online, advertising, and other channels.

  • Sharp writing and copyediting skills, plus creativity across video, print, digital, and social.

  • Confidence presenting to and training colleagues, partners, and customers.

  • Comfort turning data, research, and customer insight into decisions.

  • Strong project management skills, including budgets, deadlines, and vendor, freelance, or partner relationships.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) and a knack for managing your own priorities.

Helpful, but not essential:

  • Experience in K-12 education, educational publishing, or professional learning.

  • Familiarity with marketing automation, A/B testing, or experimentation.

  • A bachelor's degree in marketing or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A personal or professional connection to education.

Work and travel:

Expect occasional travel for team gatherings, conferences, events, and time with authors and customers.

Why join Sage?

  • Work with colleagues who care about education, evidence, and helping ideas reach the people who need them.

  • Contribute in a collaborative, international organization with room to learn, grow, and shape how we work.

  • Access a comprehensive benefits package.

An inclusive opportunity

We know that strong candidates do not always meet every preferred qualification. If this role interests you and you can demonstrate many of the capabilities described, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience, different career paths, and the perspectives people bring from varied backgrounds and communities.

Sage is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the process, please let the Talent Acquisition team know.

Sage is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs.

How to apply:

Ready to help great ideas reach more classrooms? Apply through Sage Careers and share a resume that highlights the experience and results you're most proud of. Not sure you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We'd love to learn what you'd bring.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with SAGE covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.

Impartner is a global leader in Partner Relationship Management, and we're on the lookout for visionary, growth-driven leaders to join us on this exciting journey to build with us! As the #1 player in our industry, we’re outpacing the competition and leading the way forward. We're not just winning—we’re thriving and having fun along the way!

About the role

Impartner is seeking a results-driven and detail-oriented Accounting Manager, Revenue to lead our financial operations related to revenue accounting. This role is critical for ensuring the accuracy and integrity of our financial records, particularly concerning revenue recognition, deferred revenue, and accounts receivable. As the Accounting Manager, you will collaborate cross-functionally, drive process improvements, and provide strategic financial insights that support business growth and decision-making.

What you'll do

  • Manage GL Close Process: Lead and ensure timely, accurate month-end close processes, specifically focusing on key accounts such as revenue, deferred revenue, accounts receivable, and sales tax.
  • Policy and Process Improvement: Develop, implement, and continuously improve formal processes and policies related to bookings, invoicing, and collections.
  • Systems Enhancement: Collaborate with the Controller and accounting team to optimize accounting IT systems for billing and collections, ensuring smooth operations and accurate data flow.
  • Audit Support: Prepare and deliver required reporting for the annual external audit, ensuring compliance with accounting standards.
  • Tax Compliance: Manage compliance and analysis for Federal, State, Corporate, Sales & Use, VAT taxes, as well as R&D tax credits.
  • Accounts Receivable and Payables: Oversee the AR process, including credit and collections, and manage AP approvals and incentive payouts.
  • US GAAP Expertise: Conduct research on US GAAP and apply accounting best practices (e.g., ASC 606 on Revenue Recognition) to enhance financial operations.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3+ years in accounting and/or finance, with a focus on SaaS or software industries.
  • Proven experience as an Accounting Manager, Supervisor, or Finance Manager, with a proactive, hands-on approach to problem-solving.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Excel and Word; familiarity with PowerPoint is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of revenue accounting standards (ASC 606), and experience with deferred revenue, sales tax, property tax, 1099’s, and accounts receivable.
  • Able to handle large datasets while maintaining high accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Previous experience working in the B2B software/SaaS industry.
  • Previous exposure to process automation and financial systems integration.
  • Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to work cross-functionally and partner with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Able to meet deadlines and adapt to a rapidly changing environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Demonstrates a commitment to personal and professional development, with a "grit" mindset open to feedback and growth.

We are Boosta, a holding tech company that creates, develops, and invests in digital businesses with global potential. Today, we collaborate with over 800 specialists from different parts of the world, and millions of users use our products and services.

What we expect from you:

  • SEO Expertise & Technical Proficiency: Experience managing multiple websites across different GEOs and independently handling SEO for assigned markets and keyword groups. Strong command of technical SEO, site audits, competitor analysis, keyword research, and organic growth opportunities across Tier-1 and other priority GEO markets.

raw.excerpt: About Us Chess. com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.
raw.description:
About Us

Chess.com is one of the largest gaming sites in the world and the #1 platform for playing, learning, and enjoying chess.

We are a team of 600+ fully remote people in 60+ countries working hard to serve the global chess community. We are here to support 250M+ chess players worldwide with the best possible product, content, and tools to serve the community!

We are a tech company. A gaming company. A content company. And we do it all with passion and commitment to the game. Above all we prize our mission-driven, flat, life-celebrating, no-corporate culture, and we look forward to meeting you and learning more about what you can bring to the team.

About The Role

The Cloud Engineer role is critical to scaling Chess.com's infrastructure to support millions of daily chess games and serve global users. This position combines site reliability engineering expertise with cloud infrastructure management, directly impacting system performance, reliability, and scalability across Chess.com's multi-regional distributed architecture. The role requires deep technical expertise in both infrastructure automation and application optimization to maintain Chess.com's position as a high-traffic gaming platform while enabling rapid feature development and deployment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Architect and optimize cloud-native infrastructure using Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps tools to support millions of concurrent chess games across multiple global regions
  • Lead performance optimization initiatives by analyzing Golang and TypeScript codebases to identify and resolve bottlenecks at scale, with specific focus on chess programming optimizations
  • Design and implement multi-regional resilient systems capable of handling extreme scale challenges including managing 1 million+ CPUs across dozens of regions
  • Run and evolve our private Kubernetes cloud on bare-metal: a Rancher-managed fleet in our own datacenters that carries compute and IO intensive workloads, operated as one platform with GKE regions, with workloads placed wherever they get the best cost and performance.
  • Execute incident response and operational excellence serving as primary technical resource for critical infrastructure issues, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal downtime
  • Develop high-performance integration patterns for distributed systems handling extensive data volumes while maintaining reliability and scalability targets
  • Collaborate with development teams to implement cloud service integration best practices and optimize application deployment architectures
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code practices using Terraform to manage all cloud resources, ensuring consistent, automated, and scalable deployment processes
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with GitOps approaches using tools like ArgoCD to enable rapid, reliable software delivery
  • Monitor and enhance system observability through implementation of modern monitoring stacks including Prometheus, Mimir, ES, Vector and Tempo

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience managing large-scale, cloud-native distributed systems with proven ability to handle high-traffic production environments
  • Expert-level proficiency with Kubernetes including cluster deployment, management, and advanced orchestration patterns
  • Advanced Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform for managing complex cloud and Kubernetes resources in production
  • Strong programming skills in Golang with demonstrated ability to optimize high-performance services and troubleshoot complex codebases
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems design including failure modes, architectural principles, and data modeling strategies
  • Extensive experience with major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) including advanced services, networking, and cost optimization
  • Proficiency with GitOps and CI/CD methodologies using modern deployment automation and continuous integration practices
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools including metrics, logging, and distributed tracing systems for high-scale environments
  • Strong Linux systems administration skills with deep knowledge of system internals and performance optimization
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills for working effectively in globally distributed teams

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • Chess programming and optimization experience including bit-level manipulations and performance tuning for gaming applications
  • TypeScript development experience for full-stack infrastructure and tooling development
  • Service mesh implementation experience particularly in hybrid multi-cloud and bare-metal environments
  • Message broker expertise with systems like Kafka, PubSub, and Redis for event-driven architectures
  • Gaming industry experience with understanding of real-time systems and high-concurrency requirements
  • Experience with Google Cloud partnerships and direct collaboration with cloud provider engineering teams
  • C/C++ programming experience for low-level system optimizations
  • Advanced networking knowledge for multi-regional infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity
  • Experience managing bare-metal infrastructure and integrating with cloud-native services
  • Database performance optimization experience with large-scale data systems and indexing strategies

About the Opportunity

  • This is a full-time opportunity
  • We are 100% remote (work from anywhere!)

raw.title: Trustee (Volunteer)
raw.excerpt: Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK.
raw.description:
Here at Youth4Youth, we have grown a strong, tight-knit community of individuals who are passionate about making a difference and improving the lives of young people across the UK. Our growing team of volunteers all contribute, significantly, to the impact that we have as a charity on our direct beneficiaries, regardless of the department that they work in of the level of time that they are able to commit. Our servicesprimarily offer a peer-support network to young people right across the UK, allowing them to access a peer mentor who is of a similar age to them and somebody that they feel more comfortable speaking with.

If successful, you will be joining a growing team of diverse, but likeminded individuals, collaborating to increase the reach of the Charity and improve support provisions available to young people. All of our volunteers and employees are remote workers,but that doesn't stop us keeping in touch and maintaining a strong positive culture amongst our whole team.

About the role

Youth4Youth is seeking new Trustees for its Board as it continues to grow its impact at a national level. As a Trustee, you will have a unique and exciting opportunity to shape the future of the charity, whilst ensuring that we are governed effectively. We are Looking to appoint 4 - 5 new Trustees to our Board, and we are particularly interested in hearing from you if you have experience in the following areas:

  • Safeguarding, particularly in digital spaces

  • Fundraising

  • Commercial Development / Growth

As a youth focussed charity, we are committed to ensuring that Youth Voice is at the heart of every decision that we make. Alongside those experienced in the above areas, we are seeking individuals aged 25 and under to represent their peers on our Board, ensuring that Youth Voice is heard at every level.

If you would like to have an informal chat with the Chair of the Board prior to submitting an application, please reach out to .

Responsibilities and commitment

As a Trustee, we would ask that you are able to commit approximately 2 - 4 hours per month of your time. This may include:

  • Attending monthly Board connect meetings, hosted remotely (1 Hour)

  • Attending quarterly Board meetings (1.5 hours)

  • Attendance at any relevant committees, role specific

  • Attending an annual Development Day (1 full day)

Due to the make-up of our Board, all scheduled meetings fall outside of standard working hours, usually falling in evenings and weekends. This is subject to change based on the majority preferences of the Board.

As a Trustee, we would expect you to:

  • Challenge the status quo, leveraging your expertise to support the ongoing development and growth of a rapidly changing, but much needed charitable organisation.

  • Ensure that the Charity is governed correctly, in line with its governing document and charity law.

  • Support the development of future strategies which will enable further growth, and create sustainable, long-lasting impact.

  • Get involved as a volunteer, as required and in line with your availability, to support the CEO and other members of the organisation.

You will be joining a well established Board of Trustees who are all driven to create meaningful impact for young people across the UK. Our current Board of Trustees is chaired by the founder of Youth4Youth, Josh Towers, and is made up of an additional 5 Trustees. There is also an additional, newly formed, Commercial Trading Subsidiary Board (Y4Y Trading Ltd), chaired by a long-standing Trustee, Barney Harrison.

Supporting the organisation operationally is our CEO, Richard Nuttall and Operations Manager, Dora Botta. The remainder of a team is a mix of a very small paid team, but the organisation is primarily supported by volunteers.

Our mission is to continue to grow towards becoming one of the best charities in the UK. Our aim is to do this by building a diverse team, rich with different backgrounds and perspectives. Therefore, even if you feel you only are a 75% match, we would still love to hear from you. Skills can be learned, but diversity cannot.

Benefits of volunteering with Youth4Youth

We recognise that you will be joining us and giving your time as an 'in-kind' donation, but there must be benefits for you too. When joining our team, you will be open to the following benefits:

  • Professional and personal development opportunities in a variety of skill areas through volunteering in real roles. This may be general development or tailored to your specific needs or ambitions

  • Becoming a member of a strong network of likeminded individuals, spread across the UK, who you can connect with and collaborate with both within and outside of the Charity

  • Access to bespoke discounts, specifically designed for non-profit workers and Youth4Youth volunteers

  • Opportunities to truly shape the future of the Charity, having a direct influence over the impact that Youth4Youth has on its direct beneficiaries

The hiring process

Our hiring process typically has two stages

  1. Video or Written Application (when applicable)

  2. Interview with the Volunteering Coordinator for that role

Some roles will have extra stages but we’ll let you know as early as possible if so.

Please let us know if you require any accommodations for the interview process, and we’ll do our best to assist.

About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

Go Fish Digital is building a focused, integrated go-to-market engine to accelerate growth across our digital and performance marketing services. We’re looking for a detail-oriented Demand Generation Coordinator to support campaign execution and the marketing operations that drive qualified mid-market pipeline. This hands-on role combines campaign delivery, HubSpot administration, list management, content distribution, and foundational reporting.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Demand Generation, you’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Sales, and GTM Operations to turn campaign plans into accurate, timely execution. You’ll also collaborate with specialists across paid media, SEO/GEO, creative, and web development to help campaigns reach the right buyers and run reliably from launch through follow-up. This role suits someone eager to build practical skills in demand generation, marketing automation, and campaign analysis while helping build a more effective growth engine.

What You'll Do

Execute Campaigns and Email Programs

  • Build, test, schedule, and deploy marketing emails in HubSpot using approved messaging and campaign plans.
  • Configure campaign assets, forms, landing pages, and tracking links using established templates and processes.
  • Perform pre-launch checks on links, formatting, personalization, audience selection, suppression lists, and tracking.
  • Support coordinated marketing, BDR, and seller outreach through timely campaign setup and audience preparation.

Support Marketing Operations and Automation

  • Build and maintain campaign workflows, nurture sequences, and enrollment rules under the direction of the Senior Director of Demand Generation.
  • Maintain consistent campaign naming, asset organization, documentation, and tracking practices.
  • Monitor workflow execution and campaign handoffs, investigate routine issues, and escalate problems promptly.
  • Partner with GTM Operations on data quality, lead routing checks, and troubleshooting. Support established CRM processes and coordinate changes to integrations or system architecture with GTM Operations.

Manage Lists and Audience Segmentation

  • Prepare, clean, import, and segment contact and account lists based on campaign criteria.
  • Maintain contact properties, deduplication, subscription preferences, and suppression lists using established processes.
  • Check audience fit against agreed company, industry, geography, and buyer criteria before campaign launch.
  • Help monitor email bounces, unsubscribes, and other deliverability signals and flag issues for review.

Distribute Content and Coordinate Delivery

  • Publish and distribute approved content through email, website tools, social channels, and other campaign touchpoints.
  • Adapt approved assets to channel templates and coordinate with Content and agency specialists on required updates.
  • Maintain the campaign calendar, track deadlines and dependencies, and follow up on outstanding deliverables.
  • Support webinar and event execution, including registration pages, reminders, attendee lists, and follow-up campaigns.

Maintain Reporting and Improve Execution

  • Maintain basic campaign reports covering delivery, engagement, conversions, and downstream outcomes using established dashboards.
  • Check tracking and data completeness and surface gaps that affect reporting.
  • Support A/B tests by configuring approved variants, checking setup, and compiling results.
  • Identify ways to improve campaign accuracy, repeatability, and turnaround time.

What You Will Need

  • Relevant experience: 1–3 years of experience in marketing coordination, campaign execution, email marketing, or marketing operations, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Marketing platform skills: Hands-on experience building emails, managing lists, or supporting workflows in HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform.
  • Attention to detail: Able to catch errors in audience selection, data, links, copy, and campaign setup before launch.
  • Organization and follow-through: Able to manage multiple deadlines, maintain clear documentation, and communicate blockers early.
  • Data skills: Comfortable using spreadsheets to clean lists, organize information, and summarize basic campaign results.
  • Learning mindset: Curious about how campaigns and systems work, receptive to feedback, and eager to develop marketing operations skills.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Experience with HubSpot workflows, forms, landing pages, campaign reporting, and Salesforce-connected processes.
  • Familiarity with B2B demand generation, lead lifecycle stages, email deliverability, and contact subscription management.
  • Experience building and implementing measurement, testing, and attribution methodologies
  • Experience supporting content distribution, webinars, or coordinated sales and marketing campaigns.

Why Join Us
You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership
  • Employee wellness programs and additional perks

Additional Information

No agencies, please.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Please note that this job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications, which may change based on business needs.

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation

raw.excerpt: Role SummaryRevamp is seeking an Engineering Project Manager to lead engineering delivery for EPC clients building utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects.
raw.description:
Role Summary

Revamp is seeking an Engineering Project Manager to lead engineering delivery for EPC clients building utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects. Every project you manage brings more clean power to the grid, and your leadership determines how smoothly it moves from design to construction. You will run several projects at once with full ownership of their outcomes, and clients and our engineering teams will rely on you for clear direction on scope and next steps. You will bring our civil, electrical, structural, and power systems engineers together around a shared plan and earn client confidence through sound judgment and transparent communication.

You will join a mission-driven team accelerating the energy transition, where collaboration and trust shape how we work with clients and with each other. As an employee-owner, you will share directly in the success of the firm and the projects you help deliver.

Duties & Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Own project scopes, schedules, and budgets from kickoff through closeout.
  • Manage multiple smaller projects or several complex projects simultaneously.
  • Coordinate and manage internal discipline teams and external subconsultants to ensure timely and accurate deliverables.
  • Prepare, track, and submit monthly project invoicing.
  • Monitor project performance and proactively identify and resolve risks, scope changes, and schedule impacts.
  • Ensure projects comply with client requirements, contractual obligations, and Revamp quality standards.
  • Prepare and review project scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans.
  • Review complete project documents for conformity, quality assurance, and contractual compliance.
  • Apply standard project management procedures and criteria with independent judgment.

Client & Stakeholder Coordinations

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients on assigned projects.
  • Lead and participate in project meetings with clients, internal teams, and subcontractors.
  • Present project status, risks, and key issues clearly and confidently to stakeholders.
  • Review client standards, best practices, and project-specific requirements and ensure alignment across teams.
  • Assist with proposal development, including scope definition, budgeting, and scheduling inputs.

Collaboration & Team Support

  • Assign tasks to and direct discipline team members to complete project assignments.
  • Plan and coordinate detailed aspects of engineering work in collaboration with technical leads.
  • Provide mentoring and guidance to less experienced project and engineering staff.
  • Support a collaborative, accountable, and transparent project team environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting project deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, or a closely related field or an associate’s degree in a related field plus substantial relevant industry experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years of project management experience in an engineering consulting environment, renewable energy, or similar industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing project scopes, schedules, budgets, and invoicing.
  • Ability to independently evaluate, select, and apply standard project management procedures.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to identify, analyze, and solve complex project issues.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects.
  • Detail-oriented with a high standard for accuracy and quality.

Preferred

  • Substantial experience in renewable energy engineering, development, or construction environments.
  • Familiarity with the renewable energy project development lifecycle.
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and subconsultants.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions

  • Participation in Revamp’s Employee Ownership ESOP program
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier employee-owned engineering design firm dedicated to advancing large-scale renewable energy projects. Our team is united by a shared commitment to accelerating the global energy transition and creating a workplace where talented people can make a tangible impact in the fight against climate change.

As employee-owners, we take pride in building a culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability where every individual’s contribution drives both company success and personal growth. Revamp engineers have supported the design of more than 10% of the utility-scale solar generation capacity in the us since 2020, contributing directly to the renewable energy transformation.

So much more than just an engineering firm; we are a diverse, international team of immigrants, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, travelers and problem-solvers who bring curiosity and creativity to everything we do. For more information, visit www.revamp-eng.com

Disclaimers

Employment with Revamp Engineering Inc. may be subject to background checks that are permitted by applicable law and relevant to the position. Any such checks will be conducted in compliance with all legal requirements, including providing notice, obtaining consent where required, and allowing candidates to access and correct personal information as permitted by law.

Revamp Engineering Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We value diversity and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Revamp Engineering Inc. is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you require an accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us.

It compares the information you submit (your resume or CV and your answers to application questions) against criteria our recruiting team sets for the role. The feature does not reject or advance candidates; all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team and hiring managers. For more information or to request a reasonable accommodation, contact talent @ revamp‑eng.com. Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together.   • Strong understanding of information technology and multiple platforms, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly (LAN/WAN, web design, network security, and Audio/Visual technology)
  • Experience working with various levels of customer leadership teams, from Managers to Directors to C-Level Executives
  • Previous experience with government or parliamentary procedure is a plus
  • Proficient with MS Office product suites · Experience using Salesforce.com is a plus, but not required
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, closing, organizational, time management, and teamwork skills
  • Self-motivated and driven to succeed; takes initiative, willing to go the extra mile
  • Ability to problem solve quickly
  • Ability to multi-task and work within a team atmosphere
  • Clear sense of integrity, work ethic, and a sincere interest in building strong relationships that are founded on trust
  • Entrepreneurial spirit

Pay Range

USD $110,000.00 - USD $150,000.00 /Yr.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.

  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.

The Impact

  • We are proud to serve dynamic organizations around the globe that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place — quite literally. We have so many powerful success stories that illustrate how our solutions are impacting the world. See more of our impact here.

The Benefits

At Granicus, we offer a comprehensive and flexible benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance—starting from day one. Here’s what you can expect as a U.S.-based team member:

Flexibility & Balance

  • Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to rest, recharge, and live your life.
  • Company-Wide Wellbeing Days – Paid days off to unplug and focus on your mental health.

Health & Wellness
  • Multiple Health Plan Options – Including a 100% employer-paid plan.
  • Employer HSA Contributions – When enrolled in a High-Deductible Health Plan.
  • Fitness Reimbursement Program – Stay active, your way.

Family & Future
  • Paid Parental Leave – For both birthing and non-birthing parents.
  • Traditional & Roth 401(k) – With a generous company match.
  • Life & AD&D Insurance – 100% employer-paid coverage for peace of mind.
Growth & Recognition
  • Online Learning Platforms – Fuel your professional development.
  • Competitive Salary & Bonuses – Your contributions are valued and rewarded.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Granicus is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified applicants and employees will be considered for employment and advancement without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, age, genetic information, sexual or affectional orientation, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, familial status, military or veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

Overview

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the United States.

This position is responsible for leading the development, delivery, and evolution of digital capabilities within the Commercial Banking platform. The role works across multiple product domains, partnering with business stakeholders, technology teams, and product peers to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver scalable solutions that support business objectives and enhance user experiences. This position serves as a key liaison between business needs and technology execution, ensuring solutions align with enterprise standards, platform strategy, and customer expectations.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Platform Leadership

  • Develop and execute product strategies aligned with organizational and platform goals.
  • Define and communicate product vision, roadmap, and priorities for capabilities within the Commercial Banking platform.
  • Identify opportunities to improve platform experiences, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.
  • Balance competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups and product domains.

Product Development and Requirements Management

  • Translate business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner closely with Agile delivery teams to clarify requirements, answer questions, and support solution development throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Ensure solutions are designed with scalability, usability, and long-term platform sustainability in mind.
  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and analysts to refine features and deliver high-quality outcomes.

Cross-Domain Collaboration and Experience Design

  • Partner with product managers, business stakeholders, and technology teams across Commercial Banking domains to understand evolving needs and identify intersections with Administration capabilities.
  • Evaluate impacts of upstream and downstream product changes to ensure a cohesive end-to-end user experience.
  • Help design and shape administrative workflows and experiences that support business users and platform customers.

About Bowery Valuation

Bowery Valuation is redefining the commercial real estate appraisal industry through technology, data, and exceptional talent. As one of the fastest-growing appraisal firms in the country, Bowery combines cutting-edge valuation technology with a national team of expert appraisers to deliver a better experience for clients and employees alike. Bowery writes appraisal reports that assess the value of commercial properties - such as hotels and apartment complexes - for hundreds of active clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking an AR Lead to run an accounts receivable clean up and help improve our accounts receivable process, DSO, and outstanding balance. You will join our lean, collaborative accounting team, working directly to the Accounting Manager, and work closely with the accounting, business development, and appraisal teams to ensure invoices are paid accurately and on time.

This is not a light-touch collections role. As a transactional, B2B business with hundreds of active clients and widely varied payment processes, our AR cycle is a complex, multi-step process that requires diligence, organization, and consistent follow-through. We are looking for someone who wants to help with this function with a high degree of ownership — and who treats the AR balance as their number for those clients which have been assigned to them.

You will also work with our technology system to automate portions of client reach-outs, helping shape and streamline the collections workflow.

Note: This is a remote role for a U.S.-based independent contractor.

Hours & Compensation

  • Estimated 10–20 hours per week.
  • Compensation: $40–60 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Ongoing contract with no fixed end date. We are looking for someone to partner with for the long term.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end accounts receivable cycle for assigned clients, with a primary focus on client outreach and collections.
  • Proactively research and identify the appropriate point of contact within client organizations for each invoice.
  • Communicate professionally, clearly, and collaboratively with clients via email to resolve outstanding payments.
  • Collaborate closely with the Accounting Manager, business development team, and appraisers to clarify invoice details and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor the overall AR balance and drive it down through consistent, organized follow-up.
  • Manage a high volume of client accounts and follow-ups with diligence and attention to detail.
  • Support payment application and reconciliation as needed.
  • Use our upcoming automation system for client reach-outs, and help streamline AR workflows as new tools are rolled out.
  • Flag recurring issues or patterns in payment delays to leadership.
  • Take on additional accounting tasks over time as the role evolves.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience owning accounts receivable end to end in a B2B, transactional business (rather than a subscription-based model).
  • An ownership mindset: you want to run this function, not just work a queue, and you bring the diligence a complex collections process requires.
  • Accounting background or degree is a strong plus.
  • Experience with an ERP or accounting software (NetSuite is a plus, not required).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate professionally yet naturally with clients.
  • Highly organized, personable, and collaborative working style.
  • Comfortable working core hours aligned with U.S. Eastern Time.
  • Based in the United States and authorized to work as an independent contractor.
  • Genuine interest in AR/collections work.

Overview

As a Product Manager II, you'll drive two connected areas at the center of how enablement and marketing teams create the materials that guide human and AI sellers.

The Pages platform. You'll own Seismic's dynamic webpage-building platform, the foundation behind Pages, Plays, and Digital Sales Rooms. This is detailed, craft-heavy product work. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with UX design and Engineering on the decisions that make a page building and consumption great: layout, composition, re-usable components, and templates. You'll obsess over the details of the authoring experience, from the editing canvas to brand controls, while exploring how AI can make it dramatically easier to create polished, personalized experiences. And you'll tackle the unique challenge of enterprise sales enablement: giving teams creative freedom while ensuring everything they build is on-brand, governed, and easy to scale.

AI content creation. You'll create AI solutions that help marketers and enablers quickly and dynamically produce engaging enablement materials across formats, through a unified flow that speeds generation and makes it easy to deploy and optimize enablement for the field. That content will appear first in Seismic, but it also forms a trusted content layer that informs agents and agentic experiences within Seismic and everywhere sales teams work. And you'll close the loop: figuring out how to use AI, adoption data and context to help page creators improve their content based on what's working on the ground.

The most compelling part of this role is the intersection of three disciplines:

  • Creative tooling: making sophisticated design and content creation feel effortless.
  • Interaction design: obsessing over the small details that make an editor intuitive, fast, and enjoyable.
  • Enterprise workflows: adapting those capabilities to the needs of sales and marketing teams, including governance, reuse, personalization, and scale.

All of it incorporates the latest AI practices to simplify workflows and help creators accelerate, without losing control.

At Seismic, PMs operate as the general managers of their areas. You won't be handed a backlog of feature requests. You'll dig into customer problems, make the call on what to build, and own the results: adoption, retention, and the outcomes our customers see.

Who you are:

  • 3+ years of product management experience building user-facing products (B2B or B2C), including taking one or more key features to market successfully.
  • Strong specification and delivery skills. You write clear specs with the right level of detail, make sound tradeoff decisions with your team, and know when to escalate.
  • Design sensibility. You can assess a user experience, give specific and constructive feedback, and work comfortably with designers on layout, interaction, and visual detail.
  • Fluency with data. You can define instrumentation, analyze results, and use what you learn to set realistic goals and recommend next steps.
  • Technical curiosity. You can have productive conversations with engineers about front-end architecture, LLMs, and data, and you're eager to go deeper.
  • An AI-forward way of working. You use AI regularly to work faster and better, whether that's synthesizing research, prototyping, drafting specs, or analyzing data, and you can share specific recent examples.
  • Clear communication. You bring engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer success along with you, and keep your manager and stakeholders well informed.
  • Comfort working with distributed teams across time zones, including occasional early or late meetings.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Bonus points

  • You've shipped AI-powered features and know what it takes to make them reliable.
  • You've worked on a page builder, website builder, CMS, design tool, or other no-code creation product, or a product with theming and brand-customization requirements.
  • You've worked on enablement, sales, marketing, or content-management software.

Why This Role

  • A category being rewritten. AI is changing how content gets made and how enablement teams work, and you'll help define what comes next.
  • Ownership that's real. You'll drive a key product area with the accountability and room to grow that come with it.
  • Real scale from day one. Your work will reach enablement teams, marketers, and sellers at some of the world's best-known brands.
  • A team that builds with AI, not just for it. We use agentic tools in our own work and expect you to as well.

What you'll be doing:

  • Own outcomes, not output. Set clear goals and success metrics tied to adoption, retention, and customer results. Follow through after launch, report honestly on what happened, and recommend the next step.
  • Own the Pages platform roadmap that powers key Seismic Pages, Plays, Digital Sales Rooms, and other native content types: critical user-experience infrastructure for the whole product.
  • Create AI solutions that empower creators. Help users quickly and dynamically build engaging enablement materials across formats to guide human and AI sellers, delivering a trusted content layer for agents inside Seismic and wherever sales teams work.
  • Love the problem. Talk with enablement leaders, marketers, and sellers regularly. Run discovery with design and research, and test prototypes early, so you're confident a solution is valuable, usable, viable, and feasible before the team builds it.
  • Set the quality bar for AI. Define evals and quality standards that make AI-generated content accurate, on-brand, and trustworthy, and use them to decide when something is ready to ship.
  • Ship in small, measurable increments. Make smart tradeoffs between speed and quality, triage issues, and make the call on launch readiness.

What we have for you:
