Sinch is pioneering the way the world communicates. More than 150,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, PayPal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch’s Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.

At Sinch we “Dream Big”, “Win Together”, “Keep it simple”, and “Make it Happen”. These values are our foundation!

About the role

Sinch is building a Customer Success organisation for its enterprise customers across EMEA. As a CSM, you’ll be the strategic adviser for our most important and complex customers. These are large, multi-channel, multi-country relationships where the stakes are high and the conversations happen at executive level.
You’ll make sure these customers get measurable value from Sinch, see risk before it becomes churn, and bring new ideas to the table. You’ll work as a pair with the Account Manager on each account, supported by our global Onboarding and Customer Excellence teams and Sales Engineering.

Key Responsibilities

  • Be the strategic adviser for a portfolio of accounts, accountable for their health, adoption and retention.
  • Build and maintain relationships with customer executives, owning the conversation about value and outcomes alongside the Account Manager’s commercial relationship.
  • Lead innovation sessions and strategic workshops. Use the customer’s goals and usage data to show where Sinch can do more, with Sales Engineering and Account Manager turning the outcomes into solutions and opportunities.
  • Build success plans with each customer and run executive business reviews that show measurable impact.
  • Monitor health in depth (usage, traffic, quality, support and commercial signals), spot risk early, and lead the response, including complex escalations involving global teams.
  • Coordinate Onboarding, Customer Excellence, Support, Sales Engineering and Product so your customers experience one Sinch.
  • Bring structured, evidence-based customer insight back to Product.
  • Use AI and automation to go deeper on your accounts (research, preparation, risk signals) and share what works with the team.
  • Help raise the team’s practice by sharing your playbooks and coaching colleagues who are new to Customer Success.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in Customer Success, account management or technical account management, including several years owning a small number of large, complex enterprise customers
  • A track record of retaining and growing high-value accounts. You can walk us through an account you saved or transformed.
  • Confidence with executives: you’ve run executive business reviews and strategy workshops with C-level and VP-level customer stakeholders, and they asked you back
  • Strong facilitation and storytelling skills: you can turn data into a clear point of view and lead a room
  • Comfort with technology: you understand how customers integrate and use API- or platform-based products, can read usage data to spot risk and opportunity, and hold credible conversations with customer engineering teams, knowing when to bring in Sales Engineering
  • Experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder, multi-country accounts across a matrix organisation
  • Curiosity about AI, with real examples of how you’ve used it in your work
  • Experience with Salesforce and a CS platform (Gainsight or similar)
  • University degree preferred, or equivalent professional experience
  • Willingness to travel regularly across UK&I

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.

At Sinch, we value learning, embrace change, and offer opportunities for personal and professional growth. Unfortunately, we are not supporting relocation at this time.

Applicants must:

• Hold a British citizenship.

• Have a valid British work permit.

About our hiring process
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: . No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

The annual base salary for this position ranges from £29,000 to £44,000, plus a variable compensation component to be determined. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications.

raw.excerpt: OverviewWorking at AtlassianAtlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two.
raw.description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

Your future team

The Atlassian Advisory Services team is a globally distributed team of Atlassian experts who are passionate about creating customer success. Advisory Services team members engage with our largest strategic and enterprise organisations with some of the most complex business challenges to help them deliver delightful solutions to their users. We provide customer teams with trusted advisors to help orchestrate successful outcomes, providing the highest benefits from their Atlassian investment. At Atlassian, you'll have an impact on millions of users, fast! We don't just want to know your opinions, we want to see your ideas in action. We hire great people and then trust them to be great.

We're hiring a Principal Consultant - Agile Scale, with an Enterprise Strategy and Planning focus, and strong AI expertise, to join our Advisory Services Delivery team as an individual contributor - this is not a managerial role. Atlassian Principal Consultant / Enterprise Architectsare experts in Atlassian products, practices, and solutions, delivering guidance to drive value realisation for clients that have purchased Advisory Services from Atlassian. Each member of the team is accomplished at delivering performant strategic technical guidance at scale, aligning product capabilities with business needs and desired outcomes.

You will help our strongest promoters showcase successes to their peers, and serve as the tip of the spear in growing the reach of our technologies for new use cases and markets. Our aim is to help customers unleash the potential of their teams and get the most out of their Atlassian investment.

What you'll do:

  • Collaborate with your peers in Advisory Services to align on strategic outcomes that deliver exceptional service to our customers

  • Partner with customers to help solve their business challenges and achieve their internal goals through Atlassian products, practices, and solutions

  • Identify and promote opportunities for service and product expansion within a client’s organization

  • Cultivate deep industry and solution expertise, staying up-to-date with evolving best practices that support different types of teams

  • Lead complex customer engagements using a System of Work approach, drawing upon your expertise in two or more Atlassian solution areas

  • Drive global internal initiatives that positively influence our Advisory Services business and partner organizations across Atlassian

  • Delegate effectively to the Solution Consultants on your team, while maintaining ownership of client outcomes

  • Develop comprehensive and innovative technical solution content, and provide tailored enablement that enhances our team's ability to drive customer success and meaningful outcomes

  • Reach into all parts of Atlassian to influence and facilitate a deeper level of engagement, advocacy, and innovation for our largest enterprise customers

  • Spend up to 30% of your time traveling domestically, and in some cases internationally, for both internal and customer-facing events

Qualifications

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Your background:

  • 8-12 years of experience within SaaS companies

  • 8+ years of experience in customer-facing roles where you've engaged with and influenced customer stakeholders that range from technical administrators to executive leadership

  • Demonstrated expertise in Enterprise Agility, including

    • Direct experience contributing and developing enterprise-wide Agile adoption strategies, providing solutions to customer business challenges, while having in-depth knowledge of client organizational objectives

    • Hands-on experience planning and executing the rollout of large-scale enterprise planning tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Rally), customizing solutions to integrate with client systems while ensuring alignment to client organizational objectives

    • Experience in developing tailored enablement programs, leveraging relevant certifications to empower client teams with Agile expertise, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement

    • Proven track record for building relationships and influence with senior management, both with clients as well as internally

  • Demonstrated expertise in Artificial Intelligence, including

    • Familiarity with Atlassian’s Rovo platform, and ways in which Agents are implemented and deployed

    • Background in large language models (LLMs) for generative content, prompt engineering, and chat-mediated interactions

    • Proven ability to design proof-of-concept solutions to address common business challenges for Enterprise customers, particularly in the Enterprise Strategy and Planning space

  • Demonstrated expertise in Atlassian's System of Work, including

    • Mastery in identifying customer business challenges and uncovering key requirements

    • Extensive experience designing and advising customers at scale on comprehensive solutions that span products, services, practices, and platforms to support better teamwork and collaboration

  • Experience with Rovo, Agentic AI, MCP, and/or other AI integrations

  • You're fluent in English, and nice to have a second language relevant to the SEA market.

It’s nice if you are:

  • Comfortable coaching best practices and tailoring curated guidance for stakeholders to facilitate those practices

  • Experienced working on cross-team projects, engaging with Sales, Product, Support, and other teams

  • Experienced working with large customers in a consulting or technical expert capacity

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

raw.description:
About the position:

Velosio is seeking a Product Manager to own the vision, roadmap, and execution of our IP solution's within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ecosystem. This role is responsible for ensuring the product aligns with market needs, business strategy, and customer outcomes while driving cross-functional execution across development, consulting, sales, and support.

This is a hands-on product leadership role that blends strategy, execution, and stakeholder enablement to deliver measurable value for customers and internal teams.

Your day might look like:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own and communicate the product vision and roadmap

  • Prioritize features and enhancements based on customer feedback, market trends, and business objectives

  • Review and refine roadmap priorities on a quarterly basis

  • Monitor competitive landscape and industry trends to inform strategy

Customer & Market Insights

  • Partner with IP, consulting, and support teams to gather customer feedback and requirements

  • Conduct market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and risks

  • Use customer insights to guide backlog prioritization and product decisions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary liaison between development, sales, consulting, marketing, and support teams

  • Translate business requirements into clear user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Partner closely with development during sprint planning, backlog grooming, and execution

  • Collaborate with documentation and functional teams to support releases and adoption

Stakeholder Communication

  • Provide regular updates on roadmap progress, release timing, and priorities

  • Communicate risks, blockers, and tradeoffs clearly to leadership and stakeholders

  • Respond to inbound requests from sales, consulting, and support teams

Customer & Partner Engagement

  • Participate in customer calls to clarify requirements and gather feedback

  • Review support cases to identify recurring issues and enhancement opportunities

  • Support webinars, advisory councils, and customer update sessions as needed

Backlog & Requirements Management

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog

  • Create, refine, and maintain user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Review bugs regularly and prioritize based on customer and business impact

  • Ensure backlog items are development-ready prior to sprint execution

Release Planning & Delivery

  • Coordinate release schedules, sprint cutoffs, and delivery milestones

  • Create and maintain release documentation and SharePoint content

  • Oversee QA, UAT, and test environment readiness

  • Maintain release notes, documentation, and supporting materials

  • Facilitate daily scrums, sprint ceremonies, and retrospectives

What you'll bring:

Product & Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of product lifecycle management

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and project accounting / PSA solutions

  • Ability to translate business needs into actionable technical requirements

  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, DevOps pipelines, and QA processes

Analytical & Strategic Skills

  • Strong prioritization and decision-making skills

  • Comfortable analyzing usage data, adoption trends, and performance metrics

  • Able to balance short-term delivery with long-term product strategy

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent communicator across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Strong facilitation skills for sprint ceremonies and cross-functional sessions

  • Ability to clearly articulate product vision to stakeholders and leadership

Ownership & Execution

  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable managing competing priorities

  • Strong attention to detail with a bias toward execution

  • Commitment to continuous improvement and product quality

  • 5+ years of experience in product management or a related role

  • Experience working with enterprise SaaS, ERP, or PSA solutions

  • Hands-on experience working with Agile development teams

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Who we are:

At Velosio, we focus on what matters most - our people. We are a values-driven organization committed to delivering an outstanding employee experience to all our team members.

Velosio’s years of experience with business applications translate to a deep bench of tenured team members with competency across enterprise resource management (ERP), customer relationship management (CRM), and cloud services.

We have earned recognition from Microsoft as a top 1% performing partner worldwide and an emerging NetSuite leader. We have strategic independent software vendor (ISV) partnerships and a portfolio of solution and service offerings to accelerate what’s next for business.

Our mission is to enable clients to realize business value faster, simplify the process of deploying technology, acquire deeper data-driven insights, and explore ongoing innovation to drive business forward. We support the entire Microsoft Dynamics portfolio, Office 365 family and Azure services. Velosio is the only Microsoft Cloud Distributor that specializes in Dynamics 365 and is a prominent Microsoft Master VAR. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Velosio’s 400 employees serve over 4,000 clients.

Beyond our expertise, as a Velosio team member, you can leverage the Velosio award-winning culture - a network of top-notch peers, day-to-day flexibility, career development resources and the largest incentive opportunities in the industry.


Some reasons you might like working with us:

At Velosio, YOU MATTER.

Due to our ongoing commitment to delivering an exemplary employee experience, Velosio has been recognized by Comparably in multiple categories – including Best Company Culture (2021-2024), Best Company Outlook (2022-2025), Best Company for Career Growth and Best Leadership Teams (2022-2025).

Access the following link to see why:

  • 100% of current Velosio team members feel the company is invested in their career growth
  • 99% feel their manager cares about them as a person
  • 99% look forward to interacting with their coworkers every day

At Velosio, YOUR WELLNESS MATTERS.

We know one size doesn't fit all, which is why we offer a comprehensive benefits package that allows our team members to create a personalized plan best suited for their unique needs, including:

  • 3 Medical Insurance options with a company contribution to HSA
  • 3 Dental Insurance options including adult orthodontics
  • 3 Vision Insurance options
  • Unlimited PTO (UPTO)
  • Remote or hybrid working environment based on location
  • 401k Match 50% of the first 6%
  • StayWell Program – a cash reimbursement up to $600 a year toward Wellness

EEO Statement:

Velosio is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

If you need assistance or accommodation with the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or you may call us at (888) 725-2555.

raw.title: VP of Hospital & System Partnerships
raw.excerpt: Who we are: AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions.
raw.description:
Who we are:

AMOpportunities is the category leader in tech-enabled clinical training placements and workforce solutions. We equip universities and healthcare providers with the infrastructure needed to expand clinical education across all healthcare disciplines. With partnerships spanning 100+ allopathic (MD), osteopathic (DO), nursing (NP and pre-licensure), PA, and allied health degree programs at 650+ healthcare institutions nationwide and internationally, AMO is solving the healthcare training shortage by enabling quality clinical education at scale.

Since expanding to domestic B2B solutions in 2020, we've secured 75+ partnerships with U.S. academic institutions and placed students in nearly 6,000 clinical rotations. Our proprietary SaaS platform and comprehensive service solutions help schools expand enrollment, open new clinical campuses, and prepare for accreditation visits.

At AMOpportunities, we're guided by a clear set of values that shape how we show up for each other and for those we serve, every day.

  • Trust: Trust the process. Trust one another.
  • Impact: Local focus, global impact. Solutions today for tomorrow.
  • Be a global citizen: Collaborative mindset. Embrace our differences. Work better together.
  • Quality: High quality service. Delighting those we serve.
  • Adapt with Agility: Embrace change. Move fast, stay flexible.
  • Rooted in Relationships: Strong partnerships. Support and celebrate each other. Grow together.

Frequently cited statistics show that women and underrepresented groups apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. AMOpportunities encourages you to apply even if you do not meet all listed qualifications. We look forward to your application. 

About the position:

The VP of Hospital & System Partnerships is the owner of AMO’s hospital and health system relationships. This leader builds and runs the top-down clinical partnerships engine that secures new relationships with hospital systems and their associated medical professionals to build a network of active clinical experiences for AMO's customers.

The role combines business strategy with senior level selling to C-suite executives, graduate medical education (GME) leaders, and other administrators. Specifically, this leader identifies and prioritizes health systems, hospitals, and clinics for outreach, then takes opportunities through the end-to-end sales funnel – from initial outreach through to pitching and contracting.

This role owns the top-down recruitment of clinical supply, which begins with facility contracting & leadership engagement and continues through preceptor identification, qualification, and engagement (in partnership with AMO’s clinical network development team) to build preceptor networks at acquired hospitals and turn that hospital capacity into core clerkship clinical slots that enable student rotations and generate revenue.

The VP of Hospital Partnerships and the VP of Clinical Network Development share ownership of AMO’s clinical network, the VPHP owning facility relationships and the VPCND owning the development of the preceptor network, working in collaboration to build our best-in-class Clinical Network. They set strategy together, deciding which health systems to pursue, how to scope and structure Network Development Services (NDS) engagements, and where to build clinical hubs. They also execute together, joining school and hospital conversations as-needed to recruit preceptors and close deals.


While this position can be fully remote, we are looking for candidates to be residents of Alabama, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, New York, Ohio, Texas, or Wisconsin.

Essential Functions:

Hospital and Health System Acquisition Strategy

  • In consideration of company targets and contractual obligations to customers, set the national hospital acquisition strategy: define target health systems, prioritize them by capacity, geography, and fit with customer demand, and set the plan and timeline for onboarding new relationships.
  • Build and sustain relationships with health system leadership, including C-suite executives, clinical leaders, GME leaders, legal & finance teams, and the broader academic administrators.
  • Personally lead the highest-value partnership conversations and close new hospital and health system deals.
  • Expand existing health system partnerships by identifying growth opportunities across hospitals, clinics, and affiliated facilities.

Deal Execution and Contracting

  • Guide hospital deals through contracting and approval at large institutions, working with AMO's counsel.
  • Provide strategic guidance on complex affiliation agreements and partnership terms.
  • Keep contracting and affiliation processes clear, documented, and efficient, in partnership with Program Implementation teams.

Turning Hospital Partnerships into Clinical Supply

  • Operationalize every new hospital partnership by 1) cultivating buy-in for AMO’s staffing model, 2) enabling recruitment of preceptors within the hospital's affiliated and employed providers (physicians, PAs, NPs, nurses, and others) and, 3) as applicable, winning commitments of preceptor capacity from relevant hospital leaders.
  • Facilitate VPCND’s on-site recruitment events, referral programs, and targeted outreach to affiliated physician lists to secure new preceptor relationships in core and elective specialties
  • Work with operations to identify gaps in AMO’s clinical network and lead the replacement or buffer recruitment for departed or underperforming facilities.

Partnering on NDS and School Demand

  • Work with the VP of Clinical Network Development and Sales to identify the best-fit hospital targets for each NDS engagement, including clinical hubs and clusters.
  • Assist Sales team with preceptor strategy and availability for new and existing education partners.
  • Provide hospital supply for NDS engagements for PA, MD, DO, and NP programs, and collaborate with academic institutions and health systems to grow strategic clinical hubs over the long term.

Team Leadership and Site Management Oversight

  • Direct the implementation and continued development of standard operating procedures (SOPs), checklists, and training so day-to-day site work can be handed to the implementation team, with the most valuable relationships routed to the acquisition team.
  • Maintain and build out standardized dataset of clinical sites, their affiliation and credentialing requirements, and their key contacts.

Reporting, Systems, and Cross-Functional Work

  • Own pipeline visibility for hospital acquisition: forecasts, dashboards, and reporting in HubSpot.
  • Own and operationalize research and prospecting tools such as Definitive and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to segment and develop leads.
  • Collaborate across the company to keep the clinical network healthy and well documented.
  • Travel to hospital sites, partnership meetings, and conferences.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Skills, Education, & Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in a healthcare-related field, or equivalent experience in a relevant field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in healthcare business development and partnerships, provider network development, clinical-site recruitment, or health system sales, including senior-level or executive-level accountability for hard delivery targets.
  • Demonstrated record of building trusted relationships with hospital and health system leadership, GME leaders, legal teams, or academic administrators, and closing partnerships with them.
  • Experience navigating complex approval and contracting processes with multiple stakeholders at large institutions.

Overview As one of the nation's leading electric transmission line construction companies, MasTec Power Delivery companies engineer and construct efficient and reliable electrical transmission, distribution, and substation & switchyard systems. Our extensive workforce includes both union and nonunion teams, which, combined with our specialized equipment fleet, allows us to effectively meet our clients' needs for power delivery, emergency restoration, and ongoing maintenance. We've been involved in some of the most challenging and recognizable electric projects across the U.S. From the electric plant to the end users, MasTec's experienced managers and crews consistently deliver transmission, distribution, and substation & switchyard services with an unfailing commitment to safety, integrity, and sustainable practices. Salary range: $130-160k depending one experience The Engineering Project Manager is responsible for leading the engineering, design, and execution of electrical substation projects from conceptual development through commissioning and project closeout. This role provides technical leadership, project management, and cross-functional coordination to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with applicable industry standards and client requirements. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in high-voltage electrical substations, power system engineering, utility construction, and multidisciplinary project management. Responsibilities Project Management Manage the complete lifecycle of electrical substation projects ranging from distribution to transmission voltage levels. Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, resource plans, and risk assessments. Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to maintain schedule and budget performance. Lead project kickoff meetings, status reviews, and stakeholder communications. Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities. Engineering Leadership Oversee electrical engineering design for new substations, expansions, upgrades, and modernization projects. Review and approve engineering deliverables, including: Single-line diagrams Protection and control drawings Relay settings AC/DC station service systems Grounding studies Equipment layouts Cable schedules Bill of materials Ensure compliance with applicable utility standards, client specifications, and industry codes. Construction Support Provide engineering support during construction and field installation. Resolve technical issues and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs). Coordinate engineering changes and design revisions. Support equipment testing, energization, and commissioning activities. Conduct site visits to verify construction quality and engineering compliance. Client & Stakeholder Management Serve as the primary engineering contact for clients, contractors, utilities, and regulatory agencies. Build and maintain strong customer relationships through proactive communication and technical expertise. Prepare project reports, presentations, and executive-level updates. Support proposal development, scope definition, and project estimates. Quality & Safety Promote a strong safety culture throughout all phases of project execution. Ensure engineering work complies with OSHA requirements, company safety policies, and industry best practices. Implement quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) procedures. Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, and lessons learned meetings. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited institution. 5+ years of experience in electrical engineering with a focus on substation design and construction. 2+ years of project management experience leading multidisciplinary engineering projects. Strong understanding of utility transmission and distribution systems. Experience managing EPC or design-build projects. Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, specifications, and construction documents. Excellent organizational, communication, and leadership skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and project scheduling software (Microsoft Project or Primavera P6). Preferred Qualifications Professional Engineer (PE) license. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification. Experience with utility clients, renewable energy interconnections, or transmission infrastructure. Familiarity with engineering software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, ETAP, SKM PowerTools, or CYME. Working knowledge of SCADA, Protection & Control, relay systems, and NERC/FERC requirements. Experience managing projects valued from $1M to $100M+.

raw.description:
warum zu uns

Empower People. Create Success. Bei Scalian Germany stehen die Mitarbeitenden und das Miteinander im Fokus. Wir brennen für unsere Themen, bringen uns proaktiv ein und geben fachlich und persönlich tagtäglich unser Bestes. Gemeinsam feiern wir unsere kleinen und großen Erfolge, freuen uns aufrichtig für- und miteinander und unterstützen uns gegenseitig. Bringe mit uns Deine Karriere voran und nutze die vielfältigen Möglichkeiten, Dich individuell weiterzuentwickeln, Dein Wissen und Deine Ideen zu teilen und auszubauen sowie Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

was wir gemeinsam vorhaben

  • Projektteams begleiten: Unterstütze ein bis zwei agile Teams bei unseren Kunden als (Junior) Scrum Master.
  • Agiles Mindset vorleben: Sei Vorbild für agile Werte und fördere kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
  • Teams coachen: Entwickle crossfunktionale Teams weiter und unterstütze sie in ihrer Selbstorganisation.
  • Agile Arbeitsweisen einführen: Implementiere und optimiere agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder SAFe.
  • Meetings moderieren: Plane und moderiere agile Events und coache beteiligte Rollen.
  • Netzwerken: Baue starke Beziehungen zu unseren Kunden sowie innerhalb der Scalian Germany auf.
  • Stakeholder Management: Kommuniziere (intern als auch extern) und arbeite eng mit Projektteams, Stakeholdern und Kunden zusammen.

womit du überzeugst

  • Du hast ein Studium in Wirtschaftspsychologie, Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich.
  • Du hast bereits als Scrum Master, RTE oder in agilen Projekten gearbeitet.
  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in Scrum, Kanban etc. sowie idealerweise mit Skalierungs-Frameworks (z.B. SAFe) mit.
  • Stillstand ist für Dich keine Option: Du lernst kontinuierlich und entwickelst Dich weiter.
  • Der persönliche Kontakt mit Kunden bringt Dir Spaß.
  • Du förderst agile Prozesse und die Zusammenarbeit im Team.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Deine Englischkenntnisse sind gut in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du bist bereit für regelmäßige Dienstreisen.

worauf du dich freuen kannst

Unsere besondere Unternehmenskultur:

  • Herzliches und wertschätzendes Miteinander, in dem jede Persönlichkeit zählt
  • Offener Austausch und offene Türen - vom Junior bis zum Vorstand
  • Zahlreiche Team- und Unternehmensevents, wie unser jährliches Sommerfest zusammen mit unseren Familien
Unsere Benefits für Wohlergehen und Wachstum:

  • Smartes Arbeiten, z.B. mobil und mit flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen, Möglichkeit für Sabbaticals und Workation
  • Zusatzleistungen, z.B. Corporate Benefits, attraktive betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Blinkist und JobRad
  • Health Care Benefits, z.B. vergünstigte Mitgliedschaften für Urban Sports Club und betriebliche Krankenversicherung
Unser gemeinsamer Weg:

  • Intensive Einarbeitung durch ein umfangreiches Onboarding und Patenprogramm
  • Vielfältige interne Weiterbildungsangebote und externe Fördermaßnahmen
  • Internationales Austauschprogramm zur Förderung der persönlichen und beruflichen Weiterentwicklung innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe
Und vieles mehr.

was du wissen solltest

Wir suchen Persönlichkeiten! Daher prüfen wir Deine Bewerbung nicht ausschließlich auf eine bestimmte Stelle bezogen, sondern als eine Bewerbung an das Unternehmen Scalian Germany. In einem persönlichen Gespräch finden wir gemeinsam heraus, ob Deine Ziele und unsere Vorstellungen zueinander passen.

Du findest Dich im Themengebiet und Standort nicht wieder? Sende uns gerne Deine Unterlagen zu – wir berücksichtigen Dich gerne für weitere Projekte an auch an anderen Standorten.

Alles Weitere erzählen wir Dir in einem persönlichen Gespräch. Sende uns Deine Unterlagen und nutze den "Jetzt Bewerben"-Button (Dateigröße max. 35 MB).

raw.description:
Delivery Solutions Architect

Company Overview

Waterfield Tech enables companies to select, design, and deploy tailored customer engagement solutions from the world’s leading providers enhanced by cutting edge Applied AI. The results are happier customers, enhanced insights, and lower costs.

Once live, we empower companies to support, optimize, and modernize those solutions and AI applications, leading to lower risk and increased efficiency. Our client-centric process and track record of success have earned the trust of clients around the world when it comes to customer interaction.

We value our people—their diversity, their dedication, and their commitment to customer satisfaction. We encourage each other. We understand the value of hard work and the importance of a healthy balance. We’re all on the same page… even though we may get there from different perspectives. All in all, it’s a pretty cool place to be and we’re growing our global team of engineers, sales professionals, and creative souls.

Position Summary

The Delivery Solutions Architect (DSA) owns the technical solution on Waterfield Tech’s Avaya engagements — from validating the pre-sale scope through project delivery. As a member of the Delivery team, the DSA serves as the technical counterpart to the Project Manager, designing, validating, and governing the end-to-end architecture that turns client requirements into resilient, secure, and implementable outcomes.

This role anchors technical governance for Waterfield’s Avaya portfolio across upgrades, migrations, integrations, and new deployments. The DSA validates pre-sale scope and solution design alongside the Client Advisor, contributes to costing, and carries that design through project initiation, build, testing, and deployment so that what is sold is what is delivered.

The DSA is not expected to be the deepest expert on every platform. On multi-platform programs, the DSA knows the contact center landscape well enough to identify the right internal and external subject-matter experts, orchestrate their input, and ensure that integration points are documented and accounted for in the design — serving as the connective tissue that keeps technical decisions consistent, defensible, and aligned to business goals.

This role requires deep technical fluency in the Avaya Aura ecosystem, strong client-facing presence, and the discipline to govern delivery against an approved design and document it clearly.

This is a high-impact role for a senior practitioner who enjoys owning technical outcomes, partnering closely with project and pre-sales teams, and seeing complex solutions through from design to deployment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical architecture for assigned Avaya engagements, designing and validating solutions that meet documented business and functional requirements
  • Validate pre-sale scope and solution design in partnership with the Client Advisor on complex, high-touch pursuits — confirming technical fit, surfacing risks, and ensuring scope assumptions are deliverable
  • Contribute to costing inputs and effort estimates so that solutions can be delivered within the agreed scope and margin
  • Review the pre-sale design at internal kickoff (IKO) and provide clear technical direction to the assigned implementation team
  • Serve as the technical counterpart to the Project Manager, providing technical governance across the project lifecycle and ensuring integration points are identified, documented, and resourced
  • Govern delivery against the approved design — oversee functional testing and solution deployment, validating that what is built matches what was designed
  • Identify technical scope changes early and partner with the Project Manager on change control
  • Identify and orchestrate the right internal and external subject-matter experts, coordinating their input into a coherent, well-documented design
  • Produce concept design drawings and solution documentation for pre-sale validation and implementation hand-off
  • Maintain technical authority across the Avaya Aura ecosystem (Communication Manager, Session Manager, AES, Experience Portal, Elite, AACC) and adjacent partner stack
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, executable, and secure
  • Translate complex technical concepts and trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and client leadership
  • Partner with existing customers to develop and optimize their technology roadmap
  • Stay current on emerging trends, platforms, and technologies relevant to the contact center and CX landscape

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in solution architecture, technical architecture, or senior technical delivery in contact center / unified communications, ideally within professional services or systems integration, with significant time on Avaya
  • Deep, current expertise in the Avaya Aura ecosystem with the ability to design, defend, and govern solutions in client-facing settings
  • Experience validating pre-sale scope and contributing to professional services costing and effort estimates
  • Demonstrated experience designing and governing solutions with multiple integration points across more than one platform
  • Strong written communication — produces design documentation and integration details clearly, without heavy editing
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical and executive audiences
  • Strong time-management skills, with the ability to govern multiple concurrent engagements
  • Preferred: experience with adjacent CX platforms (e.g., Five9, Genesys, Cisco, NICE, Zoom); exposure to applied AI and automation in contact centers (e.g., Hyro)

Additional Requirements

  • Avaya certifications (ACSS, ACIS) preferred
  • Availability to work flexible hours as needed

Physical Requirements

  • Sitting: Ability to sit for long periods of time.
  • Vision & Hearing: Normal or corrected vision and hearing to work with others in person and video conference.

Waterfield Tech is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Waterfield Tech believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and does not discriminate against its Employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, citizenship status, disability, protected medical condition, military status, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy extends to all aspects of our employment practices including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, discipline, promotion, transfers, compensation, benefits, leaves of absence, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.

Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte de la prestation

La Direction Data a 3 grandes prestations : maximiser la collecte de données tout en respectant les
réglementations en vigueur, développer la connaissance et l’expérience utilisateurs et mettre à
disposition auprès des équipes internes des outils de pilotage et d’aide à la décision.
Dans une volonté d’améliorer la valeur ajoutée issue de nos données, nous mettons en place un
catalogue de données avec la contribution de plusieurs parties prenantes. Dans ce cadre nous
souhaitons renforcer nos équipes par une prestation de Data Catalog Product Owner qui orchestrera
la mise en oeuvre de notre futur catalogue de données.
La prestation attendue consistera à participer à la gestion et l'évolution de notre catalogue de
données. Le prestataire s'assurera que le catalogue est une ressource précieuse, utile et facile à
utiliser pour l'ensemble de l'organisation, facilitant l'accès et la compréhension des données

disponibles.

Objectif de la prestation

1. Gestion du catalogue de données :

  • Développer et maintenir le catalogue de données, y compris la classification, l'annotation et la

documentation des ensembles de données.

  • Assurer la qualité et la cohérence des métadonnées.

2. Amélioration continue :

  • Collecter et analyser les retours des utilisateurs pour améliorer continuellement le catalogue.
  • Construire, prioriser et piloter la réalisation de la liste des besoins et des fonctionnalités requises

(Backlog), en collaboration étroite avec le Data Manager ainsi que l’ensemble des parties prenantes.

  • Implémenter des fonctionnalités nouvelles et améliorées en collaboration avec les Data Stewards

3. Gouvernance des données :

  • Définir et mettre en œuvre des politiques et procédures pour la gestion des données.
  • Veiller à la conformité des données avec les réglementations en vigueur, en coordination avec le PO

Privacy.

4. Formation et support :

  • Organiser des formations utilisateur sur les meilleures pratiques d'utilisation du catalogue de

données.

  • Fournir un support continu aux utilisateurs pour assurer une utilisation optimale du catalogue.

5. Collaboration et Adhésion :

  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec toutes les parties prenantes (les Data Owners, Data

Stewards, Data Manager, Data scientists, Data analysts, Etc) pour s'assurer que le catalogue répond

aux besoins de tous les utilisateurs.

  • Contribuer activement à l’adoption du Data Catalog par l’ensemble des départements.
  • Piloter et mesurer cette adoption via des métriques conjointement établis avec l’équipe Data

Gouvernance

Expertise souhaitée

Expertises techniques requises pour la réalisation de la prestation :

  • Maîtrise d’au moins une solution Data catalog
  • Très bonne compréhension des environnements Data et Big data
  • Connaissance de la conception d’un métamodèle et de son implémentation
  • Compréhension des standards et des pratiques pour la collecte, le stockage, et l'utilisation des

métadonnées.

  • Compréhension des principes et fonctionnement des API pour les interfaçages du Data Catalog avec

d’autres systèmes de l’environnement

  • La connaissance de la solution COLLIBRA serait un plus

Expertises fonctionnelles requises pour la réalisation de la prestation :

  • Connaître les fondamentaux de la Data Gouvernance (Data Catalog, Quality, Policies, Process, etc)
  • Bonne connaissance des indicateurs marketing
  • Bonne connaissance de la réglementation (RGPD, CNIL)
  • La connaissance du domaine du Numérique et des médias (FAI, Agrégateur, Distributeur, SEO/SEA,

…) serait un plus

Mobilité

Non renseigné

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Impact

  • As a Strategic Account Manager, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
  • Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers
  • Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
  • Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
  • Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings

Qualifications

  • Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry
  • Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques
  • Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
  • Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
  • Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
  • Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process
  • Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

Qualifications

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

raw.title: Senior Staff Accountant
raw.excerpt: Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 / year Job Summary Pace Center for Girls seeks a detail-oriented, mission-driven, and experienced Senior Staff Accountant to manage and coordinate all financial activities across our centers.
raw.description:
Salary Range: $70,000 - $80,000 / year

Job Summary

Pace Center for Girls seeks a detail-oriented, mission-driven, and experienced Senior Staff Accountant to manage and coordinate all financial activities across our centers. Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Senior Staff Accountant will ensure fiscal and regulatory accountability, providing critical support to the organization's financial health and sustainability. The Senior Staff Accountant will play a vital role in maintaining the financial integrity of the organization, supporting its mission, and fostering organizational excellence.

Who We Are: At Pace we transform girls’ lives through academic and counseling programs based on girl-centered, strength-based and trauma informed framework. Team members create a safe place for girls to learn, process, heal and begin again. Founded in 1985, Pace Center for Girls is a nonprofit organization that believes all girls, regardless of their story, deserve a safe and supportive space where they can become strong, compassionate and successful women.

Our Culture:

At Pace, our culture is built on core beliefs that foster a supportive, mission-driven, and empowering environment where girls can thrive and reach their full potential. Our culture is rooted in the following foundational behaviors:

  • Caring – We are warm, sincere, compassionate, and collaborative, fostering an environment of support and connection.
  • Purposeful – We are focused on our mission and committed to social responsibility, ensuring our efforts make a meaningful impact.
  • Learning Oriented – We are open, inventive, and exploratory, continuously seeking growth and improvement.
  • Results Driven – We are focused on achieving goals and measurable success, ensuring accountability and progress.
  • Girl-Centered – The ways that girls learn and develop are unique. That's why we've created an environment that responds to their needs so they can feel safe enough to develop meaningful and trusting relationships while embracing their capabilities, strengths and autonomy.
  • Using Your Strengths – Every girl brings something exceptional to the table. At Pace, we focus on developing these special characteristics. By supporting a girl's talents and positive attributes we help her achieve her goals.
  • Understanding Trauma – Trauma can alter the course of a girl's life. At Pace, we recognize that trauma may be the root cause of unhealthy behaviors, which is why we work hard to help heal and empower girls.

What We Offer:

  • Growth and Development - Competitive salaries, ongoing learning and development opportunities, and subject-specific instructional coaching to support growth and success.
  • Work Life Balance – Team members benefit from 20 paid time off days, 14 paid national holidays, and an additional 5 days for wellness week. Center based team members observe a balanced schedule with 230 academic days and 20 dedicated in-service planning days. Teachers become eligible to receive an additional 2 weeks of paid time off after one year of employment.
  • Comprehensive Benefits - Full-time team members are eligible for a range of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, critical illness, accident coverage, legal and identity theft protection, and a 403(b)-retirement plan. Team members working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for medical, dental, FSA, HSA, and the 403(b)-retirement plan. Those working less than 30 hours per week are eligible for the 403(b)-retirement plan.
  • Mental Health and Well-Being - All team members have access to wellness resources, offering wellness rewards, counseling sessions, leadership coaching, mindfulness resources, and more to support their overall well-being.

What This Role Does:

Financial Management – Ensure Fiscal Accountability

  • Manage and coordinate all financial activities across Pace centers, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Oversee accounting functions including property, plant and equipment, investments, insurance accounts, in-kind donations, special event transactions, and other specialized accounts.
  • Perform monthly account reconciliations and allocations to ensure accuracy of financial statements and tax and regulatory returns.
  • Prepare and submit required agency applications, reports, reviews, and documents.
  • Support the budget and forecast process.

Grant and Contract Management – Drive Excellence and Compliance

  • Coordinate all major federal and state grant accounting and reporting.
  • Serve as liaison between grantors and the agency; process monthly and quarterly claims and invoices; monitor accounts receivable aging.
  • Prepare grant and contract financial reports accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with contract managers and agency partners.
  • Maintain an organized grant/contract filing system.

Financial Reporting and Analysis – Support Decision-Making

  • Provide recommendations for accounting and reporting process improvements.
  • Prepare and support in process documentation and controls.
  • Conduct research and lead efforts for all audits.
  • Act as the financial liaison for the Department of Juvenile Justice (DJJ).
  • Coordinate reporting for the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) and other assigned grants and contracts.
  • Prepare reports, reviews, and recommendations based on research and analysis.
  • Identify and communicate financial and compliance issues for assigned areas to the Finance Leadership and executive management, summarizing and explaining results.

Team Collaboration and Training – Foster a High-Performing Finance Team

  • Support the finance team by cross-training as necessary.
  • Participate in the training of temporary staff or new hires as necessary.
  • Provide training, research, and analysis to facilitate effective decision-making.
  • Participate in conference calls and webinars, delivering continuous improvement training to agency staff regarding NSLP, IRS, and other assigned projects.

Audit and Tax Compliance – Uphold Standards and Regulations

  • Assist in the preparation and performance of annual audit and tax return and other periodic regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare requested schedules and documentation for auditors in a neat, concise, and timely manner.
  • Manage sales and use tax returns along with all other applicable returns.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

What We Require for the Job:

A detail-oriented, analytical professional with a deep commitment to Pace’s mission and values. Someone who excels in financial management, compliance, and reporting, and can effectively support the organization's fiscal health and sustainability.

Core Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in accounting or business.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in an accounting position.
  • In-depth knowledge of accounting processing and reporting systems.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office.
  • Knowledge of relevant federal and state laws impacting not-for-profit fiscal compliance and reporting.
  • Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills; strong written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with a wide range of management, staff, and external vendors.
  • Strong computer and internet research skills.

Other

  • Expected to complete and participate in all required trainings and drills.
  • Required to align with the Mission, Values, and Guiding Principles, maintain ethical standards, and comply with all policies and procedures of Pace Center for Girls.

raw.description:
Position Overview

International Motors has an exciting opportunity for a Field Service Consultant Sr. This position plays a key role in delivering exceptional customer service and technical support by assisting customers with product inquiries, troubleshooting technical concerns, and providing effective solutions to product-related issues.

The Field Service Consultant Sr. serves as a resource for customers, providing Tier 1 and Tier 2 support through telephone, email, and chat communications. This role works closely with customers to resolve concerns related to product installation, operation, maintenance, and compatibility while ensuring a positive customer experience.

The ideal candidate will bring strong interpersonal skills, technical product knowledge, and a customer-focused approach to problem-solving. Additionally, this position supports continuous product improvement by documenting recurring technical issues, maintaining accurate customer information, and assisting with information tracking, billing, invoicing, and reporting activities.


Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced technical support to customers through telephone, email, and chat, addressing product inquiries, technical concerns, and service-related issues.

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot complex equipment issues related to product installation, operation, maintenance, and compatibility, recommending effective corrective actions.

  • Oversee equipment diagnostics, troubleshooting, service, and repair activities to ensure operational quality and customer satisfaction.

  • Serve as a technical resource and company liaison for customers, collaborating with engineering, manufacturing, and internal teams to resolve complex product concerns.

  • Provide customers with technical guidance and instruction on proper equipment operation, maintenance procedures, and product functionality.

  • Identify, document, and track recurring technical issues, customer concerns, and product performance trends to support continuous improvement and product quality initiatives.

  • Utilize advanced technical knowledge and independent judgment to resolve complex customer issues, recommend best practices, and escalate concerns when appropriate.

  • Maintain accurate customer records and support administrative activities, including service documentation, information tracking, billing, invoicing, and reporting.

  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of International Motors’ policies, procedures, warranties policy, and service standards to ensure accurate guidance and consistent customer support.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, dealers, and internal stakeholders to foster trust, effective communication, and timely resolution of service-related concerns.


Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 5 years of field service engineering, automotive service or truck service experience
  • At least 1 years of lead experience

OR

  • Master's degree and at least 3 years of field service engineering, automotive service or truck service experience
  • At least 1 years of lead experience

OR

  • At least 8 years of field service engineering, automotive service or truck service experience
  • At least 1 years of lead experience

Additional Requirements

  • Qualified candidates, excluding current employees, must be legally authorized on an unrestricted basis (US Citizen, Legal Permanent Resident, Refugee or Asylee) to be employed in the United States. We do not anticipate providing employment related work sponsorship for this position (e.g., H-1B status)

Desired Skills

  • Technical Troubleshooting: Strong ability to diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve complex equipment and product-related issues, including installation, operation, maintenance, and compatibility concerns.

  • Customer Service & Communication: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to provide professional technical support through telephone, email, and chat while maintaining positive customer relationships.

  • Technical Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of equipment functionality, service procedures, diagnostics, and repair processes, with the ability to provide effective technical guidance.

  • Problem-Solving & Critical Thinking: Demonstrated ability to independently analyze complex technical concerns, identify root causes, and recommend effective corrective actions.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with engineering, manufacturing, service teams, and other internal stakeholders to resolve customer concerns and improve product quality.

  • Documentation & Reporting: Strong organizational skills with experience maintaining accurate service records, tracking recurring technical issues, and supporting billing, invoicing, and reporting activities.


Benefits and Compensation

This position offers competitive market-based compensation, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support employee wellbeing. You can learn more about the benefits offered for this position by visiting .

The expected salary offered for this position will fall within the stated range, with the final offer based on the candidates' applicable skills, knowledge, and experience.


Company Overview

About TRATON
With its brands Scania, MAN, International, and Volkswagen Truck & Bus, TRATON SE is the parent and holding company of the TRATON GROUP and one of the world’s leading commercial vehicle manufacturers. The Group’s product portfolio comprises trucks, buses, and light-duty commercial vehicles. “Transforming Transportation Together. For a sustainable world.”: this intention underlines the Company’s ambition to have a lasting and sustainable impact on the commercial vehicle business and on the Group’s commercial growth.

About International
From a one-man company built on the world-changing invention of the McCormick reaper in 1831, to the 15,000-person-strong company we are today, few companies can lay claim to a history like International. Based in Lisle, Illinois, International Motors, LLC* creates solutions that deliver greater uptime and productivity to our customers throughout the full operation of our commercial vehicles. We build International® trucks and engines and IC Bus® school and commercial buses that are as tough and as smart as the people who drive them. We also develop Fleetrite® aftermarket parts. In everything we do, our vision is to accelerate the impact of sustainable mobility to create the cleaner, safer world we all deserve. As of 2021, we joined Scania, MAN and Volkswagen Truck & Bus in TRATON GROUP, a global champion of the truck and transport services industry. To learn more, visit International.com.

*International Motors, LLC is d/b/a International Motors USA in Illinois, Missouri, New Jersey, Ohio, Texas, and Utah.


EEO Statement

If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to access the online application system or participate in the interview process due to your disability, please email  to request assistance. About CData Software, Inc.

CData is the AI gateway between AI and the systems that run the business. One control point connects agents and individuals to data across hundreds of enterprise systems, grounds every request in company context, governs it down to the record and routes it to the most efficient model. Built on CData's data layer, it delivers accurate answers, governed access and falling cost, whether the user is an agent, an application or a person. CData powers AI workloads for Anthropic, Databricks, Microsoft, Google, Palantir and more than 10,000 customers worldwide.

Headquartered in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, CData has over 500 team members, with offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. We take pride not just in what we build, but in how we build it: together, with curiosity, creativity, and a shared drive to push boundaries. Learn more at or contact .

Software Engineer III

Job Summary

As a Software Engineer III, you are a senior technical contributor responsible for designing, scaling, and evolving CData’s cloud and AI platforms. You operate in complex technical domains such as multi-tenant architecture, platform scalability, reliability, and AI-enabled capabilities.

You work on high-impact problems, contribute to technical design for key initiatives, and partner closely with Product, Design, and Engineering. You raise the engineering bar through mentorship and strong technical standards.

Location(s):Remote, U.S. / North Carolina Research Triangle or East Coast (preferred)
Eligibility: Applicants must be US-based and legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.
Key Duties & Responsibilities:

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Contribute to and lead components of cloud-native, scalable, multi-tenant architecture.
  • Design and develop robust, scalable backend services and APIs using Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, or C#.
  • Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to shape technical solutions to business problems.
  • Solve complex problems in distributed systems, data infrastructure, observability, performance, and reliability.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of AI/LLM-powered features and services.
  • Guide and support other engineers, lead technical design reviews, contribute to team best practices, and champion engineering excellence.
  • Take features from concept to production with thoughtful design, testing, instrumentation, and supportability.
  • Evaluate new technologies and tools, prototype solutions, and share insights with the team.
  • Drive initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing and design through implementation, rollout, and long-term support.

AI-First Development:

  • Apply AI-first development practices to improve engineering velocity and quality.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code generation, copilots, agentic workflows) to accelerate design, implementation, and debugging.
  • Leverage AI to rapidly prototype solutions, validate ideas, and reduce time from concept to production.
  • Apply AI in testing workflows (test generation, edge case discovery, regression analysis) to improve coverage and reliability.
  • Use AI-driven approaches for code review, refactoring, and documentation to maintain high engineering quality.
  • Integrate AI into observability and incident response workflows (e.g., anomaly detection, root cause analysis).
  • Exercise sound engineering judgement when using AI-generated outputs, ensuring correctness, security, and maintainability.
Qualifications
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in object-oriented programming and system design (Java, Kotlin, C#, TypeScript, or similar).
  • Bonus: Experience with front-end frameworks like React/TypeScript.
  • Proven experience building scalable REST APIs and cloud-native microservices.
  • Strong knowledge of relational (SQL Server, Postgres) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Elasticsearch).
  • Experience with message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure or AWS).
  • Bonus: Understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, or ML integration.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across time zones.
Travel Required:No regularly scheduled travel is expected for this role.

US Only: The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is $160,000-$190,000 per year. The actual range may vary depending on specific locations and experience.

Data Access & Compliance: This role may access, process, or support systems containing confidential customer data, including PII, PHI/ePHI, and other regulated or sensitive information. The employee must comply with CData’s Information Classification and Management Policy, HIPAA-related safeguards where applicable, access-control requirements, data-handling procedures, and incident-reporting obligations.

Benefits & Perks / What you’ll Get:

  • HealthSavingAccountoffering with company contributionto help mitigate increasing health costs
  • FlexibleSavingsAccountand Dependent Care FSA

🤑 Pension scheme
💳 £50 monthly allowance to spend on whatever takes your fancy, your very own Benifex card will be topped up at the start of each month!

Role Overview 🚀

Own the creation, and continuous improvement of the support knowledge base within Zendesk, ensuring our global support teams and customers have access to accurate, consistent, and easily discoverable content. Reporting into the Senior Operations Lead, this role is pivotal in driving deflection, reducing handling times, and improving the overall customer and employee experience by embedding a culture of knowledge-centred service (KCS) across the support organisation.

The Knowledge Manager will play a key role in our AI enablement journey, ensuring our knowledge base is structured, tagged, and optimised to power AI-driven tools such as Zendesk's AI agents, generative search, and intelligent triage. They will partner closely with Support Leadership, Product, Operations, and AI/Tooling teams to translate complex product and process information into clear, customer-ready guidance and internal-facing articles - building the foundation that allows AI to deliver accurate, trusted, and scalable answers at speed.

They will own the governance, lifecycle, and quality of all knowledge assets in Zendesk Guide, ensuring content is regularly reviewed, refreshed, and aligned with evolving products, services, and ways of working. By championing self-service, AI-enabled knowledge surfacing, and consistent agent enablement, this role will directly contribute to improved CSAT, first contact resolution, and SLA adherence - supporting our journey to a world-class, scalable support model.

Responsibilities 🤘

  • Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of knowledge content - creation, review, publication, maintenance, and retirement - ensuring accuracy, consistency, and relevance across all customer-facing and internal articles.

  • Embed Knowledge-Centred Service (KCS) principles across the support organisation, coaching agents and team leads to capture, reuse, and improve knowledge as part of their daily workflow.

  • Partner with the AI and Tooling teams to ensure the knowledge base is structured, tagged, and optimised to power AI-driven capabilities such as Zendesk AI agents, generative search, and intelligent triage.

  • Drive self-service and deflection by improving the discoverability, quality, and customer-readiness of help centre content, directly contributing to reduced ticket volumes and faster resolution times.

  • Establish and monitor knowledge KPIs (e.g. article usage, deflection rates, content health, AI answer accuracy), reporting performance and insights to the Senior Operations Lead and wider leadership team.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Operations, Support Engineering, and Regional Support Leaders to ensure knowledge reflects the latest product changes, processes, and customer needs.

  • Govern content quality and compliance, ensuring all knowledge is on-brand, accurate, accessible, and aligned with regulatory and data protection requirements.

  • Champion continuous improvement, using feedback loops from agents, customers, and AI performance data to refine content, fill knowledge gaps, and improve the overall support experience.

  • Support enablement and training, ensuring new and existing agents are equipped to find, use, and contribute to the knowledge base effectively.

  • And other duties that may be assigned from time to time.

What are we looking for? 🔎

  • Proven experience in a knowledge management role within a customer or employee support environment, ideally at scale across multiple regions or product lines.

  • Hands-on experience optimising a knowledge base within Zendesk Guide (or equivalent platforms such as Salesforce Knowledge, Intercom, or ServiceNow).

  • Strong understanding and practical application of Knowledge-Centred Service (KCS) methodology, ideally with KCS certification or equivalent.

  • Demonstrable experience structuring and optimising content to power AI-driven tools (e.g. Zendesk AI agents, generative search, chatbots, or intelligent triage).

  • Track record of driving measurable improvements in self-service, deflection rates, CSAT, and first contact resolution through knowledge initiatives.

  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, content lifecycle processes, and quality standards across a global knowledge base.

  • Experience in managing translations and localisation of content.

  • Strong background in cross-functional collaboration with Product, Operations, Support Engineering, and AI/Tooling teams to translate complex information into clear, customer-ready content.

  • Experience defining and reporting on knowledge KPIs (e.g. article usage, content health, AI answer accuracy, deflection) to senior stakeholders.

  • Excellent written communication and editorial skills, with the ability to translate technical or complex topics into simple, accessible language for both customers and agents.

  • Experience coaching and enabling support teams to contribute to and use the knowledge base effectively, embedding a culture of knowledge sharing.

  • Familiarity with AI, automation, and emerging support technologies, and a passion for leveraging them to improve the customer and agent experience.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, transformation-led environment, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office tools, including Excel (data analysis, pivot tables), Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.

Even if you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, we encourage you to apply! We are looking for talented and passionate individuals who are eager to learn and grow.
