raw.description:
Hello, our name is Customertimes, but you can call us CT. We are a global digital engineering, product development, and technology consulting company. Headquartered in New York, we have a team of 1000+ experts working across 65+ countries.

About this job:

We are looking for aData Business Analyst (1 seat, Middle to Senior level) for our client, one of the largest specialty provider networks in the US and part of a major healthcare company. The network includes independent and affiliated practices in urology, gastroenterology, rheumatology, and oncology. The goal is to turn practice EHR data (joined with pathology and genomic reports, medical claims, and disease registries at the patient level) into real-world data products that pharma and biotech companies license and build on.

The Data Business Analyst owns the definitions and the specs. They take what pharma customers, sales, and the business ask for and turn it into specs the data team can build, starting with prostate and bladder cancer. They check the data before a spec goes out.

  • Start: As soon as possible;
  • Length: 6-month initial term, expected to extend well past that;
  • Hours: Full-time, US Eastern business hours;
  • Work format: Remote, with onshore preferred and nearshore accepted if fully aligned with US Eastern hours. Occasional US office visits required; frequency yet to be determined;
  • Team mix: The seat can be supported by, or blended with, nearshore or offshore staff;
  • Data platform: Databricks (Delta Lake, medallion architecture) on Azure, alongside a large SQL Server estate with legacy stored procedures.

Location: Canada, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Uruguay, Peru, Colombia, Costa Rica

How you'll make an impact:

  • Own the product definition and Concept of Operations for each data product;
  • Take long, messy field lists from sales, customers, and the business and turn them into ranked, buildable specs;
  • Own one set of definitions every group uses: what counts as a patient, a stage, a line of therapy, and a refresh;
  • Work the data before writing a spec: profile the source, check fill rates, and confirm what the records support;
  • Sit with the architect, engineers, and clinical reviewers to settle how each field gets built and checked;
  • Write the acceptance criteria and sign off that what was built matches what was asked.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Experience writing specs for a clinical data product that was built without rework;
  • Knowledge of clinical fields: stage, biomarkers, lines of therapy, and outcomes;
  • Understanding of what pharma researchers and commercial teams need from each field;
  • Hands-on experience with data: SQL, source-to-target mapping, and data models;
  • Experience as the single owner of definitions across business, product, and data groups.

You are a star if you have:

  • Experience working at a real-world data company such as Flatiron Health, ConcertAI, or Tempus, or at a provider network or health system that sells its data;
  • Oncology or urology data experience, including pathology and genomic reports;
  • Experience with EHR, claims, and registry data, and the OMOP common data model;
  • Experience writing specs for fields that AI pulls from clinical notes, including when a person reviews them;
  • Experience writing a product definition or Concept of Operations for a data product sold to pharma;
  • Knowledge of the coding systems ICD-10, CPT, NDC, and LOINC;
  • Experience building or using data readiness scorecards: fill rates, coverage, and what changed between refreshes;
  • Experience working in Databricks with SQL, and using work tools such as Jira or Confluence.

If you're looking to contribute to global projects, grow your skills, shape the way you work, and be part of a connected international community — Customertimes is the place to build your next career chapter. Are you ready to spark the tech with us?

Overview

Title: Director of Donor RelationsLocation: Remote

Salary: $90,000 - $100,000 USD Annaully

Position Summary

The Director of Donor Relations is responsible for cultivating, securing, and sustaining financial support for Corporate Chaplains of America (CCA). This role focuses on identifying, researching, qualifying, and developing relationships with prospective donors while strengthening engagement with existing supporters to encourage long-term commitment and increased giving.

A primary responsibility is cultivating meaningful relationships with major gift donors, defined as individuals or organizations with the capacity to contribute $5,000 or more annually. Through intentional relationship-building and personalized engagement, the Director will connect donors' philanthropic interests and passions with CCA's mission, helping them experience the fulfillment of investing in a ministry that makes a lasting spiritual impact.

The Director will implement strategies to expand CCA's donor base, improve donor retention, increase charitable contributions, and foster lasting partnerships that advance the organization's mission and long-term sustainability.

Responsibilities

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Identify, qualify, cultivate, and steward a portfolio of major donors, with particular emphasis on developing relationships with prospective donors outside CCA's existing ecosystem.

  • Establish individualized fundraising goals for each donor based on giving history, demonstrated interests, engagement, and financial capacity.

  • Develop and execute personalized donor engagement strategies, including communication, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship plans designed to strengthen relationships, improve retention, and increase giving.

  • Build and maintain meaningful, long-term relationships with CCA's major donors, connecting their philanthropic interests with the mission and impact of the ministry.

  • Utilize Salesforce to effectively manage donor relationships, track engagement activities, maintain accurate records, and identify opportunities for continued cultivation and increased support.

  • Maintain accurate, confidential donor records in accordance with CCA's Privacy Policy and established organizational standards.

  • Prepare and submit timely weekly and monthly reports, as directed by leadership, accurately reflecting donor engagement, fundraising activities, progress toward established goals, and overall performance.

  • Travel extensively, with an expectation of more than 50% travel, to cultivate donor relationships, conduct meetings, and represent CCA at ministry-related events.

  • Perform additional donor relations and development responsibilities as assigned to support CCA's fundraising objectives and organizational mission.

Spiritual and Ministry Responsibilities

  • Actively participate in and, when appropriate, lead biblical devotions, worship, and group prayer.

  • Faithfully support the mission, leadership, employees, and ministry partners of CCA through regular intercessory prayer.

  • Provide biblical teaching and training to business owners and employees when invited and authorized.

  • When ordained and appropriately qualified, conduct funeral services and provide biblical counseling and spiritual care to business owners, employees, and their families, as opportunities arise.

  • Consistently demonstrate a Christ-centered character, biblical integrity, and a commitment to advancing CCA's mission through professional responsibilities and personal conduct.

Qualifications

Qualifications and Requirements

Spiritual Qualifications

  • Demonstrate a strong, growing personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a clear sense of God's calling to serve in Christian ministry.

  • Maintain a personal commitment to CCA's Christian mission and demonstrate a passion for advancing the ministry of corporate chaplaincy.

  • Affirm and uphold CCA's Statement of Faith.

  • Demonstrate alignment with CCA's Core Values and Missionary Mindset.

  • Respect CCA's Christian beliefs and consistently adhere to the organization's Christian Community Standards.

  • Actively participate in a local Christian church.

  • Exhibit personal integrity, spiritual maturity, and a lifestyle consistent with biblical principles and an authentic Christian faith.

Professional Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to identify, research, qualify, and cultivate prospective major donors with significant giving potential.

  • Ability to establish realistic, measurable fundraising goals based on individual donor giving history, financial capacity, and engagement potential.

  • Proven ability to develop and execute personalized donor cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship strategies that reflect individual interests, motivations, giving patterns, and communication preferences.

  • Ability to develop compelling fundraising proposals, presentations, and donor communications that clearly articulate ministry needs, opportunities, and measurable impact.

  • Demonstrated commitment to donor stewardship, including providing timely and meaningful updates regarding the use and impact of charitable contributions.

  • Ability to establish performance metrics, monitor fundraising progress, and prepare accurate, timely reports for organizational leadership.

  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust and establish meaningful relationships with diverse donors and ministry partners.

  • Ability to communicate CCA's mission, vision, and ministry impact with clarity, authenticity, and passion.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and donor relationships in a dynamic environment.

  • Demonstrate a positive, professional attitude and a collaborative, service-oriented approach.

  • Possess strong critical-thinking, creative problem-solving, and strategic planning abilities.

  • Demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, and the ability to independently identify opportunities and resolve challenges effectively.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree required.

  • Denominational ordination preferred.

  • Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in donor relations, fundraising, development, client relations, or a related field.

  • Experience cultivating major gifts and managing donor portfolios preferred.

  • Experience utilizing donor relationship management systems, particularly Salesforce, preferred.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

The physical demands and working conditions described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential job responsibilities.

  • Work is primarily performed in a remote office environment, with frequent travel to donor meetings, ministry events, and organizational functions.

  • Position requires extensive travel, generally exceeding 50%, which may include overnight stays and occasional evening or weekend commitments.

  • Physical exertion is generally minimal, with occasional periods of prolonged standing, walking, or sitting during meetings, travel, and events.

  • Regularly requires the ability to communicate effectively in person, by telephone, and through virtual communication platforms.

  • Frequently requires the use of computers, mobile devices, and standard office equipment.

  • May occasionally require bending, reaching, climbing stairs, or carrying lightweight materials associated with meetings and events.

  • Requires visual abilities sufficient to read documents, operate computer equipment, and perform essential job responsibilities, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Un grand groupe du secteur des services à l’environnement recherche un Product Owner métier GMAO pour accompagner la transition de son environnement Maximo vers Maximo Application Suite 9 (MAS 9).
Le programme s’appuie sur des équipes disposant d’une bonne connaissance de Maximo et sur un partenaire chargé de la configuration. Le PO portera la vision et les besoins métier, en interface avec les utilisateurs, les équipes SI et ce partenaire.

Votre rôle :

Vous traduisez les enjeux opérationnels de maintenance en besoins fonctionnels clairs et priorisés. Vous challengez les demandes, contribuez aux arbitrages et veillez à ce que la solution cible réponde aux usages des équipes.
Votre responsabilité porte principalement sur le contenu fonctionnel, la coordination métier et la validation des évolutions.

Vos principales missions :

1. Porter les besoins métier

  • Recueillir et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs de la GMAO.
  • Animer les ateliers avec les équipes de maintenance et d’exploitation.
  • Identifier les processus à conserver, à simplifier ou à faire évoluer lors de la transition.
  • Formaliser les exigences, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation.

2. Structurer le backlog et les arbitrages

  • Construire et maintenir le backlog produit.
  • Proposer les priorités en fonction de la valeur métier, des contraintes opérationnelles et des dépendances.
  • Challenger les demandes de reprise à l’identique et de développements spécifiques.
  • Préparer et documenter les arbitrages avec les parties prenantes.

3. Coordonner la mise en œuvre

  • Assurer l’interface entre les métiers, les équipes SI et le partenaire de configuration.
  • Clarifier les besoins et suivre leur traduction dans la solution.
  • Évaluer les conséquences fonctionnelles des choix proposés.
  • Contribuer à l’identification des dépendances avec les données et les applications connectées.

4. Organiser la validation et accompagner la transition

  • Définir les scénarios de recette à partir des usages métier.
  • Coordonner la participation des utilisateurs à la recette et suivre les anomalies.
  • Veiller à la couverture des besoins prioritaires avant le déploiement.
  • Contribuer à la préparation des supports utilisateurs et à l’accompagnement du changement.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en tant que Product Owner, responsable fonctionnel ou Business Analyst senior sur des projets de GMAO, avec une pratique fonctionnelle de Maximo.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Bonne maîtrise des processus de maintenance et de gestion des actifs : équipements, ordres de travail, maintenance préventive et corrective.
  • Expérience fonctionnelle concrète de Maximo.
  • Participation à une migration ou à une montée de version de Maximo.
  • Connaissance de Maximo Application Suite, idéalement MAS 9.
  • Participation à l’harmonisation de processus de maintenance entre plusieurs équipes ou sites.
  • Capacité à recueillir, challenger et prioriser des besoins métier.
  • Expérience de coordination entre utilisateurs, équipes SI et intégrateur.
  • Maîtrise de la formalisation des exigences et de la recette fonctionnelle.

Qualités attendues :

  • Écoute des utilisateurs et compréhension des réalités opérationnelles.
  • Capacité à challenger les demandes et à expliciter les compromis.
  • Rigueur dans la formalisation et le suivi des besoins.
  • Aisance pour faciliter les échanges entre interlocuteurs métier et techniques.
  • Capacité de synthèse et sens des priorités.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

raw.description:
Fluke Health Solutions is seeking a Senior Fortive Business System Leader(FBSL) to partner with business and functional leaders in applying FBS to the organization's most important priorities. This role translates strategic objectives, customer needs, and performance gaps into focused improvement strategies that deliver measurable and sustainable results.

The Senior FBSL prepares for and facilitates complex Kaizen events, leads structured problem solving, builds organizational capability, and creates followership without relying on positional authority. Success requires strong Lean and FBS fundamentals, business acumen, adaptability, self-directed learning, and effectiveness across virtual, hybrid, and in-person environments.

Who You Are

  • Experienced Lean and continuous improvement practitioner who connects strategy, Kaizen activity, and measurable results.
  • Skillful facilitator able to prepare for and lead multiple complex Kaizens concurrently without compromising quality or sustainment.
  • Influential leader who creates alignment and followership across functions and organizational levels.
  • Versatile coach and mentor who connects with L2 leaders, functional leaders, continuous improvement practitioners, FBSLs, and team members closest to FHS products and customers.
  • Structured problem solver with exposure to product, commercial, service, or customer-facing work and an aptitude for AI-enabled and digital tools.

Key Responsibilities Strategic Business Partnership

  • Serve as the FBS partner for assigned functions, sites, or priorities and understand their customers, processes, performance, and capability needs.
  • Translate strategic priorities and performance gaps into focused improvement plans, clear measures, actions, and operating cadences.
  • Constructively challenge assumptions, build stakeholder alignment, and communicate progress, results, risks, and support needs.

Kaizen Preparation, Facilitation, and Sustainment

  • Partner with leaders on complex Kaizens from scoping and prework through facilitation, implementation, and sustainment across operational, transactional, commercial, product, service, and customer-facing environments.
  • Prepare for and lead multiple Kaizens concurrently while maintaining planning quality, sponsor alignment, engagement, execution, and sustainment.
  • Provides leadership for large-scale President’s Kaizen and Shingijutsu events by orchestrating stakeholder alignment, event selection, logistics, executive engagement, and governance activities to deliver measurable business results and a high-impact participant experience.
  • Partner with sponsors and process owners to define the problem, scope, objectives, team, measures, customer outcomes, roles, risks, milestones, and expected results.
  • Engage team members closest to FHS customers, products, services, and processes, so their knowledge informs problem definition and solutions.
  • Guide teams through root-cause analysis, decisions, and countermeasure development while driving ownership and accountability.
  • Translate outcomes into implementation plans with clear ownership, and escalation expectations while monitoring their sustainment.
  • Facilitate effectively in virtual, hybrid, and in-person settings.

Problem Solving, Performance, and FBS Leadership

  • Lead structured problem solving using facts, process data, customer information, and a broad cross-functional perspective.
  • Select and apply the appropriate FBS approach rather than defaulting to a manufacturing-oriented solution.
  • Connect improvement work to strategic, financial, operational, commercial, quality, and customer KPIs.
  • Demonstrate advanced proficiency in multiple FBS tools and serve as a technical resource to leaders and practitioners.
  • Support policy deployment, daily management, business operations reviews, and improvement funnels so they drive decisions and action.

Coaching, Influence, and Capability Building

  • Coach individuals at all levels, from team members closest to FHS products and customers through L2 leaders, adapting style to the audience and situation.
  • Coach leaders in using FBS to set priorities, review performance, remove barriers, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Develop Champions and Practitioners through training, application, observation, feedback, and progressively greater ownership.
  • Set the standard for what good looks like for FBSLs in business partnership, prework, facilitation, sponsor engagement, problem solving, implementation, and sustainment.
  • Create followership through credibility, business understanding, candid communication, and consistent follow-through.
  • Transfer ownership to leaders and process owners rather than creating dependency on the FBS team.

Adaptability, Virtual Leadership, and Digital Improvement

  • Lead change through ambiguity and shifting priorities while maintaining focus on business outcomes.
  • Build productive relationships across functions, sites, cultures, and time zones using virtual collaboration and visual management.
  • Apply AI, automation, analytics, and digital tools responsibly to defined business needs and share practical learning.

Qualifications Required

  • Eight or more years of progressive experience in continuous improvement, operations, product, service, commercial, customer-facing, or another relevant environment.
  • Five or more years of hands-on experience applying Lean, FBS, or comparable continuous-improvement fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex Kaizens from problem definition and prework through implementation and sustainment, including multiple concurrent events.
  • Project-management capability within a Kaizen environment, including scope, milestones, ownership, risks, measures, stakeholder alignment, and implementation planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate cross-functional problem solving, coach from frontline team members through L2 leaders, and influence without direct authority.
  • Exposure to product, commercial, service, or customer-facing work sufficient to understand customer-centered challenges and commercial problem solving.
  • Strong business acumen, communication, facilitation, adaptability, independent judgment, and self-directed learning.
  • Aptitude for AI-enabled tools, analytics, automation, and digital collaboration.
  • Ability to lead virtually and travel up to one week per month.

What Success Looks Like

  • Multiple Kaizens are prepared for and facilitated concurrently with strong participation, measurable results, clear ownership, and sustained performance.
  • L2 leaders and team members closest to FHS products and customers are effectively engaged, and their perspectives are connected in improvement decisions.
  • Leaders, process owners, Champions, Practitioners, and FBSLs demonstrate increased capability and ownership.
  • Improvement activity is prioritized around customer and business impact and supported by disciplined problem solving.
  • Relevant AI and digital capabilities improve productivity, analysis, decision-making, or customer outcomes.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We're looking for an experienced payroll specialist to join Rippling’s Global Payroll Operations team. We are rapidly expanding Rippling to serve the needs of employees and employers all over the world. Our Global Payroll Operations team plays a critical role in ensuring the success of our global payroll products, which are natively built and fully integrated with Rippling’s broader suite of products.

As Rippling expands its product offerings globally, there is a critical business need for Rippling to develop new muscles around global product operations and country-specific payroll expertise outside of the US.

This role, Global Payroll Operations Specialist, is a critical hire for the Global Payroll Operations team that will be fully dedicated to developing and executing these new capabilities. This role will own all operational aspects across select countries, relationships with our external partners, and drive our expansion into new customer segments and geographies. Additionally, this role brings critical country-specific payroll expertise to support the development of our natively built payroll software.

This is an exciting role that requires significant cross-departmental engagement with a major impact on the product and customer experience.

Direct experience working with major Investor-Owned Utilities (IOUs), municipal utilities, public utility districts, and electric cooperatives. Advanced knowledge of utility construction methods, utility contract structures, labor productivity factors, and cost estimating principles. Knowledge of utility work methods, grid modernization programs, wildfire mitigation programs, underground distribution, and transmission line construction. raw.excerpt: Ciklum is looking for a Senior Account Director to join our team full-time in the US.
raw.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Account Director to join our team full-time in the US.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Account Director, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. We are a custom product engineering and digital transformation company supporting both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts, and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

Ciklum is experiencing rapid growth, with the United States representing our primary strategic growth market. We are inviting experienced leadership professionals to drive high-impact digital transformations alongside premier West Coast technology companies, global retail brands, and innovative consumer financial platforms.

As an Account Director, you will serve as a key commercial leader and B2C Subject Matter Expert across our US West Coast region. In this high-visibility role, you will be responsible for scaling established enterprise B2C accounts across the West Coast tech and consumer landscape, while actively driving commercial development and expansion into key regional and global brands spanning Retail, Consumer Financial Services, and Consumer Tech.

Combining deep domain expertise in consumer digital experiences with strategic account management, you will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, guiding complex digital transformation initiatives, omnichannel commerce modernizations, and customer-facing digital products. You will champion AI-driven customer transformations, modern product delivery, and digital execution techniques to maximize customer engagement, retention, and account growth. You will partner closely with global delivery management, technical practice leads, and executive leadership to drive substantial business impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Account Leadership & Growth: Own and execute comprehensive portfolio plans for our strategic West Coast B2C accounts across Retail, Consumer Finance, and Tech. Formulate long-term account strategies rooted in a deep understanding of consumer behavior, omnichannel engagement, platform scalability, and client business goals
  • AI Transformation & B2C Innovation: Guide clients on leveraging Enterprise AI, Generative AI, and predictive analytics to power personalized customer journeys, modern commerce engines, automated support frameworks, and intelligent consumer applications
  • Commercial & Pipeline Development: Actively identify, qualify, and close expansion opportunities within existing strategic B2C accounts while supporting new-logo acquisition across the West Coast market. Lead end-to-end sales and expansion efforts from initial opportunity shaping through contract execution
  • Domain SME & C-Suite Engagement: Function as a Subject Matter Expert in consumer engagement and B2C digital ecosystems. Engage with C-Level Executives (CIOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Heads of Product/Engineering) to articulate Ciklum’s value proposition in modernizing digital touchpoints, mobile applications, and core platform capabilities
  • P&L & Portfolio Accountability: Take ownership of account-level P&L across your portfolio, including revenue growth, margin optimization, forecasting accuracy, statement of work (SOW) structuring, and commercial governance
  • Modern Digital Delivery Governance: Advocate for agile product development, DevOps/DevSecOps practices, cloud-native architectures, and AI-assisted engineering tools to deliver high-velocity product iterations and high reliability for mission-critical consumer applications
  • Matrix Leadership & Escalation: Collaborate with cross-functional delivery teams (onshore, nearshore, and offshore) to ensure flawless program delivery, contract adherence, proactive risk management, and market-leading Net Promoter Scores (NPS)
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with global practice leads (Data & AI, Cloud Engineering, Product Design, Experience Engineering) to design and package custom solutions engineered for high-scale B2C environments
  • Partnership Growth Focus: Takes ownership of some domain focused partnerships with regional partners to accelerate growth

Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum of 10+ years in technology consulting, IT services, digital transformation, or custom software engineering, with at least 8+ years dedicated specifically to account management, client relationship leadership, and commercial growth
  • B2C & Multi-Vertical SME: Demonstrated background managing enterprise accounts within Retail, Consumer Financial Services (e.g., neobanks, consumer payments, wealthtech), and Consumer Tech platforms. Practical consulting experience in high-volume, customer-facing digital ecosystems is required
  • West Coast Market Presence: Proven track record of navigating, growing, and managing enterprise accounts across the US West Coast technology and corporate landscape
  • Experience operating within fast-paced, matrixed environments utilizing global delivery models (onshore/nearshore/offshore)
    AI & Digital Product Fluency: Strong understanding of how AI/ML, personalization engines, data pipelines, and cloud platform modernizations are applied to solve modern consumer engagement and operational challenges
  • Digital Delivery & Tooling Acumen: Hands-on familiarity with modern software development methodologies (Agile at scale, CI/CD, modern microservices frameworks) and delivery tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps, AI engineering tools) to engage credibly with engineering and product leaders
  • Enterprise Sales & Account Expansion: Proven history of consistently meeting and exceeding multi-million-dollar booking quotas, revenue targets, and portfolio profitability metrics in consumer tech/digital service accounts
  • Executive Presence & Pitching: Exceptional capability to build trust with C-Level executives, framing technical capabilities into clear, quantifiable business outcomes (CAC reduction, LTV growth, platform throughput, conversion rate optimization)
  • Commercial & Contractual Acumen: Expert capability in deal structuring, MSA/SOW negotiations, team ramp models, and outcome-focused pricing structures

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: Healthcare, Basic Life Insurance, Short and Long-term disability insurance according to the Company’s Benefit Plans

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress. In the US, Ciklum is growing fast—inviting experienced professionals to lead digital transformation alongside Fortune 500 clients. Be part of a company where innovation and impact go hand in hand.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

raw.title: Senior Network Engineer
raw.excerpt: Position SummaryMAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments.
raw.description:
Position Summary

MAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments. You'll design robust network solutions that ensure seamless connectivity, security, and performance while supporting digital transformation initiatives and multi-tenant secure environments.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop network monitoring, automation, and performance optimization strategies
  • Configure and manage Microsoft Azure networking services (VNets, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Network Security Groups)
  • Evaluate, re-evaluate, understand, and support existing/legacy network requirements, including documenting and extending/revisiting implementations
  • Design and implement enterprise network architectures for hybrid cloud environments
  • Work with other IT cross-functional teams for collaboration where networkoperations could be impacted
  • Deploy and maintain Fortinet security appliances (FortiGate firewalls, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager)
  • Configure and optimize Cisco enterprise networking equipment (switches, routers, wireless controllers)
  • Implement network segmentation and microsegmentation strategies for secure multi-tenant environments
  • Design and deploy software-defined WAN (SD-WAN) solutions
  • Configure quality of service (QoS) for business-critical applications

Secondary Responsibilities

  • Support cybersecurity compliance requirements
  • Implement zero-trust network security architectures
  • Design and configure network access control (NAC) solutions
  • Perform network security assessments and vulnerability remediation
  • Implement advanced threat protection and intrusion prevention systems
  • Support compliance requirements (SOX, PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2)
  • Manage network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives
  • Provide escalation support for complex network issues
  • Implement network security controls (encryption, authentication, segmentation)
  • Design and configure firewall rules and intrusion detection
  • Perform network vulnerability assessments
  • Implement zero-trust network architectures

Requirements

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering
  • Advanced Knowledge of routing, switching, and network protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, STP, VLANs, QoS, etc.)
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure networking (Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Application Gateway, Microsoft Entra ID)
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls and security appliances (Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto,etc.)
  • Experience with FortiGate SD-WAN implementation
  • Experience with Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE)
  • Experience troubleshooting network security protocols (IPSec, SSL/TLS, 802.1X)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Cisco enterprise equipment (Catalyst switches, ISR/ASR routers, Wireless LAN Controllers)
  • Experience with network automation tools (Ansible, Terraform, Python scripting)
  • Understanding of container networking (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience with SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela, Silver Peak, VeloCloud)
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (FortiManager, PRTG, Nagios)
  • Experience with secure remote access solutions (VPN, ZTNA)
  • CCNA/CCNP, Azure certifications, or Fortinet NSE certifications

Clearance:

  • Must be eligible for Secret Security Clearance
  • US Citizenship required

Special Note

The position is contingent upon candidate’s ability to meet physical and medical requirements as needed by the position; including compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local jurisdictional requirements.

Benefits and Compensation

At MAG Aerospace, we value your contributions providing our employees with a robust Total Rewards package that supports your total well-being. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in MAG's Total Rewards programs. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits as well as paid leave, professional development, and tuition assistance. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our Total Rewards Program by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site: Salary at MAG Aerospace is determined by various factors including but not limited to location, the particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $97500 to $162500 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of MAG's total compensation package for employees.

raw.description:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Isso não poderia ser diferente com o nosso principal combustível: as pessoas!

Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.

Buscamos profissionais inovadores que sejam movidos por desafios e focados em resultados.

Se você busca uma empresa dinâmica e parceira e que investe em seus colaboradores através de capacitação constante, a Leega é o lugar para você!

>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

  • Construir e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados em batch e streaming com BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub e Cloud Storage.
  • Modelar e organizar o Data Lake/Lakehouse em BigQuery e BigLake, com camadas, particionamento e otimização de custo e performance.
  • Definir contratos de dados (schemas, freshness e SLAs) e monitorar a qualidade e a linhagem das fontes.
  • Preparar dados para IA: limpeza, anonimização, chunking e geração de embeddings para Vertex AI RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search e vector stores.
  • Garantir conformidade com a LGPD no tratamento de dados sensíveis de saúde, aplicando mascaramento, anonimização (Sensitive Data Protection), policy tags e residência de dados antes que esses dados cheguem aos ambientes de IA.
  • Desenhar acesso a dados entre projetos (Cloud IAM, Dataplex, BigLake, Analytics Hub) evitando cópias, com menor privilégio e trilha de auditoria.
  • Disponibilizar dados e sistemas internos como ferramentas para agentes via servidores MCP e MCP Toolbox, apoiando o time de IA na integração com Vertex AI Agent Engine e Agent Development Kit (ADK).
  • Manter pipelines de MLOps/LLMOps com Vertex AI Pipelines, incluindo avaliação, guardrails (Model Armor) e monitoramento de drift e qualidade das respostas.
  • Provisionar a infraestrutura de dados e IA como código com Terraform e CI/CD, e acompanhar custos por área, projeto e modelo (FinOps) com billing export para BigQuery e labels.
  • Implementar observabilidade ponta a ponta (OpenTelemetry, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace) e apoiar estratégias de resiliência e disaster recovery.

    Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Domínio de Python e SQL.
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados no GCP: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow ou Dataproc e Pub/Sub.
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (Cloud Composer/Airflow, Cloud Workflows ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados no GCP: Cloud IAM, Dataplex, policy tags e Cloud KMS.
  • Terraform e CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou similares).
  • Experiência prática em ambientes GCP com múltiplos projetos, organização e folders.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (filas, retries, idempotência e consistência).
  • Experiência preparando dados para ao menos uma aplicação com LLM em produção (RAG ou agentes com uso de ferramentas).
  • Conhecimento de LGPD aplicada a dados sensíveis, incluindo técnicas de anonimização e mascaramento.

    Diferenciais

  • Vertex AI (RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search, Agent Engine, Pipelines), Gemini e Model Armor.
  • Frameworks de agentes (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) e desenvolvimento de servidores MCP.
  • Vector stores (Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB com pgvector, BigQuery Vector Search); GraphRAG é um plus.
  • Experiência no setor de saúde ou com padrões de dados clínicos (HL7, FHIR, Cloud Healthcare API).
  • Data Mesh, arquitetura hub-and-spoke e FinOps no GCP.
  • Certificação Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Professional Machine Learning Engineer ou FinOps Certified Practitioner.

    • Competências comportamentais

  • Comunicação clara com cientistas de dados, times de IA, áreas de negócio e parceiros externos.
  • Disciplina de segurança e ética no tratamento de dados sensíveis de pacientes, especialmente quando consumidos por agentes autônomos.
  • Capacidade de explicitar trade-offs técnicos (cópia de dados vs. acesso entre projetos, batch vs. streaming, custo vs. latência).
  • Hábito de documentar e atribuir ownership de pipelines, fontes de dados e ferramentas entre os times.

Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. A true underwriting company, we have a 200-year history of helping our customers manage risk with laser-focused expertise, integrity and discipline. Our people are empowered to make decisions and problem-solve with you smartly and swiftly. Our annual gross written premium is 6.2 billion. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. With our employee-first focus, the Company is consistently recognized as a great place to work, earning multiple workplace and wellness awards, including the Great Place to Work® Award, Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For, Fortune Best Workplaces for Parents, Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials, and many others.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

Travel Insured International, a Crum & Forster company, is hiring a Customer Service Representative.

Travel Insured International is a leading travel insurance provider with more than 30 years in business. As a key component of our Specialty Business Unit, within the Accident & Health division, TII provides travel protection plans to help each individual travel confidently. Travel Insured International is proud to offer products to consumers and to agency partners of all sizes. We're committed to providing dependable coverage, great value, and customer satisfaction.

Because protecting travelers' journeys isn’t just our business—it’s our promise. Our promise to protect every traveler, every experience, every time. Travel Insured International travel protection meets our travelers in the moments that matter. We are here. Go be there.

Travel Insured International is hiring our next class of Customer Service Representatives to join our growing organization! Join us!

Our Customer Service Representatives deliver exceptional service to our callers, which include travelers and our extensive travel advisor community.

Interested in this role, but don’t have Customer Service experience? Our Customer Service Representatives are provided with training and tools to begin your career! Our structured training program includes licensing training, classroom training on everything Customer Care at TII, and a collaborative mentor stage that allows for practical application of your new knowledge.

We are proud that some of our best Customer Service Representatives have gone on to other parts of our organization, including, Claims, Product and our Quality Management teams, to name a few!

We are pleased to offer 100% remote working schedules within the US. The Customer Service department is open from 7:45AM – 7:15PM EST. Shift times include 7:45am -4:15pm, 9:00am-5:30pm, and 10:45am-7:15pm. Scheduled shifts are determined by business need and may be subject to change.

Job Description

What you will do:

  • Answer inbound calls
  • Provide accurate, clear and timely responses to a variety of traveler and travel advisor calls that will include, but not be limited to travel insurance coverage questions, website troubleshooting, purchase inquires and agent support requests

  • Customer-Centric: skilled at prioritizing their needs and experiences, understanding what they want and delivering exceptional service.
  • Sales Focused: Ability to effectively communicate the value of TII’s offerings and tailored solutions to travelers insurance needs.
  • Effective Listening: Including active listening and empathy
  • Effective Communication Skills: Both written communication skills, targeting information, comments and explanations in a manner appropriate to the needs of the audience and verbally by phone/
  • Ability to resolve service issues and complaints, leveraging problem-solving and service skills to achieve an appropriate outcome promptly and effectively with a great deal of independence.

Requirements:

  • A High School Diploma or GED is required
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer service or retail role is required; call center experience preferred
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications is required. Includes MS Word, Outlook and Teams.
  • A Personal Lines or Property & Casualty License is required for this role. Classroom training is provided.
  • Experience in the Travel Insurance industry is preferred.
  • Dependable internet connection with a dedicated private workspace.

What C&F will bring to you

What C&F will bring to YOU:

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenant is owning your career development so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you require a special accommodation, please let us know.

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. The annualized base pay for the advertised position, located in the specified area, ranges from a minimum of $31,100 to a maximum of $58,500. raw.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.

In this role, you will build and run the infrastructure and tooling behind the platform's products - from AWS and Kubernetes environments, through CI/CD pipelines, to the observability stack - for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who manages infrastructure through code and automation, owns the reliability of what they deploy, and works closely with developers to get code to production.

Technology stack:

  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, EKS)

  • Containerization & orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Docker Compose

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Helm

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry

  • Programming & scripting: Python, Go, shell scripting

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (RDS), event streaming and CDC, RabbitMQ, MQTT

  • Security & compliance: IAM, SOC 2 controls, OAuth2

  • APIs: REST, gRPC

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of reliability, security and automation

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone whose working hours can overlap with the US East Coast

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow - Claude Code is used heavily across the team

  • This is an infrastructure-focused role, working closely with the product teams to connect code to production

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building and maintaining infrastructure for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform

  • Operating and optimizing AWS infrastructure (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS) for cost, security and performance

  • Managing infrastructure as code with Terraform and Helm

  • Building and improving CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions and internal platform tooling that lets developers serve themselves

  • Improving monitoring, alerting and incident response, and defining SLOs (Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki)

  • Helping enforce security and compliance standards, including SOC 2 controls

  • Working closely with the product teams to get code to production reliably

  • Contributing to documentation and onboarding, and taking part in the on-call rotation

  • Using Claude Code day to day: setting constraints, reviewing the output and staying accountable for correctness and security

Do we have a match?

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering

  • Strong experience with AWS, especially EKS and Kubernetes

  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform and Helm

  • CI/CD experience (ideally GitHub Actions)

  • Experience with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir or Loki, and with OpenTelemetry

  • Proficiency in Python, Go or shell scripting

  • Experience with CDC and event streaming, or with scaling large multi-tenant observability systems

  • Comfort in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI coding tools (ideally Claude Code)

  • Strong communication and documentation skills

  • Availability for an on-call rotation and working hours overlapping with the US East Coast

  • Good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level)

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with SOC 2 or other security-focused environments

  • Experience with messaging technologies such as MQTT or AMQP (e.g. RabbitMQ)

  • Familiarity with network source-of-truth or network automation tooling

  • Open-source contributions

  • Experience working in a B2B software startup (ideally 2+ years)

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

Position Summary:

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. This includes assembling, preparing, reviewing, and verifying loan closing documents while ensuring compliance with all applicable state, federal, and regulatory requirements. This role manages an active pipeline of transactions to ensure files are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with established service level agreements while delivering high-quality support to clients, lenders, and settlement partners.

Essential Functions:

  • Assemble, prepare, review, and verify all documents required for loan closings, including contracts, settlement statements, closing disclosures, mortgages, deeds, and title policies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare preliminary and final settlement statements, including Closing Disclosures (CD) and ALTA statements, and manage revisions and approvals as needed.
  • Review and revise closing documents to meet lender requirements, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, investor, and company guidelines prior to transmitting finalized packages to settlement agents.
  • Coordinate the closing process, including scheduling and execution of document signings, while ensuring all required documentation is complete prior to closing.
  • Perform final pre-closing reviews of title fees, taxes, premiums, endorsements, vesting, and all checklist items to ensure readiness for closing.
  • Serve as a liaison between lenders, title companies, borrowers, and settlement agents, maintaining clear and timely communication to ensure expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including disbursement and post-closing, to ensure a seamless transition from closing through funding and recording.
  • Support post-closing activities, including revisions to CDs or ALTA statements and overall file completion.
  • Manage an active pipeline of files, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and established service level agreements.
  • Provide operational support across all workflow stages, including back-office functions, and assist with coverage needs such as on-call, alternate shifts, and weekend support as required.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines.
  • Capable of generating a high degree of respect and trust to develop, maintain strong relationships with business partners across all levels of stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely present issues, ideas and recommendations in verbal, written and presentation formats.
  • Highly motivated, inquisitive, self-started with the ability to multi-task and effectively manage priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

Education, Formal Training, and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required, Baccalaureate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years’ experience with title or closing company preferred.
  • Strong customer service skills required.
  • National title closing experience preferable.

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, is frequently required to sit, is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to type & reach with hands and arms. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

VIP Corporate Travel Consultant (Morning Shift)

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

Our VIP Corporate Travel Consultants will need to provide a high level of consultation and accuracy during all aspects of the travel experience, including pre-booking consultation, and the reservation process from beginning to end. Candidate must have in-depth travel industry knowledge, exceptional problem-solving skills, while maintaining the highest degree of professionalism and courtesy.

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks training (paid). This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs.

The schedule for this role will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM ET, Monday – Friday.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional, personalized service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff, establishing strong rapport and ensuring all interactions are handled with professionalism.
  • Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, creating unique travel itineraries that meet the specific needs and expectations of high-level executives.
  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent experience as a VIP or Executive Travel Agent
  • 5+ years of high-end customer service experience within the travel industry
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Job Title: Director of Engineering, Internal Platforms

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We’re looking for a highly technical, hands-on Director of Engineering to lead the architecture, development, and scalability of the internal platforms powering our operations, data workflows, and business ecosystem.

You’ll own the engineering direction of mission-critical systems while overseeing quality engineering, ensuring our platforms are reliable, scalable, and built for automation.

This role requires a strong technical leader who stays close to the code, drives architectural decisions, and leverages AI-powered tools and modern engineering practices to accelerate development. You’ll lead engineering teams, establish technical standards, and deliver systems that simplify complex operations at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Lead Internal Platform Engineering: Own the architecture, development, and scalability of platforms supporting operational workflows, expert lifecycle management, data collection, analytics, and business processes.
  2. Build Intelligent Systems: Integrate LLMs, AI agents, and automation into internal platforms to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency.
  3. Drive Platform Architecture: Design scalable APIs, distributed services, event-driven systems, and integrations connecting onboarding, assessments, subscriptions, data pipelines, and financial workflows.
  4. Own Quality Engineering: Lead QE strategy, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD quality gates, release validation, and production reliability across platforms.
  5. Advance Testing Automation: Implement AI-assisted testing, automated regression coverage, and evaluation frameworks for traditional and AI-powered applications.
  6. Stay Hands-On: Drive technical design, contribute to implementation, review code, troubleshoot production issues, and resolve complex engineering challenges.
  7. Improve Engineering Productivity: Introduce AI-assisted development workflows, developer tooling, and automation to accelerate delivery while maintaining engineering quality.
  8. Lead Engineering Teams: Mentor engineers, establish technical standards, drive execution, and foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and accountability.
  9. Partner Cross-Functionally: Work with Product, AI/ML, Data, and Operations to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

What We’re Looking For

  1. 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years in engineering leadership roles.
  2. Strong hands-on development expertise in Python, TypeScript, or similar languages, with recent experience building and debugging production systems.
  3. Deep experience in platform architecture, including distributed systems, microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and workflow orchestration.
  4. Practical experience with AI-powered systems, including LLM integrations, agentic workflows, RAG, and evaluation frameworks.
  5. Experience leveraging AI development tools and automation to improve engineering productivity and delivery.
  6. Strong Quality Engineering expertise, including automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, API and end-to-end testing, and production reliability.
  7. Cloud infrastructure proficiency with AWS, GCP, or Azure, Kubernetes, databases, observability, and DevOps practices.
  8. Experience building internal platforms supporting operational workflows, data pipelines, analytics, or complex business processes.
  9. Proven technical leadership, with the ability to mentor engineers, make architectural decisions, and deliver in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience in AI research labs, AI-native companies, or high-growth technology startups.
  2. Experience with human data platforms, including expert management, data annotation, human-in-the-loop workflows, data curation, and AI evaluation pipelines.
  3. Familiarity with LLM training and evaluation workflows, including human feedback, preference data, and model benchmarking.
  4. Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Temporal, or similar technologies.
  5. Experience building internal developer platforms, shared infrastructure, or self-service engineering tools.
  6. Familiarity with AI-assisted testing, automated test generation, and evaluation of nondeterministic systems.

The role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping the organization navigate complex regulatory requirements while supporting growth, innovation, and new business initiatives.

This company is one of the world's leading providers of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure, enterprise digital solutions, cloud computing platforms, and smart devices. Established in the late 1980s and headquartered in China, the organization operates across more than 170 countries and is globally recognized for its leadership in telecommunications technology, 5G innovation, artificial intelligence, and enterprise digital transformation.

The company maintains a strong international reputation through continuous investment in advanced technologies including cloud computing, networking infrastructure, enterprise storage, optical transmission, cybersecurity, and intelligent collaboration platforms. Its large-scale R&D ecosystem and commitment to technological innovation position the organization as a strategic technology partner for governments, telecommunications operators, financial institutions, and enterprise clients worldwide.

In Indonesia, the organization plays a major role in supporting national digital transformation initiatives across sectors such as government, banking, telecommunications, logistics, manufacturing, and smart city development through strategic ICT infrastructure projects and enterprise technology solutions.

Job Role:

To strengthen its enterprise business expansion within Indonesia's Financial Services Industry (FSI) sector, the company is enhancing its strategic account management capabilities across key banking and financial institution accounts. Salesforce Solutions Consultant

Solutions | United States (Remote) | Full-Time | NAM

Who We Are

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

You'll be the person prospects watch when they want to see Salesforce solve their problem in a live org. In this presales seat you design, build and deliver tailored demonstrations across the Salesforce Core platform, turning what you learn in discovery into a working story inside a live org. A typical week mixes discovery calls, demo builds, RFP responses and deal strategy sessions with our Account Executives. You'll field the hard product, architecture and integration questions in the room, then work with our delivery team so what gets sold is scoped to land. It's a hands-on role for someone who would rather configure the product than talk about it, with occasional travel for customer meetings, demos and team events.

What you'll do

  • Build tailored demos end to end, mapped to each prospect's own requirements and use cases.

  • Own the demo orgs, keeping environments, sample data and reusable scenarios current and presentation-ready.

  • Lead discovery sessions that surface business pain, technical requirements and success criteria, then shape the solution story.

  • Partner with Account Executives on solution strategy, value positioning and technical objections through the sales cycle.

  • Answer RFPs and RFIs and technical questionnaires, and support proof-of-concept and pilot engagements.

  • Keep proposals realistic with delivery and product teams, so every solution is scoped accurately and set up to implement well.

  • Bring new releases into your demos as the Salesforce roadmap moves, especially Agentforce and Data Cloud.

What you'll bring

  • Hands-on Salesforce depth: 5 to 7 years configuring, building and demonstrating on the platform.

  • Presales experience as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Presales Consultant, or in a demo-focused role.

  • Multi-cloud range to demo Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Data Cloud (Data 360), Experience Cloud and Agentforce with confidence.

  • Consultative discovery skills that connect a business problem to the right platform capability.

  • Presence in the room to tell a clear story, run a live demo and handle technical questions on the spot.

  • Self-directed remote working, comfortable running your own week across a fully distributed team.

  • Bonus points for Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Sales, Service or Data Cloud Consultant, Agentforce Specialist) or partner and SI experience.

Why this role, why now

Salesforce clients want to see Agentforce and Data Cloud working against their own use cases before they commit. As a Salesforce Summit Partner growing on private equity backing, BPX gives you the platform breadth and the customer conversations to show them, across Sales, Service, Data and Experience Cloud.

Additional information

Benefits include medical insurance, 401(k), PTO, sick leave and remote working.

Equal Employment Opportunity. Bluprintx is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications and business need. We are committed to an accessible recruitment process and will consider requests for reasonable accommodation at any stage, contact us to discuss what you need.
