raw.description:
Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find It

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. transportation operations with a focus on freight evaluation, load selection, mileage calculations, and operational planning.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have relevant exposure to U.S. trucking or transportation operations and a working understanding of freight load boards.

The right candidate should understand that a load cannot be evaluated by rate alone. Deadhead, loaded miles, equipment, appointments, driver availability, Hours of Service, and operating requirements all affect whether freight makes sense for a truck.

What You'll Evaluate

  • Search DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Compare available freight by lane, equipment type, mileage, rate, and appointment requirements.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Identify excessive deadhead and inefficient freight options.
  • Review pickup and delivery schedules for operational feasibility.
  • Consider available driver Hours of Service when evaluating loads.
  • Determine whether available equipment is appropriate for the freight.
  • Identify potential delays, accessorial considerations, and unusual load requirements.
  • Organize suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.

Understanding Freight Economics

Freight evaluation requires looking beyond the advertised load rate.

You will be expected to understand how factors such as:

  • Loaded mileage
  • Deadhead mileage
  • Rate per mile
  • Equipment type
  • Pickup and delivery appointments
  • Driver Hours of Service
  • Freight lanes
  • Driver location and availability
  • Potential detention or other accessorial situations

affect the operational value of a load.

Applicants should be comfortable working with mileage calculations, spreadsheets, freight information, and basic trip economics.

Relevant Transportation Background

Prior professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Relevant experience or knowledge may come from:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Owner-operator or fleet operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Logistics or transportation operations

Applicants must have enough U.S. trucking knowledge to understand basic freight terminology, equipment, mileage, lanes, and load-board information.

Essential Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with freight load boards such as DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable systems.
  • Understanding of common equipment types including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Ability to calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total miles, and rate per mile.
  • Basic understanding of U.S. freight lanes.
  • Working understanding of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with drivers, brokers, carriers, and transportation personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Computer proficiency and reliable internet access.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Verify freight information before presenting loads for review.
  • Communicate load information accurately to drivers and authorized operations personnel.
  • Assist with pickup and delivery scheduling.
  • Review rate confirmations and load information for consistency with agreed terms.
  • Monitor active shipments and document operational changes.
  • Maintain accurate load and dispatch records.
  • Escalate broker-verification, safety, compliance, service, or documentation concerns.
  • Maintain professional and timely communication throughout assigned operations.

Work Arrangement

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. transportation operations.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. trucking operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, dependable communication capability, and a professional remote-work environment.

raw.excerpt: Company OverviewCircet USA is the leading provider of Network Services in North America, and we're looking for talented professionals to join our team.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Circet USA is the leading provider of Network Services in North America, and we're looking for talented professionals to join our team. We specialize in engineering and construction services delivering comprehensive solutions across Inside Plant, Outside Plant, and Wireless networks to meet the evolving infrastructure needs of our customers.

With nearly 50 years of industry experience, we work with major telecom service providers, MSOs, cloud service providers, and utilities. At Circet USA, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact by helping to create customized solutions that address our clients' unique challenges. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Circet USA’s benefits package includes the following:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Digital Health & Wellness Support
  • Critical Illness, Accident, & Hospital Insurance
  • Short-term & Long-term disability
  • Group term & Voluntary life insurance
  • Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts
  • Paid Time Off & 401K
  • Company Discount Website

Job Summary and Responsibilities

SUMMARY

Circet USA is a premier technology infrastructure design, build, and maintain partner. The Director, Project Management Office (PMO) will build and lead the Data Center Services PMO and Primavera P6 scheduling department. This hands-on leader establishes the project delivery framework, project controls, scheduling standards, governance, tools, reporting, and talent needed to support rapid growth and consistent execution across the project portfolio.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES include the following; other duties may be assigned:

  • Define the PMO charter, operating model, roles, decision rights, governance cadence, and project delivery framework from preconstruction handoff through closeout and customer turnover.
  • Establish common standards and templates for project kickoffs, stage gates, risk and issue logs, change management, lessons learned, closeout, and customer reporting.
  • Select and implement the PMO tools and reporting stack in partnership with IT, Finance, Operations, Sales, and Estimating.
  • Build and lead the Primavera P6 scheduling department, including its mission, organization, staffing plan, hiring, training, career paths, and operating standards.
  • Serve as the business unit authority for P6 enterprise structure, coding, calendars, permissions, templates, baselines, resource loading, and update protocols.
  • Develop repeatable schedule templates for data center scopes, including structured cabling, phased data hall turnover, and commissioning support.
  • Require sound critical path method schedules and lead schedule-quality reviews using recognized criteria such as the DCMA 14-point assessment.
  • Oversee look-ahead schedules, recovery plans, delay analyses, and time impact analyses supporting change orders and claims.
  • Align Circet schedules with owner, customer, and general contractor master schedules and reporting requirements.
  • Provide leadership with an integrated view of portfolio health across schedule, cost, margin, safety, quality, staffing, change, and risk.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting, estimates at completion, change-order tracking, work-in-progress reviews, and margin performance.
  • Lead monthly portfolio reviews, identify at-risk projects early, and present data-supported recovery recommendations to the SVP.
  • Define and maintain key performance indicators for project delivery, PMO effectiveness, schedule quality, and portfolio performance.
  • Forecast labor and resource demand across backlog and pipeline, identify capacity constraints, and connect training capacity to project demand.
  • Support Sales and Estimating with schedule development, delivery plans, and customer-facing project-controls content.
  • Recruit, coach, and develop PMO and scheduling professionals; train project managers, superintendents, and field leaders on standards and tools.
  • Build a culture of accurate reporting, early escalation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers for change management and change order execution on their assigned project/s.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to Project Managers as applies to project budget management, job cost control, and earned value management on their assigned project/s.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and ability required.

  • Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be substituted.
  • 10+ years of project delivery, project controls, or scheduling experience in data center, mission-critical, telecommunications, or complex infrastructure construction.
  • 5+ years leading a PMO, project controls group, scheduling team, or leading large-scale delivery.
  • Demonstrated success building or substantially rebuilding a PMO or scheduling function in a rapid-growth environment.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Primavera P6, critical path method scheduling, schedule logic, baselines, resource loading, and schedule-quality review.
  • Experience with recovery schedules, delay analysis, time impact analysis, and change orders tied to schedule impacts.
  • Working knowledge of contractor financials, including forecasting, estimates at completion, margin, and work in progress.
  • Experience reporting to executives and working directly with owners, customers, and general contractors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Direct experience supporting hyperscale or colocation data center delivery.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, methods of procedure (MOPs), commissioning levels, TIA-942, and BICSI standards.
  • PMP, PMI-SP, AACE PSP, or AACE CCP certification.
  • Experience with Power BI or a similar reporting platform and construction management software such as Procore.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed or similarly high-growth services business.
  • Experience with field-services workforces and labor-capacity planning.

COMPETENCIES

  • Strategic Leadership and PMO Development
  • Primavera P6 and Project Scheduling
  • Project Controls and Portfolio Governance
  • Financial Acumen and Performance Reporting
  • Risk, Change, and Claims Management
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Influence
  • Executive and Customer Communication
  • Talent Development and Change Adoption

SUCCESS MEASURES

  • Within 30 days: current projects, tools, and reporting gaps assessed; PMO charter and hiring plan approved.
  • Within 90 days: P6 environment and standards defined; initial schedulers hired or assigned; monthly portfolio review operating; highest-risk projects on P6 schedules.
  • Within 6 months: all new projects launched using standard templates and stage gates; portfolio dashboard live; schedule-quality reviews established.
  • Within 12 months: all active projects baselined in P6; PMO and scheduling teams staffed to plan; labor forecasts informing capacity decisions; function prepared to support continued growth.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex business, construction, contractual, and technical documents; ability to respond effectively to sensitive inquiries and communicate clearly with executives, customers, general contractors, and field teams.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to calculate and interpret percentages, rates, variances, productivity, forecast-to-complete values, margins, schedule performance, earned-value indicators, and other project and financial measures; ability to apply basic algebra and quantitative reasoning.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to define problems, collect and validate data, establish facts, evaluate alternatives, identify cause and effect, and draw sound conclusions in situations involving multiple variables, competing priorities, and incomplete information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this position, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle objects, tools, or controls; talk; and hear. The employee is frequently required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role combines office or remote work with regular travel to active project sites and customer locations. Site visits may require personal protective equipment and compliance with site safety, security, and access requirements. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

TRAVEL

Anticipated travel is up to 30% based on business need, including project-site visits and customer-facing engagements.

Circet USA is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer of females, minorities, veterans and disabled.

About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org(opens in new window) to learn more.

Short Description

  • Uses clinical expertise to review patient medical records and ensure that the documentation accurately reflects the patient’s diagnosis, treatments and severity of illness. This role bridges the gap between healthcare providers and coding professionals, ensuring that medical records are complete, compliant, and support proper reimbursement.
  • Concurrently review inpatient medical records for clear consistent, concise, legible and accurate documentation to reflect the patient’s severity of illness and intensity of services.
  • Generate and utilize queries to clarify physician documentation whenever there is conflicting, ambiguous or incomplete information in the medical record regarding any significant reportable condition or procedure.
  • Complete analysis of clinical information to identify gaps in clinical documentation. To “bridge the gap” utilize the physician advisor for clarification of clinical presentation.
  • Collaboratively work with HIM Leadership, Coders, Coding Quality Educators/Reviewers and peers to improve accuracy of final DRG.
  • Collaborate and provide educational support to physicians, nurses and ancillary staff to facilitate modifications of clinical documentation processes that promote documentation improvement.
  • Facilitates modifications to clinical documentation through concurrent interaction with physicians, nursing staff, other patient caregiver and Health Information coding staff to support that appropriate reimbursement and clinical severity is captured for the level of service rendered to all inpatients.
  • Provide clinical review of cases denied for medical necessity by auditing agencies. Using knowledge of medical necessity criteria assist physician advisor in collecting pertinent information to support an appeal.

Experience Required

3-5 years of experience required.

  • High School/GED Required
  • Bachelor's Degree Required
  • Bachelor's of Science in Nursing preferred

License/Certification Requirements

  • Certified Clinical Documentation Specialist Certification preferred
  • Certified Documentation Improvement Practitioner preferred
  • Registered Nurse, any state, preferred

Special Requirements

Professional team player, able to communicate well with others on all levels required.

WHO WE ARE

As the largest private-sector power producer in the world and the nation's largest producer of clean and reliable energy, Constellation is focused on our purpose: lighting the way to a brilliant tomorrow for all. We have been the leader in clean energy production for more than a decade, and we are cultivating a workplace where our employees can grow, thrive, and contribute. Now integrated with Calpine, our portfolio includes 55 gigawatts of capacity from nuclear, natural gas, geothermal, hydro, wind and solar facilities, with the generating capacity to power the equivalent of 27 million homes.

Our culture and employee experience make it clear: We are powered by passion and purpose. Together, we're creating healthier communities and a cleaner planet, and our people are the driving force behind our success. At Constellation, you can build a fulfilling career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact. By doing our best work and meeting new challenges, we can accomplish great things. Join us in meeting the country's energy needs today and tomorrow.

Purpose of the Role:

Support the Chief of Staff to the Chief External Affairs & Growth Officer through policy and business research, executive briefing preparation, project coordination, and tracking of organizational priorities. The intern will synthesize complex information into clear, actionable materials and support internal and external engagements involving energy, regulatory, legislative, political, and market issues. Constellation's 2027 Summer Intern Program will run approximately 10 weeks, from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027.

This internship offers a unique opportunity to see how strategy, public policy, legal, communications, sustainability, advocacy, and development come together. The intern will work directly with the Chief of Staff and support projects that cut across the External Affairs & Growth organization, gaining exposure to senior leaders, enterprise priorities, and the processes behind executive decision-making.

A significant part of this work is policy-focused and centers on preparing the Chief External Affairs & Growth Officer for both internal and external engagements. The intern will help research the energy, regulatory, legislative, and political issues that shape Constellation’s business, and turn that research into the briefings, talking points, and background materials.

This is a great opportunity for someone interested in the intersection of energy, public policy, politics, corporate strategy, communications, and organizational leadership who wants hands-on experience seeing how a large, complex organization turns priorities into action.

About External Affairs & Growth:

External Affairs & Growth brings together teams responsible for Legal; Public Policy; Sustainability & Policy Analysis; Strategy, Corporate Affairs & Public Advocacy; and Development. The organization works across a wide range of issues affecting Constellation and the energy industry, bringing together different functions and perspectives to advance shared priorities.

Primary Duties and Accountabilities:

  • Conduct research on energy, public policy, legislative, regulatory, political, and market issues and summarize relevant findings for executive decision-making and engagements.
  • Draft and edit briefing materials, issue summaries, stakeholder profiles, talking points, presentations, meeting materials, and other executive communications.
  • Support preparation for leadership meetings and external engagements by developing agendas and materials, documenting decisions and action items, and coordinating follow-up.
  • Assist with cross-functional projects by organizing information, maintaining project plans and trackers, monitoring timelines and deliverables, and identifyingnext steps.
  • Track organizational priorities, commitments, decisions, and action items to support timely and consistent execution.
  • Use Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft 365 tools to organize, analyze, track, and present information.
  • Support process improvements, information sharing, and other time-sensitive assignments as priorities evolve.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Currently enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate degree program.
  • Demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize complex information clearly andconcisely to multiple levels of leadership including senior executives.
  • Demonstrated research, analytical, organizational, and project coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business needs.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams, and working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  • Ability to work full-time during the summer and primarily during East Coast business hours

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Rising junior or senior in an undergraduate program or currently enrolled in a master’s program.
  • Coursework or degree focus in public policy, public administration, economics, communications, marketing, political science, government, international affairs, energy, environmental policy, or a related field.
  • Prior internship, employment, or volunteer experience in government, public policy, political campaigns, energy, communications, corporate strategy, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including experience organizing, analyzing, tracking, and presenting information.
  • Interest in energy and public policy, organizational strategy, executive decision-making, or cross-functional business operations.

Constellation will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. You must have the ability to lawfully work in the United States without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.

Position Title: Lead Systems Engineer - Design

Position Location: Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States

JOB SUMMARY

The Lead Systems Engineer provides leadership, expertise, and delegates work for design document deliverables for building automation system (BAS), electrical power monitoring system (EPMS), and software integration design projects in hyperscale data center and similar mission critical / technology sectors.

The Lead Systems Engineer will work with internal and external MEP/FP trade engineers, equipment representatives, product vendors, and BIM / Revit / AutoCAD production resources.

The Lead Systems Engineer will be self-directed on day-to-day work and receive high level instruction on new projects, tasks or assignments. Will execute and lead teams and projects, tasks or assignments of complex scope. This role also will coordinate activities of other personnel and serve as a people manager.

This person will communicate and operate in line with organizational goals / values, and departmental objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Develop and Execute Building Automation Systems Engineering Solutions (55%)

  • Serve as client program lead, project trade lead, and SME for the BAS and EPMS scope for one or more projects and / or programs.
  • Develop client standards, basis of design (BOD), perform feasibility studies, and assist clients with building automation roadmaps
  • Lead designs for DDC and PLC based BAS and EPMS systems
  • Design controls network / system architecture including IT / OT requirements
  • Select instrumentation, sensors, actuators, valves and other field devices
  • Coordinate with equipment, system, and product vendors for building automation interface requirements
  • Create and review project book and sheet specifications
  • Create and review sequence of operations
  • Create and review system diagrams and point / alarm lists
  • Work closely with client IT departments for network design, interface details, and security requirements
  • Provide direction on engineering production aspects with internal and external Revit / BIM resources

Construction Related Process, Deliverables and Submissions (15%)

  • Accountable for design document deliverables for design phases including Schematic Design (SD), Design Development (DD), Issue For Permit (IFP), Issue For Construction (IFC)
  • Lead planning and execution of Construction Administration (CA) phase activities remote and on site
  • Lead building automation focused design reviews and page turns
  • ​Participate in internal and external quality control and peer reviews
  • Lead internal and external project meeting discussions on engineering scope

Reporting and Communication (15%)

  • Manage project communication and reporting
  • Prepare project progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Manage personal hours using company tools

People Manager (15%)

  • Implement and monitor team objectives to meet set goals.
  • Manage and execute departmental or organizational projects, ensuring alignment with departmental focus.
  • Ensure employee adherence to company policies and procedures, serve as the first stop for employee questions on workplace rules and practices.
  • Direct team members clearly, maintaining consistency with organizational objectives.
  • Develop team efficiency and prioritization strategies.
  • Facilitate team member development through targeted coaching.
  • Resolve conflicts within the team, promoting a collaborative atmosphere.
  • Perform routine performance evaluations and 1:1 meetings, offering feedback and defining objectives.
  • Participate in organizational strategy discussions to synchronize departmental and company goals.
  • Foster interdepartmental communication to enhance organizational understanding.
  • Align team efforts with overarching company strategies.
  • Communicate details effectively to all stakeholders.
  • Optimize resource management and task assignments within the team.
  • Adapt resource allocation in response to project demands and departmental needs.
  • Cultivate a team environment that encourages cooperation and collective problem-solving.
  • Assist with team and departmental hiring and recruiting processes.

Technology, Digital Tools & AI-Enabled Efficiency

  • Leverage AI-enabled and digital tools to enhance efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support consistent, high-quality work output.
  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and demonstrate a continuous learning mindset, seeking out new technologies, skills, and methods that elevate individual and team performance.
  • Adapt to emerging technologies and evolving digital workflows, actively supporting the integration and adoption of innovative tools across the organization.

Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget

Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned

POSITION REQUIREMENTS (ADVANCED LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING)

  • Skilled in navigating clients through BAS project designs including identification of standards, needs, and option evaluation
  • Skilled in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail
  • Skilled at using MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Teams), along with exceptional organizational skills for file management
  • Skilled in designing BAS and EPMS packages
  • Knowledge of construction design process, stakeholders, deliverables
  • Knowledge of code requirements and energy guidelines related to BAS designs
  • Knowledge of data center HVAC applications and BAS control strategies including chilled water plants
  • Knowledge of IoT and smart building solutions
  • Knowledge of Networking including Addressing, VLANs, LANs, Switches and Routers
  • Knowledge of open-source protocols (BACnet, Modbus and SNMP)
  • Knowledge of DDC systems used in building automation designs
  • Knowledge of PLC systems used in building automation designs
  • Organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to streamline workflows, optimize operational processes, and contribute to company-wide innovation
  • Ability to work successfully in a remote environment through effective communication and organizational skills, self-motivation, proactiveness and resourcefulness in a distraction free workspace
  • Ability to follow company and site safety requirements
  • Ability to analyze and prepare documents, reports and correspondence
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form (technical and non-technical information)
  • Ability to communicate effectively directly with clients and at times serve as primary point of client contact
  • Ability to work successfully as a member of a team and independently with moderate supervision
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet close deadlines
  • Ability to effectively plan and delegate the work of others
  • Ability to mentor and train junior engineers

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is

  • Frequently manipulating, moving or grasping small parts, devices or tools
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position
  • Frequently moving through office, critical facility and other environments (such as low temperatures, high temperatures and outdoor elements such as precipitation and wind), including tight and confined spaces
  • Frequently descending / ascending stairs and ladders to access equipment
  • On occasion the employee may be required to position self under or over equipment
  • On occasion the employee may move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds

TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS

  • Up to 15%, this may include travel to any or all 50 US states
  • Effective May 7, 2025, and in accordance with U.S. federal regulations for domestic air travel, a valid REAL ID (or an acceptable alternative, such as a passport) is required for travel associated with this position.
  • Travel may involve transportation by car or plane depending on the destination and nature of the business need.
  • Travel is defined as physically leaving home on behalf of business activities including but not limited to client sites, meetings with other employees, meetings for business development purposes, running errands on behalf of the business, attending industry conferences, etc.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction or related discipline

OR

  • Two years of experience with hands-on installation, testing, validation and troubleshooting of controls infrastructure

PLUS

  • Minimum eight years of additional experience with BAS and EPMS design
  • At least half of this experience should be with hyperscale or colocation data center projects

BENEFITS

  • Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option)
  • Dental and vision plans
  • Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26

  • PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year
  • Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents
  • Short and long-term disability, AD&D coverage

  • Paid parental leave after one year of employment
